Bava Batra 164b:13-165a:2: Hahu mekushshar daata lekammeh derabbi, veamar rabbi: en zeman bazze?! amar leh rabbi shimon bar rabbi lerabbi: shemma ben kesharav muvela? palyeh, vechazyeh. hadar chaza beh rabbi bevishut. amar leh: lav ana ketavteh, rabbi yehuda chayyayta katveh. amar leh: kelach millashon hara hazze.
Zimnin hava yatev kammeh, veka fasek sidra besefer tehillim; amar rabbi: kamma meyushshar ketav ze! amar leh: lav ana ketavteh, yehuda chayyayta katveh. amar leh: kelach millashon hara hazze.

Bishlama hatam, ikka lashon hara; ella hacha, may lashon hara ikka? mishshum derav dimi – detane rav dimi achu derav safra: leolam al yesapper adam betovato shel chavero, shemmittoch tovato ba lide raato.
Amar rav amram amar rav: shalosh averot en adam nitztzol mehen bechol yom – hirhur avera, veiyyun tefilla, velashon hara. lashon hara salka datach?!
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: rov begazel, umiut baarayot, vehakkol belashon hara. belashon hara salka datach?! ella avak lashon hara.
Berakhot 27a:15-27b:4: Rav ikkela leve geniva vetzalli shel shabbat beerev shabbat, vahava metzalle rabbi yirmeya bar abba laachore derav, vesayyem rav vela paskeh litzloteh derabbi yirmeya. shema minna telat: shema minna mitpallel adam shel shabbat beerev shabbat. ushema minna mitpallel talmid achore rabbo. ushema minna asur laavor keneged hammitpallelin.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur laavor keneged hammitpallelin. ini?! veha rabbi amme verabbi assi chalfi. rabbi amme verabbi assi — chutz learba ammot hu dechalfi.
Verabbi yirmeya hechi aved hachi?! veha amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam al yitpallel adam
Lo keneged rabbo, velo achore rabbo.

Vetanya, rabbi eliezer omer: hammitpallel achore rabbo, vehannoten shalom lerabbo, vehammachazir shalom lerabbo, vehacholek al yeshivato shel rabbo, vehaomer davar shello shama mippi rabbo — gorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael!
Shane rabbi yirmeya bar abba detalmid chaver hava. vehayeynu dekaamar leh rabbi yirmeya bar abba lerav: mi bedalt? amar leh: in, bedelna, vela amar "mi bedel mar"?

Umi bedel? vehaamar rabbi avin: paam achat hitpallel rabbi shel shabbat beerev shabbat, venichnas lammerchatz, veyatza veshana lan pirkin, vaadayin lo chashcha! amar rava: hahu denichnas lehazzia, vekodem gezera hava.
Chullin 84a:18-24: Talmud lomar "tzed", mikkol makom. im ken, ma talmud lomar "asher yatzud"? limmeda tora derech eretz, shello yochal adam basar ella bahazemana hazzot.
Tanu rabbanan: "ki yarchiv Adonai elohecha et gevulcha" – limmeda tora derech eretz, shello yochal adam basar ella leteavon.

Yachol yikkach adam min hashshuk veyochal? talmud lomar: "vezavachta mibbekarcha umitztzoncha". yachol yizbach kol bekaro veyochal, kol tzono veyochal? talmud lomar: "mibbekarcha" – velo kol bekarcha, "mitztzoncha" – velo kol tzoncha.

Mikkan amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: mi sheyyesh lo mane – yikkach lefaso litra yarak, asara mane – yikkach lefaso litra dagim, chamishshim mane – yikkach lefaso litra basar, mea mane – yishpetu lo kedera bechol yom. veinach emat? meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.

Amar rav: tzerichin anu lachosh ledivre zaken. amar rabbi yochanan: abba mimmishpachat beriim hava, aval kegon anu, mi sheyyesh lo peruta betoch kiso – yeritzenna lachenvavni. amar rav nachman: kegon anu lovin veochlin.

"Kevasim lilvushecha" – miggez kevasim yehe malbushecha, "umechir sade attudim" – leolam yimkor adam sade veyikkach attudim, veal yimkor adam attudim veyikkach sade. "vede chalev izzim" – dayyo leadam sheyyitparnes mechalev gedayim utelaim shebbetoch beto.

"Lelachmecha lelechem betecha" – lachmecha kodem lelechem betecha. "vechayyim lenaarotecha" – amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: ten chayyim lenaarotecha, mikkan limmeda tora derech eretz shello yelammed adam et beno basar veyayin.
Eruvin 65a:13-65b:2: Amar rav yehuda: la ibberi lelya ella leshinta. amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: la ibberi sehara ella legirsa. amri leh lerabbi zera: mechaddedan shematach. amar lehu: dimame ninhu.
Amara leh barteh derav chisda lerav chisda: la bae mar menam pureta? amar la: hasheta atu yome daariche vekattine, venenum tuva.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: anan poale dimame anan. rav acha bar yaakov yazef ufara.
Amar rabbi elazar: habba min hadderech, al yitpallel shelosha yamim, shenneemar: "vaekbetzem el hannahar habba el achava vannachane sham yamim shelosha vaavina baam vegomer".
Avu dishmuel, ki ate beorcha, la metzalle telata yome. shemuel la metzalle beveta deit beh shichra. rav pappa la metzalle beveta deit beh haresana.
Amar rabbi chanina: kol hammitpatte beyeno — yesh bo middaat kono, shenneemar: "vayyarach Adonai et reach hannichoach vegomer".
Amar rabbi chiyyay: kol hammityayshshev beyeno — yesh bo daat shivim zekenim. "yayin" nittan beshivim otiyyot, vesod" nittan beshivim otiyyot. nichnas yayin — yatza sod.
Amar rabbi chanin: lo nivra yayin ella lenachem avelim uleshallem sachar larshaim, shenneemar: "tenu shechar leoved vegomer".

Amar rabbi chanin bar pappa: kol sheen yayin nishpach betoch beto kammayim — eno bichlal beracha, shenneemar: "uverach et lachmecha veet memecha". ma lechem shennikkach bechesef maaser — af mayim shennikkach bechesef maaser, umay nihu — yayin, veka kare leh mayim.
I nishpach beveto kammayim — ikka beracha, vei la — la.
Amar rabbi ilay, bishlosha devarim adam nikkar: bechoso, uvechiso uvechaso. veamri leh af besachako.
Ezekiel 20:12-16: Vegam et-shabbetotay natatti lahem lihyot leot beni uvenehem ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddesham
Vayyamru-vi vet-yisrael bammidbar bechukkotay lo-halachu veet-mishpatay maasu asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem veet-shabbetotay chillelu meod vaomar lishpoch chamati alehem bammidbar lechallotam
Vaeese lemaan shemi levilti hechel leene haggoyim asher hotzetim leenehem
Vegam-ani nasati yadi lahem bammidbar levilti havi otam el-haaretz asher-natatti zavat chalav udevash tzevi hi lechol-haaratzot
Yaan bemishpatay maasu veet-chukkotay lo-halchu vahem veet-shabbetotay chillelu ki achare gillulehem libbam holech
Ezekiel 20:17-22: Vattachos eni alehem mishshachatam velo-asiti otam kala bammidbar
Vaomar el-benehem bammidbar bechukke avotechem al-telechu veet-mishpetehem al-tishmoru uvegillulehem al-tittammau
Ani Adonai elohechem bechukkotay lechu veet-mishpatay shimru vaasu otam
Veet-shabbetotay kaddeshu vehayu leot beni uvenechem ladaat ki ani Adonai elohechem

Vayyamru-vi habbanim bechukkotay lo-halachu veet-mishpatay lo-shamru laasot otam asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem et-shabbetotay chillelu vaomar lishpoch chamati alehem lechallot appi bam bammidbar
Vahashivoti et-yadi vaaas lemaan shemi levilti hechel leene haggoyim asher-hotzeti otam leenehem
Ezekiel 20:2-7: Ben-adam dabber et-zikne yisrael veamarta alehem ko amar adonay Adonai halidrosh oti attem baim chay-ani im-iddaresh lachem neum adonay Adonai
Hatishpot otam hatishpot ben-adam et-toavot avotam hodiem
Veamarta alehem ko-amar adonay Adonai beyom bochori veyisrael vaessa yadi lezera bet yaakov vaivvada lahem beeretz mitzrayim vaessa yadi lahem lemor ani Adonai elohechem
Bayyom hahu nasati yadi lahem lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim el-eretz asher-tarti lahem zavat chalav udevash tzevi hi lechol-haaratzot
Vaomar alehem ish shikkutze enav hashelichu uvegillule mitzrayim al-tittammau ani Adonai elohechem
Ezekiel 20:23-27: Gam-ani nasati et-yadi lahem bammidbar lehafitz otam baggoyim ulezarot otam baaratzot
Yaan mishpatay lo-asu vechukkotay maasu veet-shabbetotay chillelu veachare gillule avotam hayu enehem
Vegam-ani natatti lahem chukkim lo tovim umishpatim lo yichyu bahem
Vaatamme otam bemattenotam behaavir kol-peter racham lemaan ashimmem lemaan asher yedu asher ani Adonai {s}
Lachen dabber el-bet yisrael ben-adam veamarta alehem ko amar adonay Adonai od zot giddefu oti avotechem bemaalam bi maal
Ezekiel 20:8-11: Vayyamru-vi velo avu lishmoa elay ish et-shikkutze enehem lo hishlichu veet-gillule mitzrayim lo azavu vaomar lishpoch chamati alehem lechallot appi bahem betoch eretz mitzrayim
Vaaas lemaan shemi levilti hechel leene haggoyim asher-hemma vetocham asher nodati alehem leenehem lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim
Vaetten lahem et-chukkotay veet-mishpatay hodati otam asher yaase otam haadam vachay bahem
Kiddushin 29a:10-30b:14: Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: haav chayyayv bivno lemulo, velifdoto, ulelammedo tora, ulehassio ishsha, ulelammedo ummanut. veyesh omrim: af lahashito bammayim. rabbi yehuda omer: kol sheeno melammed et beno ummanut – melammedo listut. listut salka datach? ella: keillu melammedo listut.

"Lemulo" menalan? dichtiv: "vayyamol avraham et yitzchak beno". vehecha dela mahleh avu michayyeyvi be dina lemimhaleh, dichtiv: "himmol lachem kol zachar". vehecha dela mahlu be dina michayyayv ihu lemimhal nafsheh, dichtiv: "vearel zachar asher lo yimmol et besar orlato venichreta".
Ihi menalan dela michayyeyva? dichtiv: "kaasher tzivva oto elohim" – oto velo otah.
Ashkechan miyyad, ledorot menalan? tana deve rabbi yishmael: kol makom shenneemar: "tzav" eno ella zeruz, miyyad uledorot.
Zeruz, dichtiv: "vetzav et yehoshua vechazzekehu veammetzehu". miyyad uledorot, dichtiv: "min hayyom asher tzivva Adonai vahala ledorotechem"
Lifdoto. menalan? dichtiv: "kol bechor banecha tifde". vehecha dela parkeh avu michayyayv ihu lemifrekeh dichtiv: (pado) "tippade".
Veihi menalan dela mippakda? dichtiv: "tippade" – "tifde", kol shemmetzuvvev lifdot et atzmo – metzuvvev lifdot et acherim, vechol sheeno metzuvvev lifdot et atzmo – eno metzuvvev lifdot acherim.

Veihi menalan dela michayyeyva lemifrak nafsha? dichtiv: "tifde" – "tippade", kol sheacherim metzuvvivym lifdoto – metzuvvev lifdot et atzmo, vechol sheen acherim metzuvvivym lifdoto – en metzuvvev lifdot et atzmo. uminnayin sheen acherim metzuvvivyn lifdotah? deamar kera: "kol bechor banecha tifde" – banecha velo benotecha.
Tanu rabbanan: hu lifdot uveno lifdot – hu kodem livno. rabbi yehuda omer: beno kodmo. shezze mitzvato al aviv, veze mitzvat beno alav.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: hakkol modin
Kol hecha delekka ella chamesh selaim – hu kodem livno. may tama? mitzva degufeh adifa. ki peligi hecha deikka chamesh meshuebadim vechamesh bene chorin.
Rabbi yehuda savar: milva (dichtiv) [hakketuva] battora kichtuva bishtar damya, behane chamesh parek livreh veazel kohen vetaref leh lechamesh meshuebadim ledideh.
Verabbanan savri: milva dichtiv beorayyta lav kichtuva bishtar damya, vehilkach mitzva degufeh adif.
Tanu rabbanan: lifdot et beno velaalot laregel – pode et beno veachar kach ole laregel. rabbi yehuda omer: ole laregel, veachar kach pode et beno. shezzo mitzva overet, vezo mitzva sheenah overet.
Bishlama lerabbi yehuda, kidkaamar tama. ella rabbanan may tamayyhu? deamar kera: "kol bechor banecha tifde", vahadar: "lo yerau fanay rekam".
Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheim hayu lo chamishsha banim mechamesh nashim shechayyayv lifdot kullan – talmud lomar: "kol bechor banecha tifde". peshita, befeter rechem tela rachamana!
Mahu detema: nelaf bechor bechor minnachala, ma lehallan "reshit ono", af kan "reshit ono", ka mashma lan.
Lelammedo tora. menalan? dichtiv: "velimmadtem otam et benechem". vehecha dela agmereh avu michayyayv ihu lemigmar nafsheh, dichtiv: "ulemadtem".
Ihi menalan dela michayyeyva? dichtiv: "velimmadtem" "ulemadtem", kol shemmetzuvvev lilmod – metzuvvev lelammed, vechol sheeno metzuvvev lilmod – eno metzuvvev lelammed.

Veihi menalan dela michayyeyva lemelaf nafsha? dichtiv: "velimmadtem" "ulemadtem", kol sheacherim metzuvvivyn lelammedo – metzuvvev lelammed et atzmo, vechol sheen acherim metzuvvivyn lelammedo – en metzuvvev lelammed et atzmo. uminnayin sheen acherim metzuvvivyn lelammedah? deamar kera: "velimmadtem otam et benechem" et benechem, velo benotechem.

Tanu rabbanan: hu lilmod uveno lilmod – hu kodem livno. rabbi yehuda omer: im beno zariz umemullach vetalmudo mitkayyem beyado – beno kodmo. ki ha derav yaakov bereh derav acha bar yaakov shaddereh avu lekammeh deabbaye. ki ata chazyeh dela hava michaddedan shemateh. amar leh: ana adifa minnach, tuv at, deezil ana.
Shema abbaye deka hava ate. hava hahu mazzik be rabbanan deabbaye, dechi havo ayyli bitren afillu bimama havo mittazzeki. amar lehu: la littev leh inash ushepiza, efshar demitrechish nissa.
Al, bat behahu be rabbanan. iddemi leh ketannina deshiva reshvoteh. kol keria dichra netar chad resheh. amar lehu limchar: i la itrechish nissa sakkentin.

Tanu rabbanan: lilmod tora velissa ishsha – yilmod tora veachar kach yissa ishsha. veim i efshar lo belo ishsha – yissa ishsha veachar kach yilmod tora. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha, nose ishsha veachar kach yilmod tora.
Rabbi yochanan amar: rechayim betzavvaro veyaasok battora?! vela peligi: ha – lan, veha – lehu.

Mishtabbach leh rav chisda lerav huna bidrav hamenuna deadam gadol hu. amar leh: kesheyyavo leyadcha – haviehu leyadi. ki ata chazyeh dela pares sudara. amar leh: may tama la paresat sudara? amar leh: dela nesevna. ahderinhu leappeh minneh. amar leh: chazi dela chazet lehu leappay ad denasvat.
Rav huna letameh deamar: ben esrim shana velo nasa ishsha – kol yamav baavera. baavera salka datach?! ella ema: kol yamav behirhur avera.
Amar rava, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: ad esrim shana yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu umetzappe laadam matay yissa ishsha, kevan shehiggia esrim velo nasa, omer: tippach atzmotav.
Amar rav chisda: hay daadifna mechavray, dinsevna beshittesar, vei hava nasevna bearbesar
Hava amena lesatan: gira beenaych. amar leh rava lerabbi natan bar amme: addidach al tzavvere divraych. mishshittesar vead esrim vetarte veamri la: mittamne sere ad esrim vearbaa.
Ketannae: "chanoch lannaar al pi darko", rabbi yehuda verabbi nechemya, chad amar: mishshittesar vead esrim vetarten, vechad amar: mittamne sere vead esrim vearbea.

Ad hechan chayyayv adam lelammed et beno tora? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kegon zevulun ben dan, shellimmedo avi aviv mikra umishna vetalmud halachot veaggadot. metivi: limmedo mikra – en melammedo mishna, veamar rava: mikra – zo tora!
Kizvulun ben dan, velo kizvulun ben dan. kizvulun ben dan – shellimmedo avi aviv, velo kizvulun ben dan, deillu hatam mikra mishna vetalmud halachot veaggadot, veillu hacha – mikra levad.

Vaavi aviv mi michayyayv? vehatanya: "velimmadtem otam et benechem" – velo bene venechem. uma ani mekayyem: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha", lomar lach: shekkol hamelammed et beno tora – maale alav hakkatuv keillu limmedo lo velivno uleven beno, ad sof kol haddorot!

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya: "velimmadtem otam et benechem" – en li ella benechem, bene venechem minnayin? talmud lomar: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha". im ken ma talmud lomar: "benechem" – benechem velo benotechem.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hamelammed et ben beno tora maale alav hakkatuv keillu kibbelah mehar sinay, shenneemar: "vehodatam levanecha velivne vanecha", usemich leh: "yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elokecha bechorev".

Rabbi chiyyay bar abba ashkecheh lerabbi yehoshua ben levi deshade disna aresheh veka mamte leh leyanoka leve chenishta. amar leh: may kulle hay? amar leh: mi zutar may dichtiv: "vehodatam levanecha" usemich leh: "yom asher amadta lifne Adonai elokecha bechorev"? mikkan veelach, rabbi chiyyay bar abba la taem umetza ad demakre leyanoka umosfeh. rabba bar rav huna la taem umetza ad demayyte leyanoka levet midresha.
Amar rav safra mishshum rabbi yehoshua ben chananya: may dichtiv "veshinnantam levanecha" – al tikre "veshinnantam", ella "veshillashtam".
Leolam yeshallesh adam shenotav: shelish bammikra, shelish bammishna, shelish battalmud. mi yodea kamma chaye? la tzericha leyome.

Lefichach nikreu rishonim "sofrim", shehayu sofrim kol haotiyyot shebbattora, shehayu omrim: vav degachon"– chetzyayn shel otiyyot shel sefer tora. "darosh darash" – chetzyayn shel tevot. "vehitgallach" – shel pesukim. "yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar" – ayin deyaar chetzyayn shel tehillim. "vehu rachum yechapper avon" – chetzyo difsukim.

Bae rav yosef: vav "degachon", mehay gisa o mehay gisa? amaru leh: nete sefer tora venimninhu, mi la amar rabba bar bar chana: lo zazu mishsham ad sheheviu sefer tora umenaum? amar lehu: inhu bekii bachaserot viterot, anan la bekiinan.

Bae rav yosef: "vehitgallach", mehay gisa o mehay gisa? amar leh abbaye: pesuke miha layto limninhu! bifsuke name la bekiinan, dechi ata rav acha bar adda, amar: bemareva paski leh lehay kera litlata pesuke: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinne anochi ba elecha beav heanan".
Tanu rabbanan: chameshet alafim ushemone meot ushemonim ushemona pesukim havu pesuke sefer tora, yater alav tehillim shemona, chaser mimmennu divre hayyamim shemona.
Tanu rabbanan: "veshinnantam", sheyyehu divre tora mechuddadim befich, sheim yishal lecha adam davar al tegamgem vetomar lo, ella emor lo miyyad, shenneemar:

"Emor lachochma achoti at vegomer" veomer: "koshrem al etzbeotecha kotvem al luach libbecha", veomer: "kechitztzim beyad gibbor ken bene hanneurim", veomer: "chitztze gibbor shenunim", veomer: "chitztzecha shenunim ammim tachtecha yippelu", veomer: "ashre haggever asher mille et ashpato mehem lo yevoshu ki yedabberu et oyvim bashshaar".

May "et oyvim bashshaar"? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: afillu haav uveno, harav vetalmido sheoskin battora bashshaar echad – naasim oyvim ze et ze. veenam zazim mishsham ad shennaasim ohavim ze et ze shenneemar: "et vahev besufa", al tikre "besufa" ella "besofah".

Tanu rabbanan: "vesamtem" – sam tam, nimshela tora kesam chayyim. mashal leadam shehikka et beno makka gedola vehinniach lo retiyya al makkato, veamar lo: beni, kol zeman shehartiyya zo al makkatcha echol ma shehanaatecha, ushete ma shehanaatecha, urechotz ben bechammin ben betzonen veen atta mityayre. veim atta maavirah hare hi maala nome.
Kach hakkadosh baruch hu amar lahem leyisrael: banay, barati yetzer hara uvarati lo tora tavlin. veim attem oskim battora – en attem nimsarim beyado, shenneemar: "halo im tetiv seet",

Veim en attem oskin battora – attem nimsarim beyado, shenneemar: "lappetach chattat rovetz", velo od ella shekkol massao umattano becha, shenneemar: "veelecha teshukato". veim atta rotze atta moshel bo, shenneemar: "veatta timshol bo".

Tanu rabbanan: kashe yetzer hara, sheafillu yotzro kerao ra, shenneemar: "ki yetzer lev haadam ra minneurav". amar rav yitzchak: yitzro shel adam mitchaddesh alav bechol yom, shenneemar: "rak ra kol hayyom".

Veamar rabbi shimon ben levi: yitzro shel adam mitgabber alav bechol yom umevakkesh hamito, shenneemar: "tzofe rasha latztzaddik umevakkesh lahamito", veilmale hakkadosh baruch hu ozro en yachol lo, shenneemar: "elohim lo yaazvennu veyado".

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: beni im paga becha menuuol ze – moshchehu levet hammidrash. im even hu – nimmoach, veim barzel hu – mitpotzetz, shenneemar: "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai uchefattish yefotzetz sala". im even hu – nimmoach, shenneemar: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim" veomer: "avanim shachaku mayim".
Lehassio ishsha. menalan? dichtiv: "kechu nashim veholidu banim uvanot ukechu livnechem nashim veet benotechem tenu laanashim".
Bishlama beno – beyado, ella bitto – beyado hi? hachi kaamar lehu: nitten la midde v[na]lebshay unechasseyay ki hechi di[l]kiftzu ala inashe.

Lelammedo ummanut. menalan? amar chizkiyya: deamar kera: "ree chayyim im ishsha asher ahavta". im "ishsha" mammash hi: keshem shechayyayv lehassio ishsha – kach chayyayv lelammedo ummanut. im tora hi: keshem shechayyayv lelammedo tora – kach chayyayv lelammedo ummanut.
Veyesh omrim af lahashito bannahar. may tama? chayyuteh hu.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kol sheeno melammedo ummanut – melammedo listut. listut salka datach! ella, keillu melammedo listut.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deagmereh iska.
Mishnah Bava Batra 6:6-7:2:
Mi sheyyesh lo ginna lifnim migginnato shel chavero, nichnas beshaa shedderech bene adam nichnasim veyotze beshaa shedderech bene adam yotzin, veeno machnis letochah taggarin, velo yikkanes mittochah letoch sade acheret, vehachitzon zorea et haddarech. natnu lo derech min hatztzad middaat shenehem, nichnas beshaa shehu rotze veyotze beshaa shehu rotze, umachnis letochah taggarin, velo yikkanes mittochah letoch sade acheret, veze vaze enam rashshaim lezarah: 
Mi shehayta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu, netalah venatan lahem min hatztzad, ma shennatan natan, veshello lo higgio. derech hayyachid, arba ammot. derech harabbim, shesh esre amma. derech hammelech, en lah shiur. derech hakkever, en lah shiur. hammaamad, dayyane tzippori amru, bet arbaat kabbin: 
Hammocher makom lachavero laasot lo kever, vechen hamekabbel mechavero laasot lo kever, ose tochah shel meara arba ammot al shesh, ufoteach letochah shemona chuchin, shelosha mikkan ushelosha mikkan ushenayim mikkenegdan, vechuchin arkan arba ammot veruman shiva verachban shishsha. rabbi shimon omer, ose tochah shel meara shesh ammot al shemone, ufoteach letochah shelosha asar kuch, arbaa mikkan vearbaa mikkan ushelosha mikkenegdan veechad mimin happetach veechad min hassemol. veose chatzer al pi hammeara shesh al shesh, kimlo hammitta vekovreha, ufoteach letochah shete mearot, achat mikkan veachat mikkan. rabbi shimon omer, arba, learba ruchoteha. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol lefi hassala: 
Haomer lachavero, bet kor afar ani mocher lecha, hayu sham nekaim amukkim asara tefachim o selaim gevohim asara tefachim, enan nimdadin immah. pachot mikkan, nimdadin immah. veim amar lo kevet kor afar, afillu hayu sham nekaim amukkim yoter measara tefachim o selaim gevohin yoter measara tefachim, hare ellu nimdadin immah: 
Bet kor afar ani mocher lecha midda vachevel, pichet kol shehu, yenakke. hotir kol shehu, yachazir. im amar, hen chaser hen yater, afillu fichet rova lassea o hotir rova lassea, higgio. yoter mikkan, yaase cheshbon. ma hu machazir lo, maot. veim ratza, machazir lo karka. velamma amru machazir lo maot, leyappot kocho shel mocher, sheim shiyyer bassade bet tisha kabbin uvagginna bet chatzi kav, uchedivre rabbi akiva bet rova, machazir lo et hakkarka. velo et harova bilvad hu machazir, ella et kol hammotar:
Mishnah Bava Batra 7:3-8:2:
Midda vachevel ani mocher lecha hen chaser hen yater, bittel hen chaser hen yater midda vachevel. hen chaser hen yater midda vachevel, bittel midda vachevel hen chaser hen yater, divre ven nannas. besimanav uvimtzarav, pachot mishshetut, higgio. ad shetut, yenakke: 
Haomer lachavero chatzi sade ani mocher lecha, meshammenin benehen venotel chatzi sadehu. chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lecha, meshammenin benehen venotel chetzyah baddarom, vehu mekabbel alav mekom haggader, charitz uven charitz. vechamma hu charitz, shishsha tefachim. uven charitz, shelosha: 
Yesh nochalin umanchilin, veyesh nochalin velo manchilin, manchilin velo nochalin, lo nochalin velo manchilin. veellu nochalin umanchilin, haav et habbanim vehabbanim et haav vehaachin min haav, nochalin umanchilin. haish et immo vehaish et ishto, uvene achayot, nochalin velo manchilin. haishsha et baneha vehaishsha et balah vaache haem, manchilin velo nochalin. vehaachim min haem, lo nochalin velo manchilin: 
Seder nechalot kach hu, (Bamidbar 27) ish ki yamut uven en lo, vehaavartem et nachalato levitto, ben kodem labbat, vechol yotze yerecho shel ben kodmin labbat. bat kodemet laachin. yotze yerechah shel bat, kodmin laachin. achin kodmin laache haav. yotze yerechan shel achin, kodmin laache haav. ze hakkelal, kol hakkodem bannachala, yotze yerecho kodmin. vehaav kodem lechol yotze yerecho:
Mishnah Bava Batra 8:3-6:
Benot tzelafchad natlu shelosha chalakim bannachala. chelek avihen shehaya im yotze mitzrayim, vechelko im echav benichse chefer. veshehaya vechor notel shene chalakim: 
Echad habben veechad habbat bannachala, ella shehabben notel pi shenayim benichse haav veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem. vehabbanot nizzonot minnichse haav veenan nizzonot minnichse haem: 
Haomer ish peloni veni bechor lo yittol pi shenayim, ish peloni veni lo yirash im echav, lo amar kelum, shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora. hamechallek nechasav levanav al piv, ribba leechad umiet leechad vehishva lahen et habbechor, devarav kayyamin. veim amar mishshum yerushsha, lo amar kelum. katav ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof mishshum mattana, devarav kayyamin. haomer ish peloni yirasheni bimkom sheyesh bat, bitti tirasheni bimkom sheyyesh ben, lo amar kelum, shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, im amar al mi shehu rauy leyarsho, devarav kayyamin. veal mi sheen rauy leyarsho, en devarav kayyamin. hakkotev et nechasav laacherim vehinniach et banav, ma sheasa asuy, aval en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, im lo hayu vanav nohagin kashshura, zachur letov: 
Haomer ze beni, neeman. ze achi, eno neeman venotel immo bechelko. met, yachzeru nechasim limkoman. naflu lo nechasim mimmakom acher, yirshu echav immo. mi shemmet venimtzet deyateke keshura al yerecho, hare zo enah kelum. zikka vah leacher, ben min hayyorshin ben sheeno min hayyorshin, devarav kayyamin:
Mishnah Bava Batra 8:7-9:3:
Hakkotev nechasav levanav, tzarich sheyyichtov mehayyom uleachar mita, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, eno tzarich. hakkotev nechasav livno leachar moto, haav eno yachol limkor, mippene shehen ketuvin labben, vehabben eno yachol limkor, mippene shehen birshut haav. machar haav, mechurin ad sheyyamut. machar habben, en lallokeach bahen kelum ad sheyyamut haav. haav tolesh umaachil lechol mi sheyyirtze. uma shehinniach talush, hare hu shel yorshin. hinniach banim gedolim uketannim, en haggedolim mitparnesim al hakketannim velo hakketannim nizzonin al haggedolim, ella cholkin beshave. nasu haggedolim, yisu hakketannim. veim amru ketannim hare anu nosim kederech shennesatem attem, en shomin lahem, ella ma shennatan lahem avihem natan: 
Hinniach banot gedolot uketannot, en haggedolot mitparnesot al hakketannot velo hakketannot nizzonot al haggedolot, ella cholkot beshave. nasu gedolot, yisu ketannot. veim amru ketannot, hare anu nosot kederech shennesatem attem, en shomin lahen. ze chomer babbanot mibbabbanim, shehabbanot nizzonot al habbanim veen nizzonot al habbanot: 
Mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot, bizman shehannechasim merubbim, habbanim yirshu vehabbanot yizzonu. nechasim muatin, habbanot yizzonu vehabbanim yishalu al happetachim. admon omer, bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti. amar rabban gamliel, roe ani et divre admon: 
Hinniach banim uvanot vetumtum, bizman shehannechasim merubbim, hazzecharim dochin oto etzel nekevot. nechasim muatin, hannekevot dochot oto etzel zecharim. haomer im teled ishti zachar yittol mane, yalda zachar, notel mane. nekeva matayim, yalda nekeva, notelet matayim. im zachar mane im nekeva matayim, veyalda zachar unekeva, zachar notel mane vehannekeva notelet matayim. yalda tumtum, eno notel. im amar kol ma shetteled ishti yittol, hare ze yittol. veim en sham yoresh ella hu, yoresh et hakkol: 
Hinniach banim gedolim uketannim, hishbichu gedolim et hannechasim, hishbichu laemtza. im amru reu ma shehinniach lanu abba, hare anu osim veochlin, hishbichu leatzman. vechen haishsha shehishbicha et hannechasim, hishbicha laemtza. im amra reu ma shehinniach li bali, hare ani osa veochelet, hishbicha leatzmah:
Mishnah Bava Batra 9:4-7:
Haachin hashshuttafin shennafal echad mehen laummanut, nafal laemtza. chala venitrappa, nitrappa mishshel atzmo. haachin sheasu miktzatan shushevinut bechayye haav, chazra shushevinut, chazra laemtza, shehashshushevinut nigbet bevet din. aval hashsholeach lachavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen, enan nigbin bevet din, mippene shehen gemilut chasadim: 
Hashsholeach sivlonot levet chamiv, shalach sham mea mane veachal sham seudat chatan afillu vedinar, enan nigbin. lo achal sham seudat chatan, hare ellu nigbin. shalach sivlonot merubbin sheyyachzeru immah levet balah, hare ellu nigbin. sivlonot muatin shettishtammesh bahen bevet aviha, enan nigbin: 
Shechiv mera shekkatav kol nechasav laacherim veshiyyer karka kol shehu, mattenato kayyemet. lo shiyyer karka kol shehu, en mattenato kayyemet. lo chatav bah shechiv mera, hu omer shechiv mera haya vehen omrim bari haya, tzarich lehavi reaya shehaya shechiv mera, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya: 
Hamechallek nechasav al piv, rabbi eliezer omer, echad bari veechad mesukkan, nechasim sheyyesh lahen acharayut niknin bechesef uvishtar uvachazaka, vesheen lahen acharayut en niknin ella vimshicha. amru lo, maase veimman shel bene rochel shehayta chola veamra tenu chevinati levitti vehi vishnem asar mane, vameta, vekiyyemu et devareha. amar lahen, bene rochel tekabberem imman. vachachamim omrim, beshabbat, devarav kayyamin, mippene sheeno yachol lichtov. aval lo vechol. rabbi yehoshua omer, beshabbat amru, kal vachomer bechol. kayyotze vo, zachin lakkatan, veen zachin laggadol. rabbi yehoshua omer, lakkatan amru, kal vachomer laggadol:
Mishnah Bava Batra 9:8-10:1:
Nafal habbayit alav veal aviv o alav veal morishav, vehayta alav ketubbat ishsha uvaal chov, yorshe haav omrim, habben met rishon veachar kach met haav, baale hachov omrim, haav met rishon veachar kach met habben, bet shammay omrim, yachaloku. uvet hillel omrim, nechasim bechezkatan: 
Nafal habbayit alav veal ishto, yorshe habbaal omrim, haishsha meta rishona veachar kach met habbaal, yorshe haishsha omrim, habbaal met rishon veachar kach meta haishsha, bet shammay omrim, yachaloku. uvet hillel omrim, nechasim bechezkatan, ketubba bechezkat yorshe habbaal, nechasim hannichnasim vehayyotzin immah bechezkat yorshe haav: 
Nafal habbayit alav veal immo, ellu vaellu modim sheyyachaloku. amar rabbi akiva, mode ani vaze shehannechasim bechezkatan. amar lo ven azzay, al hachalukin anu mitztaarin, ella shebbata lechallek alenu et hashshavin: 
Get pashut, edav mittocho. umekushshar, edav meachorav. pashut shekkatvu edav meachorav umekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho, shenehem pesulim. rabbi chanina ven gamliel omer, mekushshar shekkatvu edav mittocho, kasher, mippene sheyyachol laasoto fashut. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, hakkol keminhag hammedina:
Mishnah Oholot 14:6-15:2:
Yesh bahen poteach tefach veen benehen poteach tefach, tuma tachtehen, tachtehen tame. benehen o al gabbehen, kenegdo ad harakia tame: 
En bahen poteach tefach, ben sheyyesh benehen poteach tefach ben sheen benehen poteach tefach, tuma tachtehen, benehen o al gabbehen, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. vechen shete yeriot shehen gevohot min haaretz poteach tafach: 
Sagos ave vechofet ave, enan meviin et hattuma, ad sheyyehu gevohin min haaretz poteach tefach. kefulin zo al gabbe zo, enan meviot et hattuma, ad shettehe haelyona gevoha min haaretz poteach tefach. tavlayot shel etz zo al gav zo enan meviot et hattuma, ad shettehe haelyona gevoha min haaretz poteach tefach. veim hayu shel shayish, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet: 
Tavlayot shel etz shehen nogot zo vazo vekarnotehem vehen gevohot min haaretz poteach tefach, tuma tachat achat mehen, hannogea bashsheniyya, tame tumat shiva, kelim shettachat harishona temeim, veshettachat hashsheniyya tehorin. hashshulchan eno mevi et hattuma, ad sheyyehe vo ribbua befoteach tafach:
Mishnah Oholot 15:3-6:
Chaviyyot shehen yoshvot al shulehen o muttot al tziddehen, baavir, vehen nogot zo vazo befoteach tefach, tuma tachat achat mehen, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. bamme devarim amurim, bithorot. aval im hayu temeot o gevohot min haaretz poteach tefach, tuma tachat achat mehen, tachat kullam tame: 
Bayit shechatzatzo vinsarim o viriot, min hatztzedadim o min hakkorot, tuma vabbayit, kelim shebbachatzatz tehorim. tuma vachatzatz, kelim shebbabbayit temein. kelim shebbachatzatz, im yesh sham poteach tefach, temeim. veim lav, tehorim: 
Chatzatzo meartzo, tuma vachatzatz, kelim shebbabbayit temeim. tuma vabbayit, kelim shebbachatzatz, im yesh bimkoman tefach al tefach al rum tefach, tehorim. veim lav, temein, sheartzo shel bayit kamohu ad hattehom: 
Bayit shehu male teven veen beno leven hakkorot poteach tefach, tuma vifnim, kelim shekkeneged yetzia temeim. tuma vachutz, kelim shebbifnim, im yesh bimkomam tefach al tefach al rum tefach, tehorim. veim lav, temeim. im yesh ben teven lakkorot poteach tefach, ben kach uven kach temeim:
Mishnah Oholot 15:7-16:1:
Bayit shemmilo afar o tzerorot, uvittelo, vechen keri shel tevua, o gal shel tzerorot, afillu chegallo shel achan, vaafillu tuma vetzad hakkelim, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet: 
Chatzar hakkever, haomed betochah tahor, ad sheyhe vah arba ammot, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, arbaa tefachim. kora sheasaah golel lekever, ben omedet ben mutta al tziddah, en tame ella cheneged happetach. asa roshah golel lekever, en tame ella ad arbaa tefachim. uvizman shehu atid lagod, rabbi yehuda omer, kullah chibbur: 
Chavit shehi melea mashkim tehorim umukkefet tzamid patil, vaasaah golel lekever, hannogea bah, tame tumat shiva, vehechavit vehammashkin tehorin. behema sheasaah golel lekever, hannogea bah, tame tumat shiva. rabbi meir omer, kol sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim eno metamme mishshum golel: 
Hannogea bemet vehannogea bechelim, hammaahil al hammet vehannogea bechelim, temein. maahil al hammet umaahil al hakkelim, hanogea bemet umaahil al hakkelim, tehorim. im yesh beyado foteach tefach, temein. shene vattim uvahen kishne chatzae zetim, pashat et shete yadav lahen, im yesh beyadav poteach tefach, mevi et hattuma. veim lav, eno mevi et hattuma: 
Kol hammittaltelin meviin et hattuma koovi hammardea. amar rabbi tarfon, akappach et banay shezzo halacha mekuppachat, sheshshama hashshomea, vetaa, shehaikkar over vehammardea al ketefo, veheehil tziddo echad al hakkever, vetimmeuhu mishshum kelim hammaahilim al hammet. amar rabbi akiva, ani atakken sheyyehu divre chachamim kayyamin, sheyyehu chol hammittaltelin meviin et hattuma al adam hannosan boovi hammardea, veal atzman bechol shehen, veal shear adam vechelim befoteach tafach:
Mishnah Oholot 16:2-5:
Ketzad. kush shehu tachuv bakkotel, kachatzi zayit mittachtav vechachatzi zayit meal gabbav, af al pi sheenan mechuvvanin, tame. nimtza mevi et hattuma leatzmo bechol shehu. hakkaddar shehu over vehassal al ketefo veheehil tziddo achat al hakkever, hakkelim shebbatztzad hashsheni tehorin. im yesh bassal poteach tefach, temeim. hatteluliyyot hakkerovot ben lair ben ladderech, echad chadashot veechad yeshanot, temeot. harchokot, chadashot tehorot vishanot temeot. ezo hi kerova, chamishshim amma. vishana, shishshim shana, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, kerova, sheen kerova mimmenna. vishana, sheen adam zochrah: 
Hammotze met battechilla mushkav kedarko, notlo veet tevusato. matza shenayim, notlan veet tevusatan. matza shelosha, im yesh ben ze laze mearba ammot vead shemone kimlo mitta vekovreha, hare zo shechunat kevarot. bodek mimmennu ulehallan esrim amma. matza echad besof esrim amma, bodek mimmennu ulehallan esrim amma, sheraglayim laddavar. sheillu mittechilla metzao, notlo veet tevusato: 
Habbodek, bodek amma al amma umanniach amma, ad shehu maggia lesela o livtula. hamotzi et heafar mimmekom tuma, ochel bedimo. hamefakkeach baggal, eno ochel bedimo: 
Haya vodek, higgia lenachal o lishlulit, o lederech harabbim, mafsik. sade shennehergu vah harugim, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor. hamefanne kivro mittoch sadehu, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor. bor shemmattilim letocho nefalim o harugim, melakket etzem etzem vehakkol tahor. rabbi shimon omer, im hitkino lekever mittechilla, yesh lo tevusa:
Mishnah Oholot 17:1-4:
Hachoresh et hakkever, hare ze ose vet happeras. ad kamma hu ose. melo maana mea amma, bet arbaat seim. rabbi yose omer, bet chamesh, bemorad. uvemaale, noten rova karshinim al borech hammacharesha, ad mekom sheyyitzmechu shelosha charshinin zo vetzad zo, ad sham hu ose vet happeras. rabbi yose omer, bemorad velo vemaale: 
Haya choresh vehittiach besela o vegader o shennier hammacharesha, ad sham hu ose vet happeras. rabbi elazar omer, bet peras ose vet peras. rabbi yehoshua omer, peamim ose, peamim eno ose. ketzad. charash chatzi maana, vechazar vecharash chetzyah, vechen hatztzedadin, hare ze ose vet peras. charash melo maana, chazar vecharash mimmenna velachutz, eno ose vet peras: 
Hachoresh melatamya, mitztzevirat haatzamot, missade sheavad hakkever betochah, o shennimtza vah kever, hachoresh et sheeno shello, vechen nachri shecharash, eno ose otah bet peras, sheen bet peras lakkutiyyim: 
Sede vet happeras al gabbe tehora, shatfu geshamim mibbet peras lattehora, afillu adumma vehilbinuha o levana vehedimuha, en osin otah bet happeras:
Mishnah Oholot 17:5-18:3:
Sade sheavad kever betochah, uvana vah bayit vaaliyya al gabbav, im hayta fitchah shel aliyya mechuvvan keneged pitcho shel bayit, aliyya tehora. veim lav, aliyya temea. afar bet happeras vaafar chutza laaretz shebba veyarak, mitztarfin kechotam hammartzufim, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyihye vemakom echad kechotam hammartzufin. amar rabbi yehuda, maase shehayu iggerot baot mimmedinat hayyam livne chohanim gedolim, vehayu vahem kisa uchesatayim chotamot, velo chashu lahem chachamim mishshum tuma: 
Ketzad botzrim bet happeras. mazzim al haadam veal hakkelim, veshonim uvotzrim umotziim chutz levet happeras, vaacherim mekabbelim mehem umolichim laggat. im nagu ellu vaellu, temeim, kedivre vet hillel. bet shammay omrim, ochez et hammaggal besiv, o votzer betzor venoten letoch hakkefisha umolich laggat. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim, becherem hannaasa vet happeras. aval notea bet happeras, yimmacher lashshuk: 
Shelosha vet perasot hen, hachoresh et hakkever, nittaat kol neta, veenah nizraat kol zera, chutz mizzera hanniktzar. veim akaro, tzover et garno letocho vechovro vishte chevarot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hattevua bishte chevarot, vehakkitniyyot beshalosh kevarot. vesoref et hakkash veet heatza, umetamme vemagga uvemassa, veeno metamme veohel: 
Sade sheavad kever betochah, nizraat kol zera, veenah nittaat kol neta. veen mekayyemin bah ilanot, chutz meilan serak sheeno ose ferot. umetamme vemagga uvemassa uveohel:
Mishnah Shabbat 16:6-17:1:
Nachri shebba lechabbot, en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe, mippene sheen shevitato alehen, aval katan shebba lechabbot, en shomin lo, mippene sheshshevitato alehen: 
Kofin keara al gabbe hanner bishvil shello teechoz bakkora, veal tzoa shel katan, veal akrav shello tishshoch. amar rabbi yehuda, maase va lifne rabban yochanan ben zakkay baarav, veamar, choshshani lo mechattat: 
Nachri shehidlik et hanner, mishtammesh leoro yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael, asur. mille mayim lehashekot behemto, mashke acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael, asur. asa goy kevesh lered bo, yored acharav yisrael, veim bishvil yisrael, asur. maase verabban gamliel uzekenim shehayu vain bisfina, veasa goy kevesh lered bo, veyardu vo rabban gamliel uzekenim: 
Kol hakkelim nittalin beshabbat vedaltotehen immahen, af al pi shennitparku veshabbat. sheenan domin ledaltot habbayit, lefi sheenan min hammuchan:
Mishnah Shabbat 17:2-6:
Notel adam kurnas lefatztzea bo et haegozim, vekurdom lachtoch et haddevela. megera, ligror bah et haggevina. magrefa, ligrof bah et haggerogarot. et harachat veet hammazleg, latet alav lekatan. et hakkush veet hakkarkar, litchov bo. machat shel yad, littol bo et hakkotz, veshel sakkaim, liftoach bo et haddalet: 
Kane shel zetim, im yesh kesher berosho, mekabbel tuma, veim lav, en mekabbel tuma. ben kach uven kach, nittal beshabbat: 
Rabbi yose omer, kol hakkelim nittalin, chutz min hammassar haggadol veyated shel macharesha. kol hakkelim nittalin letzorech veshello letzorech. rabbi nechemya omer, en nittalin ella letzorech: 
Kol hakkelim hannittalin beshabbat, shivrehen nittalin immahen, uvilvad sheyyihyu osin meen melacha. shivre areva, lechassot bahen et pi hechavit. shivre zechuchit, lechassot bahen et pi happach. rabbi yehuda omer, uvilvad sheyyihyu osin meen melachtan. shivre areva, litztzok letochan mikpa. veshel zechuchit litztzok letochan shamen: 
Haeven shebbekeruya, im memallein bah veenah nofelet, memallein bah. veim lav, en memallein bah. zemora shehi keshura vetafiach, memallein bah beshabbat:
Mishnah Shabbat 17:7-18:2:
Pekak hachallon, rabbi eliezer omer, bizman shehu kashur vetaluy, pokkin bo, veim lav, en pokkin bo. vachachamim omrim, ben kach uven kach pokkin bo: 
Kol kissuye hakkelim sheyyesh lahem bet achiza nittalim beshabbat. amar rabbi yose, bamme devarim amurim. bechissuy karka, aval bechissuy hakkelim, ben kach uven kach nittalim beshabbat: 
Mefannin afillu arba vechamesh kuppot shel teven veshel tevua mippene haorchim umippene vittul bet hammidrash, aval lo et haotzar. mefannin teruma tehora, udemay, umaaser rishon shennittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, vehatturmos hayyavesh, mippene shehu maachol laaniyyim. aval lo et hattevel, velo maaser rishon shello nittela terumato, velo et maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, velo et halluf, velo hachardal. rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir beluf, mippene shehu maachal orvin: 
Chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradim, im hitkinan lemaachal behema, metaltelin otan. veim lav, en metaltelin otan. kofin et hassal lifne haefrochim, kede sheyyaalu veyerdu. tarnegolet shebbarcha, dochin otah ad shettikkanes. medaddin agalin useyachin birshut harabbim. ishsha medadda et benah. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehu notel achat umeniach achat, aval im haya gorer, asur:
Mishnah Shabbat 18:3-19:3:
En meyalledin et habbehema veyom tov, aval mesaadin. umeyalledin et haishsha beshabbat, vekorin lah chachama mimmakom lemakom, umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat, vekoshrin et hattabbur. rabbi yose omer, af chotchin. vechol tzarche mila osin beshabbat: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, im lo hevi cheli meerev shabbat, mevio veshabbat megulle. uvassakkana, mechassehu al pi edim. veod amar rabbi eliezer, kortin etzim laasot pechamin velaasot keli varzel. kelal amar rabbi akiva, kol melacha sheefshar laasotah meerev shabbat enah docha et hashshabbat, veshei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat docha et hashshabbat: 
Osin kol tzarche mila veshabbat, mohalin, uforin, umotztzin, venotnin aleha ispelanit vechammon. im lo shachak meerev shabbat, loes beshinnav venoten. im lo taraf yayin veshemen meerev shabbat, yinnaten ze veatzmo veze veatzmo. veen osin lah chaluk lechattechilla, aval korech aleha semartut. im lo hitkin meerev shabbat, korech al etzbao umevi, vaafillu mechatzer acheret: 
Marchitzin et hakkatan, ben lifne hammila uven leachar hammila, umezallefin alav bayyad, aval lo vichli. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, marchitzin et hakkatan bayyom hashshelishi shechal lihyot beshabbat, shenneemar (Bereshit led) vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim. safek veanderoginos en mechallelin alav et hashshabbat, verabbi yehuda mattir beanderoginos:
Mishnah Shabbat 19:4-20:1:
Mi shehayu lo shete tinokot, echad lamul achar hashshabbat veechad lamul beshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat beshabbat, chayyav. echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul beshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat beshabbat, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat, verabbi yehoshua poter: 
Katan nimmol lishmona, letisha, velaasara, uleachad asar, velishnem asar, lo fachot velo yoter. ha ketzad. kedarko, lishmona. nolad leven hashshemashot, nimmol letisha. ben hashshemashot shel erev shabbat, nimmol laasara. yom tov leachar hashshabbat, nimmol leachad asar. shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, nimmol lishnem asar. katan hachole, en mohalin oto ad sheyyavri: 
Ellu hen tzitzin hameakkevin et hammila, basar hachofe et rov haatara. veeno ochel batteruma. veim haya vaal basar, metakkeno mippene marit haayin. mal velo fara et hammila, keillu lo mal: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, tolin et hameshammeret beyom tov, venotnin latteluya veshabbat. vachachamim omrim, en tolin et hameshammeret beyom tov, veen notnin latteluya veshabbat, aval notnin latteluya veyom tov:
Mishnah Shabbat 20:2-21:1:
Notnin mayim al gabbe hashshemarim bishvil sheyyitztzallu, umesannenin et hayyayin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit, venotnin betza vimsannenet shel chardal, veosin enumelin beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, beshabbat, bechos, beyom tov, belagin, uvammoed, bechavit. rabbi tzadok omer, hakkol lefi haorchin: 
En shorin et hachiltit befoshrin, aval noten letoch hachometz. veen shorin et hakkarshinin velo shafin otan, aval noten letoch hakkevara o letoch hakkalkalla. en kovrin et hatteven bichvara, velo yittenennu al gabbe makom gavoah bishvil sheyyered hammotz, aval notel hu vichvara venoten letoch haevus: 
Gorfin millifne happetam, umesallekin litzdadin mippene hari, divre rabbi dosa. vachachamim osrin. notlin millifne vehema zo venotnin lifne vehema zo beshabbat: 
Hakkash sheal gabbe hammitta, lo yenaneo veyado, ella menaneo vegufo. veim haya maachal behema, o shehaya alav kar o sadin, menaneo veyado. machbesh shel baale vattim, mattirin, aval lo chovshin. veshel kovsin, lo yigga bo. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya muttar meerev shabbat, mattir et kullo veshomto: 
Notel adam et beno vehaeven beyado, vechalkalla vehaeven betochah. umetaltelin teruma temea im hattehora veim hachullin. rabbi yehuda omer, af maalin et hamedumma beechad umea:
Mishneh Torah, Forbidden Intercourse 22::
En dorshin besitre arayot bishlosha mippene shehaechad tarud bishelat harav vehashshenayim nosin venotnin ze im ze veen datam penuya lishmoa. sheddato shel adam kerova etzel arayot. im nistappek lo davar sheshshama more lehakel. lefichach en dorshin ella lishnayim kede sheyyihye haechad hashshomea mefanne dato veyodea ma sheyyishma min harav: 
En lecha davar bechol hattora kullah shehu kashe lerov haam lifrosh ella min haarayot vehabbiot haasurot. amru chachamim beshaa shennitztauu yisrael al haarayot bachu vekibbelu mitzva zo betaromot uvechiyya shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 11 10)</small> "boche lemishpechotav" al iske mishpachot:

Veamru chachamim gezel vaarayot nafsho shel adam mitavva lahen umechammedatan. veen atta motze kahal bechol zeman uzeman sheen bahen perutzin baarayot uviot asurot. [veod] amru chachamim rov begezel miut baarayot vehakkol baavak lashon hara: 
Lefichach rauy lo leadam lachof yitzro bedavar ze ulehargil atzmo bikdushsha yetera uvemachashava tehora uvedea nechona kede lehinnatzel mehen. veyizzaher min hayyichud shehu haggorem haggadol. gedole hachachamim hayu omrim letalmidehem hizzaharu bi mippene bitti hizzaharu bi mippene kallati. kede lelammed letalmidehem shello yitbayyeshu middavar ze veyitrachaku min hayyichud: 
Vechen yinhog lehitrachek min hassechok umin hashshichrut umiddivre agavim sheellu gormin gedolim vehem maalot shel arayot. velo yeshev belo ishsha shemminhag ze gorem letohora yetera. gedola mikkol zot amru yafne atzmo umachashavto ledivre tora veyarchiv dato bachachma sheen machshevet arayot mitgabberet ella belev panuy min hachachma. uvachachma hu omer <small>(Mishlei 5 19)</small> "ayyelet ahavim veyaalat chen daddeha yeravvecha vechol et beahavatah tishge tamid":
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 12:1-5: Keshennose adam ishsha ben betula ben beula ben gedola ben ketanna achat bat yisrael veachat haggiyyoret o hameshuchreret yitchayyev lah baasara devarim veyizke bearbaa devarim:

Vehaasara shelosha mehen min hattora veellu hen. <small>(Shemot 21 10)</small> "sheerah. kesutah. veonatah". sheerah ellu mezonoteha. kesutah kemashmao. onatah lavo aleha kederech kol haaretz. vehashshiva middivre sofrim vechullan tenay bet din hem. haechad mehem ikkar ketubba. vehashshear hem hannikrain tenae ketubba veellu hen. lerappotah im chalta. velifdotah im nishbet. lekavrah im meta. velihyot nizzonet min nechasav. veyoshevet beveto achar moto kol zeman almenutah. velihyot benoteha mimmennu nizzonot minnechasav achare moto ad shettitaresna. velihyot baneha hazzecharim mimmennu yorshin ketubbatah yoter al chelkam bayrushsha sheim achehem:

Vehaarbaa shezzocha bahen kullam middivre sofrim veellu hen. lihyot maase yadeha shello. velihyot metziatah shello. vesheyyihye ochel kol perot nechaseha bechayyeha. veim meta bechayyav yirashenna. vehu kodem lechol adam bayrushsha:

Veod tikkenu chachamim sheyyihyu maase yede haishsha keneged mezonoteha. ufidyonah keneged achilat perot nechaseha. ukevuratah keneged yerushshato lichtubbatah. lefichach im amra haishsha eni nizzonit veeni osa shomin lah veen kofin otah. aval im amar habbaal eni zanech veeni notel kelum mimmaase yadayich en shomin lo shemma lo yesappeku lah maase yadeha bimzonoteha. umippene takkana zo yechashvu hammezonot mittenae hakketubba:

Kol haddevarim haellu af al pi shello nichtevu bishtar hakketubba vaafillu lo katvu ketubba ella nasa setam kevan shennesaah zacha bearbaa devarim shello vezachta haishsha baasara devarim shellah veenan tzerichin lefaresh:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 12:10-13: Kamma mezonot poskin laishsha. poskin lah lechem shete seuddot bechol yom seudda benonit shel kol adam beotah hair keadam sheeno lo chole velo gargeran umeoto maachol shel anshe otah hair. im chittim chittim veim seorim seorim. vechen orez vedochan o mishshear minin shennahagu bahen. ufoskin lah parperet leechol bah et happat kegon kitnit o yerakot vechayyotze bahen. veshemen laachila veshemen lehadelakat hanner uferot umeat yayin lishtot im haya minhag hammakom sheyyishtu hannashim yayin. ufoskin lah shalosh seuddot beshabbat uvasar o dagim keminhag hammakom. venoten lah bechol shabbat veshabbat maa kesef litzracheha kegon peruta lechibbus o lemerchatz vechayyotze bahen:

Bamme devarim amurim beani shebbeyisrael aval im haya ashir hakkol lefi ashro. afillu haya mamono rauy laasot lah kamma tavshile basar bechol yom kofin oto ufoskin lah mezonot kefi mamono. veim haya ani beyoter veeno yachol litten lah afillu lechem shehi tzericha lo kofin oto lehotzi vetihye ketubbatah chov alav ad shettimtza yado veyitten:
Baal sheratza litten leishto mezonoteha haruyot lah vetihye ochelet veshota leatzmah vehu shote veochel leatzmo harshut beyado uvilvad sheyyochal immah millele shabbat lelele shabbat:

Haishsha sheppasku lah mezonot vehotiru hammotar labbaal. haya balah kohen eno noten lah kol mezonoteha teruma mippene shettorach gadol hu lah leshamran middevarim hametammein uleachlan betohora ella noten lah mechetza chullin umechetza teruma:
Mishneh Torah, Marriage 12:6-9: Hitna habbaal shello yitchayyev beechad min haddevarim shehu chayyav bahen. o shehitnat haishsha shello yizke habbaal beechad min haddevarim shehu zoche bahem hattenay kayyam chutz mishshelosha devarim sheen hattenay moil bahen. vechol hammatne alehen tenao batel. veellu hen. onatah. veikkar ketubbatah. virushshatah:
Ketzad. hitna im haishsha sheen lah alav ona tenao batel vechayyav beonatah. shehare hitna al ma shekkatuv battora veeno tenay mamon:

Hitna immah lifchot meikkar ketubba o shekkatav lah matayim o mea ikkar ketubba vechatva lo shennitkabbela mehen kach vechach vehi lo nitkabbela tenao batel shekkol happochet livtula mimmatayim ulealmana mimmea hare beilato beilat zenut:

Hitna immah achar shennesaah shello yirashenna tenao batel veaf al pi sheyyerushshat habbaal middivre sofrim asu chizzuk ledivrehem keshel tora. vechol tenay shebbayrushsha batel veaf al pi shehu mamon shenneemar bah <small>(Bamidbar 27 11)</small> "lechukkat mishpat". uvishar haddevarim tenao kayyam, kegon shehitna immah sheen lah sheer uchesut, al menat shello yochal perot nechaseha, vechol kayyotze baze, tenao kayyam:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8:4-6:
Kol zera shekketzirato matzmachat oto umegaddalto kegon aspasta vesilka. hakkotzro bishgaga chayyav shete chattaot. achat mippene shehu kotzer veachat mippene shehu notea. vechen hazzomer vehu tzarich laetzim chayyav mishshum kotzer umishshum notea. gavshushit shel afar shealu bah asavim, higbihah meal haaretz vehinnichah al gabbe yetedot chayyav mishshum tolesh. hayta al gabbe yetedot vehinnichah al haaretz chayyav mishshum zorea. teenim sheyyavshu beibbehen vechen ilan sheyyavshu perotav bo. hattolesh mehen beshabbat chayyav af al pi shehen kaakurin leinyan tuma: 
Hattolesh ulshin hamezared zeradin. im laachila shiuro kigrogeret. veim livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi. veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza. hameammer ochalin im laachila shiuro kigrogeret. veim immer livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi. veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza. uvetza haamura bechol makom hi betza benonit shel tarnegolin. vechol makom shenneemar kede levashshel betza hu kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza ugerogeret echad mishshelosha bevetza. veen immur ella begiddule karka: 
Hamekabbetz devela veasa mimmenna iggula o shennikkev teenim vehichnis hachevel bahen ad shennitkabbetzu guf echad. hare ze toledet meammer vechayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Niddah 20b:5-6: Ulla ikkela lefumebdita, ayyto lekammeh dema vela chaza. amar: uma rabbi elazar demara deara deyisrael hava, ki mikkela leatra derabbi yehuda — la chaze dema, ana echze?!

Veammay karu leh "mara deara deyisrael"? dehahi itteta (daayytaa) [deayytay] dema lekammeh derabbi elazar, hava yatev rabbi amme kammeh. archeh, amar la: hay dam chimmud hu. batar denafka, ittefal la rabbi amme. amara leh: baali haya badderech vachamadtiv. kare aleh: "sod Adonai lireav".

Chacham beni vesammach libbi veashiva chorfi davar
Zohar, Kedoshim 1: (Vayikra 19:1-2) vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor. dabber el kol adat bene yisrael veamarta alehem kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem. ribbi elazar patach, (Tehillim 32:9) al tihyu kesus kefered en havin vegomer. bechamma zimnin orayyta ashidat behu bivne nasha, kama zimnin arimat kalin, lechol sitrin leitteara lehu, vechullehu demichin beshenata bechovehon (sefer acher bechorehon), la mistakkelin, vela mashgichin, behech anpin yekumun leyoma dedina illaa, kad yitba lon malka illaa elbona deorayyta, ditzvavchat lokovlehon, vela ahadru anpin lokovlah, dechullehu pegimin becholla, dela yadu mehemnuta demalka illaa, vavy lon, vavy lenafshehon.

Deha orayyta beh ashidat, veamrat (Mishlei 9:4) mi feti yasur henna chasar lev (sefer acher veamra) amra lo. mahu chasar lev. delet leh mehemnuta, deman dela ishtaddal beorayyta, lav beh mehemnuta, ufagim hu mikkolla (sefer acher veamra) amra lo, omra lo mibbae leh, kema deat amer (Tehillim 42:10) omra leel sali, mahu amra. ella leachlela uleittosfa orayyta dilella, dehi karyay leh chasar lev, pagim mimmehemnuta.

Dehachi tanenan, kol man dela ishtaddal beorayyta, asir lemikrav legabbeh, leishtattefa bahaddeh, ulemebad beh sechorta, vekol shekken lemehach immeh beorcha. deha let beh mehemnuta. (veal da) tanenan kol bar nash deazil beorcha, velet immeh mille deorayyta, itchayyayv benafsheh. kol shekken man deizdavvavg beorcha, im man delet beh mehemnuta, dela chashiv likara demareh vedideh dela chas al nafsheh.

Ribbi yehuda omer, man dela chas al nafsheh, hech yishlof nafsha dechashra livreh. amar ribbi elazar, tavvavhna al dara, veha ittemar milla vechulei. veal da ketiv al tihyu kesus kefered en havin. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, veyadin orchoy dekudesha berich hu, umekaddeshe garmayyhu bikdusha demalka, veishtechachu kaddishin becholla, uvegin kach meshallefe rucha dekudesha milleella, uvenayyhu kullehu zakkae keshot, veikrun bene malka benin kaddishin. (zakkain inun evarim vechulei ad lemeheve beniddatah, maheraaya mehemana nidpas befarashat pinchas maamar matchil ella pegia 225 amud bet).

Vavy lehon lerashiayyay, dechullehu chatzifin, veovadayyhu chatzifin. begine kach yartin benayyhu nafsha chatzifa, missitra dimsaava. kema dichtiv venitmetem bam, ata leistaava, mesaavin leh. al tihyu kesus kefered, deinnun mare zenuta (sefer acher dimsaavuta) al kolla. en havin, dela yishtaddelun bene nasha bearcha da, dei hache, ketiv hacha en havin, uchetiv hatam (Yeshayahu 56:11) vehakkelavim azze nefesh lo yadu sava vehema roim lo yadu havin. kelomar yehon mizdammenin innun deikrun azze nefesh. may taama. mishshum dela yadu havin.

Vehema roim, may roim, illen innun madbere umanhige lebar nash bagehinnam. lo yadu sava, kema deat amer (Mishlei 30:15) laaluka shete vanot hav hav, begin kach deinnun hav hav, la yadu sava. kullam ledarkam panu ish levitzo mikkatzehu. deha tayyayre degehinnam innun. vechol da man garim lehu. begin dela itkaddashu behahu ziuuga kema deitzterich. veal da ketiv, kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. amar kudesha berich hu, mikkol shear ammin la rayati leadbeka bi, ella yisrael, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai, attun, vela shear ammin. (veal da ketiv hacha kadosh) begin kach, (kedoshim tihyu dayyka).
Zohar, Kedoshim 15: Ribbi chiyyay patach veamar kera avatreh, (Vayikra 19:14) lo tekallel cheresh velifne ivvir vegomer, hay kera kemashmao. aval parsheta da, kolla olifna minnah millin ochoranin, vechullehu talyayn da beda. ta chaze, man delayit lechavreh, veihu kammeh, veachsif leh, keillu oshid dameh, veha okimna. vehay kera, delav chavreh immeh, vehu layit leh, hahi milla salleka.

Delet lach milla umilla denafik mippumeh, dela it leh kala, hahu kala salik leella, vechamma kasterin mitchabberan immeh dehahu kala, ad desalleka veittear atar dithoma rabba, kema deukemuha vechamma mitarin aleh dehahu bar nash. vavy leman deappik milla bisha mippumeh, veha ukemuha.

Velifne ivvir lo titten michshol, kemashmao. veukemuha, beman degarim leochora lemechete. vechen man demache livreh rabba. velifne ivvir lo titten vegomer, beman dela mata lehoraa veore, (kema deat amar) dichtiv, (Mishlei 7:26) ki rabbim chalalim hippila vaatzumim kol harugeha. vehay abar, mishshum velifne ivvir lo titten michshol, begin deachshil leh lechavreh lealma deate.

Detanenan man deazil beorach meshar beorayyta, uman deishtedal beorayyta kedka yaut, it leh chulaka tava tadir lealma deate. dehahi milla deorayyta deappik mippumeh, azla veshaata bealma, vesalleka leella. vechamma illain kaddishin mitchabberan behahi milla, vesalleka beorach meshar, veitattar beitra kaddisha, veistache benahara dealma deate, denagid venafik meeden, veitkabbal beh, veishteav begavih, veitannag (sefer acher vaatanetaa) socharaneh dehahu nahara, ilana illaa. ucheden nagid venafik nehora illaa veitattar beh behahu bar nash kol yoma, kema deittemar. (yitro 57 amud alef).

Uman delae (nusach acher deyalef) beorayyta, vela ishtaddal bah beorach keshot, uveorach meshar. hahu milla salleka, vesate orchin, velet man deyitchabbar bah, vecholla dachyyayn lah levar, veazil veshat bealma vela yishkach atar. man garim leh hay. hahu desate leh meorach meshar, hada hu dichtiv velifne ivvir lo titten michshol. uvegine kach ketiv, veyareta meelohecha ani Adonai.

Uman detiuvete lemile beorayyta, vela ashkach man deyolif leh, vehu birchimuta deorayyta, lae bah, umegamgem bah, begimguma dela yada. kol milla umilla salleka, vekudesha berich hu chadde behahi milla, vekabbil lah, venata lah sacharaneh dehahu nachala, veitavidu meillen millin ilanin ravrevin, veikrun arve nachal, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:19) beahavatah tishge tamid.

Vedavid malka amar, (Tehillim 86:11) horeni Adonai darkecha ahalech baamittecha. uchetiv (Tehillim 27:11) unecheni beorach mishor lemaan shorray. zakkain innun deyadin orchoy deorayyta, umishtaddele bah beorach meshar, deinnun natin ilanin dechayyin leella, dechullehu asuvta. uvegin kach ketiv, (Malachi 2:6) torat emet hayta befihu. vechi it tora delav ihi emet. in kegavvna deamaran, deore man dela yada, velav ihu keshot vehahu deolif milla mineh, olif milla delav ihu emet. uvegine kach ketiv, torat emet hayta befihu.

Veim kol da, mibbae leh levar nash lemelaf mille deorayyta mikkol bar nash, afillu mimman dela yada. begin deal da yittear beorayyta, veyete lemelaf mimman deyada, ulevatar ishtechach, deazil bah beorayyta beorach keshot. ta chaze, yishtedal bar nash bealma beorayyta ufikkudoy, afillu dela avid lishmah, demittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah.
Zohar, Kedoshim 3: Ribbi yose hava azil beorcha, paga beh ribbi chiyyay, amar leh hay deukemuha chavrayyay, dichtiv beeli, (Shmuel 1 3:14) velachen nishbati levet eli im yitkapper avon bet eli bezevach umincha ad olam. bezevach umincha eno mitkapper, aval mitkapper hu bedivre tora. amay. begin dedivre tora, sallekin al kol karbenin dealma. kema deukemuha dichtiv, (Vayikra 7:37) zot hattora laola lammincha velachattat velaasham velammilluim, shakil orayyta lokovel kol karbenin dealma. amar leh, hachi hu vadday, dechol man deishtedal beorayyta, af al gav deitgezar aleh onsha milella, nicha leh mikkol karbenin veillavavn, vehahu onsha itkera. (uvegin delae bah lishmah, kudesha berich hu itpayyays bahadeh)

Veta chaze, la itdache bar nash lealmin, ella bemillin deorayyta. begine kach millin deorayyta la mekabbelin tumea, begin deihi (Mishlei 3) kayyeyma ledakkea leillen misave, veasuvta beorayyta ishtechach. dichtiv, rifut tehi lesharecha veshikkuy leatzmotecha. vedachyuta ishtechach beorayyta, dichtiv, (Tehillim 19:10) yirat Adonai tehora omedet laad. may omedet laad. dekayyeyma tedira behahu dachyuta, vela itade minneh lealmin.

Amar leh yirat Adonai ketiv, vela tora. amar leh, hachi hu vadday, deha orayyta missitra digvura ka atyay. amar leh, umehatam nafka, mehacha nafka, dichtiv, (Tehillim 111:10) reshit chachma yirat Adonai, uchetiv yirat Adonai tehora.

Veorayyta kedushsha itkere, dichtiv ki kadosh ani Adonai, veda orayyta, dehi shema kaddisha illaa. veal da, man deishtedal bah itdache, ulevatar itkaddash, dichtiv kedoshim tihyu, kedoshim heyu la ketiv, ella tihyu. tihyu vadday. amar leh hachi hu, umikra ketiv, (Shemot 19:6) veattem tihyu li mamlechet kohanim vegoy kadosh, uchetiv elle haddevarim vegomer.

Tana, kedushsha deorayyta, kedushsha dislikat al kol kiddushin. ukedushsha dechachmeta illaa setima, salleka al kolla. amar leh lav orayyta bela chachmeta, velav chachmeta bela orayyta, vecholla bechad darga hu, vecholla chad, ella orayyta bechachma illaa ishtechachat, uva kayyeyma, uva itnetau sharshaha mikkol sitrin.

Ad dahavo azle, ashkachu chad bar nash, bilkinta dekuseta, (sefer acher balekaytanea dakeysechaa) rachiv al suseya, ashmit yedoy lechad anpa deilana. amar ribbi yose, hay hu dichtiv vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim. adam mekaddesh atzmo millematta, mekaddeshin oto millemala. hada hu dichtiv, kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai.

Tane ribbi abba, parsheta da kelala deorayyta hi, vechotama dekusheta degushepanka hi. befarsheta da itchaddashu razin illain deorayyta, beeser amiran, vegizrin veonashin, ufikkudin illain, dechad matan chavrayyay lefarsheta da, havo chaddan.

Amar ribbi abba, may tama parsheta daarayot, ufarsheta dikdoshim tihyu, semuchin da leda. ella hachi tana, kol man deistamar meillen eryayn, bikdushsha itavid vadday. vekol shekken i itkaddash bikdushsha demareh. veha attearu chavrayyay.

Ematay onatan decholla, leitkaddash bar nash. ta chaze, man devae leitkaddesha biruta demareh, la lishammesh ella mippalgut lelya veelach, o befalgut lelya. deha behahi shaata, kudesha berich hu ishtechach beginta deeden, ukedushsha illaa ittear, ucheden shaata hi leitkaddesha. hay lishar bene nasha, talmide chachamim deyadin orchoy deorayyta, befalgut lelya shaata dilhon lemekam lemile beorayyta, leizdavvevga bikkeneset yisrael, leshabbecha lishma kaddisha, lemalka kaddisha.

Belelya deshabbeta, diruta decholla ishtechach, ziuuga dilhon behahi shaata. leappaka reuta dekudesha berich hu ukkeneset yisrael, kema deittemar dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. veillen ikrun kaddishin, dichtiv kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv (Tehillim 1:3) vehaya keetz shatul al palge mayim asher piryo yitten beitto vegomer.

Kedoshim tihyu, ribbi abba patach, (Shmuel b 7:23) umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz, ta chaze, bechol ammin dealma, la itree behu kudesha berich hu, bar beyisrael bilchodayyhu, veavid lon amma yechidaa bealma, vekara lon goy echad kishmeh. veattar lon bechamma itrin, vechamma pikudin, leitattera behu. veal da tefilin deresha utefillin didroa, leitattera behu bar nash kegavvna dilella. uleishtakkecha chad shelim becholla.

Uvehahi shaata deitattar behu bar nash, veitkaddash behu, itavid shelim, veikre echad, deechad la ikre ella kad ihu shelim. uman defagim, la ikre echad. veal da kudesha berich hu ikre echad, bishlimu dechola, bishlimu daavahan, bishlimu dichneset yisrael. begin kach yisrael letatta ikrun echad. dechad bar nash anach tefilin, veitchappe bechissuyay demitzva, keden itattar beitrin kaddishin kegavvna delella, veikre echad.

Uvegine kach, lete echad, veyishtedal beechad. kudesha berich hu deihu echad, yishtedal beechad. deha let malka mishtaddal, ella bemay deitchaze leh. uvegin kach ketiv, (iyyov 23:13) vehu veechad umi yeshivennu, la share kudesha berich hu vela ishtechach ella beechad. beechad, echad mibbae leh ella beman deittekan bikdushsha illaa lemehevi chad. keden hu sharya beechad, vela baatar ochora.

Veematay ikre bar nash echad. beshaata deishtechach dechar venukeba, veitkaddash bikdushsha (sefer acher beitrin) illaa, veitkevavn leitkaddesha. veta chaze, bezimna deishtechach bar nash beziuuga chad dechar venukeba, veitkavivn leitkaddesha kedka yeot. keden hu shelim, veikre echad bela pegimu.

Begine kach, bae bar nash lemechde leitteteh behahi shaata, lezammena lah biruta chada immeh. veyitkavvevnun tarvavyyhu kechad lehahi milla. vechad mishtakkeche tarvavyyhu kechad, keden kolla chad benafsha uvegufa. benafsha: leadbeka da beda biruta chada. uvegufa: kema deolifna devar nash dela nasiv, hu keman deitpelig, vechad mitchabberan dechar venukeba, keden itavidu chad gufa. ishtechach deinhu chad nafsha, vechad gufa, veikre bar nash echad. keden kudesha berich hu share beechad, veafkid rucha dikdushsha behahu echad.

Veillen ikrun benin dekudesha berich hu, kema deittemar. uvegine kach kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. zakkain innun yisrael dela okim milla da baatar ochora, ella beh mammash, dichtiv ki kadosh ani Adonai. begin leitdabbeka beh, vela beochora. veal da kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem.
Zohar, Kedoshim 4:26-48: (Vayikra 19:3) ish immo veaviv tirau vegomer. ha tanenan, defarsheta da kelala deorayyta. makkish dechilu deabba veima leshabbetotay. ella amar ribbi yose, kolla chad, man dedachil mehay, natir lehay.

Ish immo, akdim immo leaviv bidchilu may tama. kema deukemuha. aval imma delet reshu bidaha kol kach keaviv (sefer acher aval ta chaze immo da keneset yisrael uvegin dibba sharya yire veihi yirat Adonai itkere) akdim dechilu dilah.
Ribbi yitzchak amar, ma ketiv leella, kedoshim tihyu. ate bar nash leitkaddesha beitteteh kechad. mimman hu shevacha yattir behahi kedushsha. havi emma minukeba. begin kach ish immo veaviv tirau.

Ribbi yehuda amar, ish immo veaviv tirau, kehay gavvna, (Bereshit 2:4) beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim. uvaatar ochora, akdim shamayim laaretz. ella leachazaa detarvavyyhu kachada itavidu. uf hacha akdim imma leabba, uvaatar ochora akdim abba leimma, leachazaa detarvavyyhu kachada ishtadalu beh.

Veet shabbetotay tishmoru, shakil da leda, vecholla kachada ittekalu bematkela chad. dichtiv, (Shemot 31:14) ushemartem et hashabbat ki kodesh hi lachem, uchetiv (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. ella chad leabba, vechad leimma. ketiv hacha ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru. uchetiv hatam (Vayikra 26:2) et shabbetotay tishmoru umikdashi tirau. mahu mikdashi. kemashmao. tu mikdashi illen innun dimkaddeshe garmayyhu behahi shaata. kegavvna da, (yechezkel 9:6) umimmikdashi tachellu. al tikre mimmikdashi, ella mimmekuddashay. ma lehallan mimmekuddashay, af kan mimmekuddashay, deinnun abba veimma.

(Vayikra 19:3) ish immo veaviv tirau. rabbi shimon amar, ketiv (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai vegomer. zakkain innun yisrael, demitdabbekan beh bekudesha berich hu, (inun velo umin ovde kochavim umazzalot) uvegin deinnun mitdabbekan beh bekudesha berich hu, kolla itdevaku kachada da beda.

Ta chaze, beshaata debar nash mekaddesh letatta, kegon chavrayyay dimkaddeshe garmayyhu mishshabbat leshabbat, beshaata deziuuga illaa ishtechach, deha behahi shaata raava ishtechach, uvirchata izdammenat. keden mitdabbekan kullehu kechad, nafsha deshabbat, vegufa deizdeman beshabbat. veal da ketiv, ish immo veaviv tirau, deinnun ziuuga chad begufa, behahi shaata (leitkaddesha) deitkaddesha. veet shabbetotay tishmoru. da shabbat illaa veshabbat tattaa, deinnun mezammene lenafsha behahu gufa, mehahu ziuuga illaa. veal da veet shabbetotay tishmoru, tere vecholla itdevak da beda, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Davar acher veet shabbetotay tishmoru, leazhara leinnun dimchakkan leziuugayyhu mishshabbat leshabbat, veha okimna, kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay dimsarsan garmayyhu kol shear yomin, begin lemile beorayyta. veinnun mechakkan mishshabbat leshabbat. hada hu dichtiv asher yishmeru et shabbetotay, kema deat amer (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar. uvegin kach veet shabbetotay tishmoru. ish immo veaviv tirau, da gufa. veet shabbetotay tishmoru, da nafsha. vecholla itdevak da beda. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Raya mehemna ish immo veaviv tirau veet shabbetotay tishmoru. pikkuda da, shakil da leda. shakil yekara deav veem, likara deshabbat. leabba akdim kavod, vehay ihu deamar kera, (Malachi 1:6) veim av ani ayye chevodi veim adonim ani ayyi morai. kevodi salik bechusheban eser amiran, 38 elohim deovada divreshit.

Uvechol atar (Mishlei 3:35) kavod chachamim yinchalu, veukemuha rabbanan, en kavod ella tora. begin deinnun lev elohim detora, yekara dileh. veillen (inun) chachamim deorayyta, chachamim bechachma, yartin hay kavod vela tippeshe, dealayyhu ittemar, (Mishlei 3:35) uchesilim merim kalon. umenalan deman dela yada beorayyta ikre kesil, dichtiv, (Tehillim 92:7) uchesil lo yavin et zot. veen zot, ella tora, dichtiv, (Devarim 4:44) vezot hattora asher sam moshe.

Raya mehemana. begin dachalishata, patachna lefarsheta beillen pikudin, lemehevi meat ezer lach. ittakkaf bach, deha mashshiryayn dimtivtan atan legabbach, befikkuda batar da, deihu pikkuda lehaamid alecha melech leella. vekudesha berich hu yokim lach melech beillain vetattain bediukeneh. begin derabbanan dimtivta, alayyhu shechinta illaa vetattaa. vekudesha berich hu melech beemtztzaita, achid beillain vetattain hachi ant tehe bediukeneh, bera dileh, kum bikara demalka.

Kam raya mehemana, vesalik yedoy leella, veamar, yehe raava dilach illat haillot, deant mitalle meilluy leilluy, ad delet illuy. ella deant leella mikkol illuy. lemehav li chela, lemebad reutach bedargin dilach, deinnun abba veimma, vaana bera dilhon. uveyichudach tarvavyyhu echad. veant shaklat dechilu deabba veima, lidchilu dilach, batar deant beemtztzaita chad, vela teren, bela shuttafu, af al gav deinnun chad beshuttafu dilach, aval annet chad bela shuttafu detinyayna. uvegin da ittemar bach, (Devarim 32:39) veen elohim immadi.

Hav li chela, leitteara bikarach bekadmita. ulevatar bikara deavi veimi devishmayya, deukemuha alayyhu, (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo veomer en pasha chaver hu leish mashchit. veukemuha mare matnitin, en aviv, ella kudesha berich hu. veen immo, ella keneset yisrael. vikara dilach abba chachma, dechalil eser sefirot mittatta dileh leella, vetarvavyyhu innun kuresyay safsal techotach likarach.

Vehachi takkinu, lemehevi katan laggadol mechabbed dilella minneh. abba, ihu chachma, halo av echad lechullanu, lemehevi meshamesh techotach, veant keter elyon al resheh. velet keter alach, velet elaha ochora. veimma, leshammesha leabba. deihu techoteh lemehevi kisse techoteh.

Vayyomer ihu, bechol maamar, ad telatin uteren, yehi ken, vayhi chen. veihi, avidat maamareh miyyad. uvegin deavidat maamareh vetztziuuye bela ikkuva kelal, 34 shevilin divhon itbere kol divreshit, ovada itkeriat kavod, (Tehillim 29:9) uvehechalo kullo omer kavod. (yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. ayyi mekom kevodo lehaaritztzo.

Vetargum kevod aviv, yekara daavuhi. veda (tehillim 19) torat Adonai temima, alah ittemar (Mishlei 3) yekara hi veyisrael mippeninim. deitkeriu banim, bichlal ben uvat, missitra detiferet umalchut. deinnun ben uvat, yekara deaviv veimmo, lemebad tziuuyeh, vetztzivuy dileh, innun pikudin daase. veha ukemuha mare matnitin, yesh metztzuvve veose. uvegin kach ihu naase venishma. vehay ihu kavod deabba veima, ditztzavve livreh deyebad hache veihu avid miyyad, bela ikkuva kelal.

Veillat al kolla, ana bae leishtaddela bikarach, letakken middot deabba veimma, likarach. tehe beezri lesaddera kolla kedka yiot. veant tesader li, ulechol mare metivtan ella vetatta, umashshiryayn demalachin illain vetattain, lemehevi metakkenin umesadderin likara dilach, velikara deabba veimma, lemehevi safsal techot ragloy. ulemebad tziuuyeh bechol pikudin dileh. ulemidchal minneh bechol pikudin dela taase.

Vehay ihu ish immo veaviv tirau, vesamich leh veet shabbetotay tishmoru. uvikra acharina veet mitztzevotay taasu. missitra defikkudin daase deinnun kavod, akdim abba leimma, veda 15. missitra dela taase, akdim imma leabba, veda he. vehayeynu kevod elohim haseter davar. leillen dela mishtaddele behay kavod, haseter davar minnayyhu.

Vealayyhu ittemar, (Mishlei 3:35) uchesilim merim kalon. illen innun amme haaretz, batar dela mishtaddelin behay kavod deorayyta, veech amrin avinu shebbashshamayim shema kolenu chus verachem alenu vekabbel tefillatenu. ha ihu lemma lon, veim av ani ayye chevodi, ayyi ishtaddeluta dilchon beorayyta, uvefikkudin dili, lemebad tziuuyay, deman dela yada betztziuuyay demareh, ech yavid leh.

Bar mimman deshama mechachamim veavid, vehay ihu dekabbil naase venishma. veim kol da, man dela kabbil mimmareh, ella mishlucheh, ikka afrashuta. umay afrashuta it ben da leda. deha ketiv, moshe kibbel tora missinay, ulevatar umesarah lihoshua. ana kabbilna, ulevatar mosarna lechullehu. vehachi man dimkabbel meochora, kekabbalat sihara vechochavayyay mishshimmesha, uvehay kibbul itmele. uman dimkabbel yachil leistalleka minneh neviu, kema dachazena beshimsha vesihara, deistallekat nehora dilhon, belelya, dela nahir shimsha, ella bimama. vesihara belelya.

Vei tema dehahu nehora desihara mishshimmesha ihu, deaf al gav deitkenish, nahir besihara vechochavayya, ha chazenan missitra ochora belakuta desihara veshimmesha deistellak nehorayyhu, veishtaaru kegufa bela nishmeta, deit adon alehem machashich meorehem. aval ikkara dinhora, hahu atar dinvia delet pesak linhora dileh, vela it aleh elaha ochora lemifsak minneh nehoreh.

Veillat haillot, batar deant tamman, let pesak linviu dinhora deorayyta. yehe raava dilach dela tazuz meabba veimma dili, vela mibbenoy. vehachi man deamit garmeh al orayyta, dehi yekara, itkayyeymat beh, vela mafsekat minneh. ma delav hachi, man dela yishtaddel ba, ella af al gav deavad tziuuy chachamim, ihu shammash dilhon, eved vela ben, aval i ihu mehemana, mareh ashlit leh bechol dileh.

Aval man dela ishtedal beorayyta, vela meshammesh chachamim, lemishma minnayyhu pikudin, lekayyem naase venishma. ella dessarach veavar al lo taase, ihu shakil leumin dealma ovde avoda zara, benoy desamael venachash, deittemar behu, (Mishlei 3:35) uchesilim merim kalon, dela bau lekabbela orayyta, dechol delet beh tora, let beh kavod, deittemar bahem (Mishlei 3:35) kavod chachamim yinchalu.
Zohar, Terumah 14: Kegavvna deinnun mityaychadin leella beechad, uf hachi ihi, ityachadat letatta beraza deechad, lemehve immehon leella chad lokovel chad, kudesha berich hu echad leella, la yativ al kuresyay dikareh, ad deihi itavidat beraza deechad kegavvna dileh, lemeheve echad beechad. veha (134 amud alef) okimna raza daAdonai echad ushemo echad.

Raza deshabbat, ihi shabbat, deitachada beraza deechad, lemishre alah raza deechad. tzelota demaale shabbeta, deha itachadat kuresyay yakkira kaddisha, beraza deechad, veittakkanat lemishre alah malka kaddisha illaa.

Kad ayel shabbeta, ihi ityachadat veitparshat missitra achara, vechol dinin mitabberin minah, veihi ishtearat beyichuda dinhiru kaddisha, veitatterat bechamma itrin legabbe malka kaddisha, vechol shuletani rugezin umare dedina kullehu arkin, (nusach acher veitavaru minna) velet shuletanu achara bechullehu almin.

Veanpaha nehirin binhiru illaa, veitatterat letatta beamma kaddisha, vechullehu mitatterin benishmatin chadtin. keden sheruta ditzlota, levarcha lah bechedva, binhiru deanpin, velomar barchu et Adonai hamevorach. et Adonai dayyka, begin lemiftach legabbah bivracha.

Veasir leamma kadisha lemiftach legabbah bifsuka dedina, kegon vehu rachum vegomer, begin deha itparshat meraza desitra achara, vechol mare dedinin itparshu veitabberu minah. uman deittear hay letatta, garim leatara hachi leella. vechurseyay kadisha la yachla leitattera baatara dikdushsha, dechol zimna demitare letatta innun marehon dedina, dahavo mitabberin vahavu azle kullehu leittammera go nukeba deafra dithoma rabba, kullehu tayyvin leashraa beduchetayyhu veitrachakat (vaatadechaket) behu atar kadisha devaat nayycha.

Vela tema deda ihu bilchodoy, ella let itaruta leella leatara, ad deyisrael mitare letatta, kema deukimna, dichtiv, (Tehillim 81:4) bakkese leyom chaggenu. leyom chag la ketiv, ella leyom chaggenu. veal da asir leamma kadisha, deka mitatterin beitrin kaddishin denishmatin, begin leatara nayycha, deinnun yitarun dina, ella kullehu biru urechimu sagi, deyitarun birkan ella vetatta kachada.

rashi: Yisrefu oto veethen. e atta yachol lomar ishto harishona yisrefu, shehare nesaah behetter velo neesra alav, ella ishsha veimmah hakketuvoyn kan shetehen leissur — shennasa chamoto veimmah; veyesh merabbotenu sheomrim en kan ella chamoto, umahu ethen? et achat mehen velashon yevani hiv hen achat (sifra; sanhedrin 76):
Velo tissa alav chet. lo talbin et panav barabbim (80 sifra):
ohc: Lo tisna et achicha vegomer. perush, im nisbav meachicha davar haggorem lisnoto – lo tisnaehu bilvavcha, ella beficha dabber elav tochachot al asher kacha sibbev, vehu amro hocheach vegomer. veamro velo tissa alav chet, perush, lo tachlit bedatecha shemma shennisbav meachicha beresha asaan veodennu omed becheto amus al shichmo, ella tihye dan oto lechaf zechut, vetochichennu veal yede hattochacha yihye echad mishshene devarim: o yitten amatla lehannaasa veen chet, o yitcharet al hannaasa veyashuv leval asot kaddavar hazze, vahare hu kerea keach lecha.

Od nire lefaresh, behair od beshiur hannidbar shehaya tzarich lomar "lo tisna bilvavcha et achicha", sheyyigmor mekom hassina shehitchil ledabber bah veachar kach yizkor et mi yisna. achen yechavven lehodia shiur hassina asher Adonai metzavve aleha, shello yomar adam sheeno karuy sina ella sina gemura levakkesh raato velachpotz bechilyono, aval harechaka ballev enah keruya sina. laze nitchakkem hakkatuv lismoch lo tisna im tevat achicha, lomar ki hashearat hassina asher yetzavve Adonai aleha hi hannirgeshet beerech ach, veshiur ze kol sheyyarchikehu millibbo ketzat hinne hu yored mimmadregat ach, vahare hu over mishshum "lo tisna".
Od yirtze, behair lamma beazharat "lo tisna" dikdek lomar "et achicha", uveazharat "hocheach tochiach" amar "et amitecha", shennire shemmedabber bishne nosim.

Achen yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Tikkunim Adonai, tanna deve eliyyahu Rabba 83): im raita talmid chacham sheavar avera bayyom, al teharher acharav ballayla ki vadday asa teshuva. gam matzinu sheamru zichronam livracha (fesachim 113:) befarashat "ki tire chamor sonaacha" vegomer shehakkatuv medabber bemi sheraa bachavero davar megunne shemmitzva lisnooto. vechan tzivva hakkatuv sheim raa davar megunne betalmid chacham eno nichlal begeder otam shetztzivva Adonai lisnootam, ella tzarich lehacheziko ki vadday asa teshuva, vehu amro lo tisna et achicha shehu talmid chacham hammitkanne beshem ach, dichtiv (tehillim 122:8): "lemaan achay vereay". o al derech amram "et Adonai elohecha tira" lerabbot talmide chachamim, kemo chen kan et achicha perush, hammitrabbe meet achicha", vetevat "achicha" chozeret al habbore baruch hu shennikra ach leyisrael (midrash shocher tov 23) kivyachol.
