Veamro hocheach tochiach medabber benose acher, shehem hamon haam, velaze amar et amitecha velo amar "hocheach tochichennu" vechozer leachicha sheamar bitchilla, ella lomar sheeno medabber bema shehitchil ledabber bo shehu talmid chacham, ella bahamon haam shemmitzva lisnooto, metzavvehu Adonai sheyyochichennu al panav "lamma taase cho" binimut lashon, bechibba uverakkut lashon. veamro velo tissa alav chet, perush shello yimna mimmennu hattochachot, shebbaze yishshaer bemassa cheto velo yashuv el Adonai, ha lamadta sheim lo hochicho bittel ase dehocheach velo taase shel "velo tissa".

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (ketuvot 105:) hay tzureva merabbanan desanu leh bene mateh mishshum demochach lehu bemile dishmayya. umeatta yomar hechacham: "lamma li kina, lamma li sina vetacharut im zera yisrael? veechdal mehochiach veehye ahuv venechmad lechullan!" laze nitchakkem Adonai vekodem shetztzivvahu lehochiach, tzivva livne yisrael shello yisnauhu, veachar kach tzivvahu lehochiach, shehare yisrael muzharim meAdonai leval yisnauhu. veim tomar: "umi yaarvennu laam shello yisnauhu veyishmeru mitzvat lo tisna?" laze amar velo tissa alav chet, perush shello yachshedem bechet ze ella yachzikem bechashrut. veomer leshon yachid lishlol hachashad afillu miyyachid, sheyyachzik kol ish yisrael shello yisneu bashshaar mochiach, uvaze yochiach veyachzor veyochiach ad sheyyekabbelu musaro.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat log:) baavon haddor nitpasim gedole olam, vechen hu omer (Shir HaShirim 1:14) "eshkol hakkofer" vegomer, uletzad ze chash hakkatuv shettikkanes belev kerove Adonai harechakat hallev al maase Adonai ze, ki yomru sheenam muvtachim bechayyehem uveshalvatam hagam ki yafliu lehetiv maasehem. laze ba devar Adonai kan veamar letzaddikav "lo tisna et achicha bilvavecha", perush "achicha" ze hakkadosh baruch hu, veyesh lecha ladaat shello lechol yisrael behashevaa yikkare hakkadosh baruch hu ach ella lehakkerovim vehaddevekim baAdonai kerabbi akiva vachaverav, vetzivva lahem shello yitrachek libbam meAdonai, shehaharchaka hi anaf hassina. veim tomar, ma ashiv el libbi levittachon bechayyay uveshalvati, laze amar hocheach tochiach et amitecha uvaze lo tissa atta alav, perush, bishvilo, chet, ki kelum taam tefisat hatztzaddik hu bishvil avon haddor, im yochichennu hare hu nitztzol mimma nafshach, im chazru bitshuva hare en kan avonot sheyyittafes alehem, veim lo chazru hare niftarta mittefisa, kemo sheggilla sodo beyad avadav hanneviim, dichtiv (Yechezkel 33:9): "veatta ki hizharta rasha vegomer hu rasha baavono yamut veatta et nafshecha hitztzalta". ulederech ze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim sheddikdaknu bappasuk.

Shuv ba leyadi tanna deve eliyyahu (Rabba 98) veze leshono: vechi beachim min haav vehaem hakkatuv medabber? en hakkatuv medabber ella keneged hakkadosh baruch hu, sheen lo achim lo baolam hazze velo baolam habba velo limot hammashiach, ella tzaddike olam sheosin retzono betorato bechol yom, shekkara otam achim vereim, ad kan leshono. veteda shemmaalat ach yoter mimmadregat banim, kemaamar zichronam livracha (Shir HaShirim Rabba 83): lo zaz mechabbevah ad shekkeraah bitti, lo zaz vechulei ad shekkeraah achoti.

rashi: Venetel. massa:
Vechaas evil. shehaevil machis lehakkadosh baruch hu, gorem lehavi kaas laolam:
targum: Yekara chefa unetul chala verugezeh deshatya yakir min tarvehon:

rashi: Mippene seva takum. yachol zaken ashmay, tal zaken, en zaken ella shekkana chachma (kiddushin 32):

Vehadarta pene zaken. ezehu hiddur? lo yeshev bimkomo velo yistor et devarav: yachol yaatzim enav kemi shello raahu? lechach neemar veyareta meelohecha, shehare davar ze masur lelibbo shel osehu, sheen makkir bo ella hu, vechol davar hammasur lallev neemar vo veyareta meelohecha (sham):
ohc: Mippene seva takum vegomer – razal amru (kiddushin lev:) "mippene seva", shehu gadol beshanim, "takum vehadarta", kima sheyyesh bah hiddur. "takum vehadarta pene zaken" – ze shekkana chachma. kashe, kefi ze haya lo lomar "mippene seva umippene zaken takum vehadarta". veulay shennitkavven lehameshich hahiddur lezaken ze shekkana chachma, vehakkima leseva shehu habba bayyamim. vehakkavvana baze shetztzarich haderaga gedola bichvod hechacham yoter mikkevod gadol beshanim. vahagam sheddarshu zichrono livracha kima vehiddur laze vekima vehiddur laze, im kol ze mimma shennitchakkem hakkatuv ledabber beseder ze lehameshich hiddur lezaken, hodienu ki gadol hiddur lezaken mehiddur gadol beshanim. umeatta nimtzenu omrim shetztzarich lechabbed hechacham yoter mibbaal seva.

Od yirmoz al derech amram zichronam livracha bivreshit rabba (Bereshit Rabba 65:9) ki avraham avinu bikkesh al hasseva kede sheyyihye nikkar haav mehabben vechulei, dichtiv (Bereshit 24:1) "veavraham zaken", vehu amro mippene seva takum, uvaze atta mehadder pene zaken shehu avraham, dichtiv "veavraham zaken", sheal yado haya davar ze.

Od yirmoz al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 12:6) ki harshaim kefufe koma, vitzav Adonai laadam sheyyitorer letakken maasav lashuv laAdonai vezo hi kimato, veheiro letakken maasav mippene seva, perush sevato kede shello tovad mimmennu, al derech amram zichronam livracha (yevamot 50.) zacha mashlimin lo, lo zacha pochatin lo velo yaggia lime shenotenu shivim shana. gam ramaz kede shello yavou yamim raim beet sevato shehem yissurin hakkashim laadam mikkol yissurin, keamram zichronam livracha (Kohelet Rabba 12:1) ki hem yamim shekkochot haadam vehishtaddelutav afesim vehu tzarich lehashegacha elohit:

Od yirmoz vehadarta pene zaken, perush ziknat atzmo, al derech amram (socha 53.): ashre yaldutenu shello biyyesha et ziknutenu. gam ramaz lemaamaram zichronam livracha (chagiga yad:) shebbeshaa shehatztzaddik holech meolam hazze, omrim leavraham avinu: ashrecha avraham avinu shetztzaddik ze yatza mechalatzecha, uchesheholech harasha lo day sheen omrim ken lefanav ella shehu mitztaer. laze meorer Adonai lehaadam veomer lo vehadarta pene zaken, ze avraham shemmithadder kesheomrim lefanav "ashrecha" vechulei. vehosif lehafechido meinyene olam habba, veamar veyareta meelohecha – zo yirat onesh yom haddin, ani Adonai – zo tashlum sachar tov shel olam habba. o yirtze lehair hayyira vehaahava, yira – "veyareta" vegomer, ahava – "ani Adonai", ki shem ze hu mekor haahava hachashuka belev kol maskil.

rashi: Im iddaresh lachem. bevakkashatchem; uvesof hassefer hazze hu omer "iddaresh levet yisrael" (Yechezkel 36:37)! zo achat min hammekomot hamelammedim otanu shehakkadosh baruch hu chozer bo al haraa, veal kayyotze vaze "hahu amar velo yaase" (Bamidbar 23:19); midrash tanchuma (vayyar 13):
targum: Bar adam itnabbe lesave yisrael vetemar lehon kidnan amar Adonai elohim halemitba ulefan min kodamay attun atan kayam ana im eshteel lechon bememri amar Adonai elohim:

rashi: Beyom zivchachem yeachel. keshettizbechuhu tishchatuhu al menat zeman ze shekkavati lachem kevar:
Chacham beni. hitchakkem beni:
Vesammach libbi. utehe libbi sameach becha:
targum: Itchakkem beri vechade libbi veachzar milta leilen dimchasdin li:

rashi: Pecham legechalim veetzim leesh. pecham shel esh asuy lehaveir gechalim amumot veetzim asuyin lehassik esh, veish madon lecharchar riv:
targum: Tartekel legumere vekise lenura vegavra tigrana mechare vehuta:

rashi: Veish. perat lekatan:
Asher yinaf et eshet ish. perat leeshet katan, limmedanu sheen lekatan kiddushin, veal ezo eshet ish chiyyavti lecha?
Asher yinaf et eshet reehu. perat leeshet goy, limmedanu sheen kiddushin legoy (sifra; sanhedrin 52):
Mot yumat hannoef vehannoafet. kol mita haamura vattora setam, enah ella chenek (sifra; sanhedrin 55):
Venislach lo mechattato asher chata. lerabbot et hammezid kashshogeg (sifra):
Lo takkifu peat roshchem. ze hammashve tzedaav laachore azno ulefaddachto, venimtza hekkef rosho agol saviv, sheal achore aznav ikkere searo lemala mitztzedaav harebe:

Peat zekanecha. sof hazzakan ugevulav (makkot 20), vehen chamesh — shetayim bechol lechi valechi, lemala etzel harosh shehu rachav, veyesh bo shete feot, veachat lematta besantero — mekom chibbur shene hallechayayim yachad (shavuot 50):
ohc: Lo takkifu vegomer. behakkafat harosh amar leshon rabbim, uvehashchatat hazzakan amar leshon yachid, lomar sheyyeshno beazharat "lo takkif" hagam sheeno beazharat "lo tashchit", kegon mi sheadayin en lo chatimat zakan, shello tomar kevan sheeno belo tashchit" eno belo takkif", kederech sheddarshu (kiddushin la:) bemishpat hannashim sheenan belo takkifu" kevan sheenam belo tashchit". veim tomar, uma raita lerabbot ellu ulemaet ellu, merabbe ani hazzecharim sheyyeshnam belo tashchit" kesheyyigdelu, umemaet ani hannashim sheen beminam "lo tashchit".

rashi: Vaomar alehem. aharon nibba lahem nevua zo, kodem shennigla hakkadosh baruch hu al moshe bassene, vezehu shenneemar leeli (Shmuel 1 2:27) "haniglo nigleti el bet avicha bihyotam bemitzrayim vegomer" (tanchuma Shemot 27):
targum: Vaamaret lehon gevar yat shikutzohi archiku mikovel enohi uvefulechan taavat mitzrae la tistaavun ana Adonai elahachon:

rashi: Beefes etzim. kelomar shene devarim ellu shavin: keshem shebeefes etzim tichbe esh, kach been nirgan shel lashon hara hamesachsech baale riv, yishtok madon:
targum: Hechna delet kise daacha nura vehechna delet shegusha yishtak tigra:

rashi: Vaaraltem orlato. vaatamtem atimato — yehe atum venistam millehanot mimmennu:
Shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim. meematay mone lo? mishsheat netiato; yachol im hitznio, leachar shalosh shanim yehe muttar, tal yihye — bahavayato yehe (sifra):
ohc: Vechi tavou el haaretz vegomer. shalosh mitzvot neemru kan: 1 biat haaretz, al derech amram (ketuvot 110:) hakkol maalin leeretz yisrael vechulei. 2 lintoa kol etz maachol leshevach haaretz. 3 linhog shene arla.

Od yirmoz beamro vechi tavou el haaretz, shello tihye hakkavvana leteavon hamuregashot, ella tihye kavvanat habbia el haaretz lechibbuv ulecheshek haaretz hakkedosha asher bachar Adonai bah, har Adonai shamma. veamar ki en kavvanat dibbur ze lehachelit hammenia mehishtaddel beyishshuv haaretz, ella "unetatem" vegomer, ha lamadta shemma shehitna bemaamar "el haaretz" hu bivchinat tachlit hammachshava shettihye lemaalat haaretz bammusekalot, lo lahanaat hagguf.

Veulay sheromez beamro etz maachol al bene tora sheggam hem nikreu netaim, kemo sheamar rabbi yose (shabbat 118:) chamesh beilot baalti vechamesh netiot natati, venikraim gam ken etz, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 65:22) "kime haetz yeme ammi", uchemo chen darshu bazzohar (chelek 3 202.) befasuk "lo tashchit et etzah" shemmedabber beadam ben tora, vetzivva Adonai shettihye ikkar hachenasat haaretz lintoa bah etz maachol shehem bene tora, ki avirah shel eretz yisrael machkim umetaher hannefesh (bava batra kinnach:), venikra ben tora etz maachol ki mimmennu mazon lannefesh. vetze ulemad mimmaase shel rabbi akiva (massechet kullah rabbati perek 2) shellimmed tora leoto tinok shehaya aviv met venatun betzara gedola, umiyyom sheppatach piv bedivre tora nehena aviv baolam haelyon:

Veamar shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim, perush atumim, shello yetze mehem tziftzuf tora shehu peri maachol (tanchuma, kedoshim yad), shead shalosh shanim en hattinok yachol ledabber, uvashshana harviit shehitchil ledabber yelammedo lomar "tora tzivva lanu", "shema yisrael", veze yikkare "kodesh hillulim", uvashshana hachamishit tochlu et piryo, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (avot 5:24) ben chamesh shanim lammikra, veyatchil lihyot etz maachol.

Vesamach hakkatuv laze mitzvat lo tochlu al haddam, ramaz hakkatuv shello yihye sippuko bemaachalo al sibbat haddam shehu geshem haadam utechunato, ella letachlit hammuskol haramuz beetz maachol. vesamach laze gam ken mitzvat lo tenachashu, ki tachlit achilat haddam hu chelek hannachash, besod (Yeshayahu 65:25) "venachash afar lachmo", vehu ochel kol geshem haadam ad keloto, vehu amro velo teonenu al derech amro (Iyov 7:9) "kala anan vayyelach ken yored sheol lo yaale", ufasuk ze medabber baholech achar hammurgash leharebot chelev vadam.

rashi: Veel bene yisrael tomar. onshin al haazharot:
Mot yumat. bevet din, veim en koach bevet din, am haaretz mesayyein otan (sifra):
Am haaretz. am shebbegino nivret haaretz, am sheatidin lirash haaretz al yede mitzvot hallalu (sham):
ohc: Veel bene yisrael vegomer. taam amro veel bene yisrael nitkavven lehazehir kelalut yisrael laharog hannoten mizzaro lammolech, veamar betosefet vav lomar shemmillevad chiyyuv hammaavir gam chiyyuv kol haam lehaanisho.

rashi: Umikdashi tirau. lo yikkanes bemaklo uveminalo uvaafundato uveavak sheal raglav (berachot 54); veaappi sheani mazhirchem al hammikdash, et shabbetotay tishmoru — en binyan hammikdash doche shabbat (sifra):
ohc: Et shabbetotay tishmoru vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma chazar lomar paam sheniyya ma shetztzivva bitchillat happarasha (Vayikra 19:3). verazal betorat kohanim amru veze leshonam: yachol yehe binyan bet hammikdash doche et hashshabbat? talmud lomar "et shabbetotay tishmoru" vegomer, ad kan. divrehem zichronam livracha yotziu otanu mikkoshi hassemichut, aval koshi hakkefel bimkomo munnach, shehaya lo lichtov "umikdashi tirau" samuch lemaamar "veet shabbetotay tishmoru" haamur bitchillat happarasha, velo haya tzarich lomar paam sheniyya "veet shabbetotay" vegomer.

Venire ki mitzva zo keshura im ma shellefaneha, ki letzad shetztzivva Adonai laav leval yechallel bitto lehazenotah, lifamim yimmatze ki habbat meatzmah techallel kevod atzmah uchevod aviha liznot veen yad haav baemtza, laze tzivva Adonai laav sheyyaase shemira leval tizne habbat ki hakkol taluy bammolid. veleheyot sheyyesh shalosh sibbot asher yafilu holadat teva ra bannoladim: haechad, im bishat hazziuug yechavven el hanaat hammishgal lo lesibbat mitzvat habbore lekayyem hammin, ze yolid bannolad tigboret (ra). hammin hashsheni mimmenna, perush mitztzad shehaishsha maaseha lo tovim, rachla batar rachla azla (ketuvot 63.). 3, im hammolidim av o em chashvu bechinat hara behessach haddaat, uchemaase chizkiyya hammelech alav hashshalom (sanhedrin 104.) asher machashavtam sibbeva holadat bilti hagun, hagam heyotam yesode olam.

Keneged sibba rishona amar et shabbetotay tishmoru, al derech amram bazzohar (10 89.) befasuk "lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay" (Yeshayahu 56:4), shehem hatztzaddikim hammesarsim et atzmam veenam nizkakim linshotehem ella belel shabbat, umoshchin livnehem neshamot kedoshim, ad kan. hare sheharotze leholid ben baal nefesh tehora tzarich lesares atzmo velaatzor koach hattaev, velo yifal ella lattachlit hammetzuvve bo meet Adonai baruch hu. vehu maamar Adonai limnoa nefesh zona mibbeto, et shabbetotay tishmoru lehizdavveg bahem, uvaze tolid neshama kedosha hammoeset biznut. ucheneged sibba sheniyya shehu hachashash mitztzad haem amar umikdashi tirau, azhara liro mehammikdash, uvaze tishmor atzmah haishsha leval yevienna el hammikdash lehashekotah me hammarim. ucheneged sibba shelishit samach laze azharat al tifnu el haovot veel hayyiddeonim, hem bechinat hattuma harotza umitavva lehiddavek baadam hattahor.

Vetevat ovot leshon ava, al derech amro (Devarim 23:6) "velo ava Adonai". veremez yiddeoni hu lomar shello yachshov yihye yadua etzlo, ki yediat hattame machrachat haadam lehiddavek bo keteva hashshafel shechafetz lehiddavek beelyon vechashuk.

Veamar ani Adonai elohechem, ba latet taam lehemshech nefesh raa missibbat hachoshev, ki letzad ki Adonai elohenu, perush, shochen betoch nefesh yisrael, bachashov haadam bivchinat hara mistallek koach hakkedushsha veen mizdammen lefanav lehameshich ella chelek hara. nimtza ki kol sheeno shomer atzmo mishshalosh sibbot hu mechallel bitto vechulei:

rashi: Dabber el kol adat bene yisrael. melammed shenneemra farasha zo behakehel mippene sherov gufe tora teluyyin bah (sifra):

Kedoshim tihyu. hevu ferushim min haarayot umin haavera, shekkol makom sheatta motze geder erva atta motze kedushsha, ishsha zona vachalala vegomer ani Adonai mekaddishchem (Vayikra 21), velo yechallel zaro, ani Adonai mekaddesho (sham), kedoshim yihyu, ishsha zona vachalala (sham):
ohc: El kol adat vegomer. taam amro "el kol", amru zichronam livracha betorat kohanim: lefi shepparasha zo rov gufe hattora teluyim bah, neemra behakehel. vahagam shekkol mitzva umitzva mimmitzvot hattora haya moshe omrah lechol yisrael, kaamur babbarayta, huvea beeruvin ned:, teretz harav rabbi eliyyahu mizrachi shehayu nichnasim kat achar kat, ma sheen ken befarasha zo shennichnesu yachad, ad kan. vekashe lidvarav, im kavvanato beamro shehayu nichnasim kat achar kat al yisrael shehayu baim achar hazzekenim, im ken moshe haya omer yoter mechamishsha veshishsha peamim, ulefi cheshbon happeamim shemmana hattanna sham sheyyesh beyad kol echad arba eno mashma ken, shekkatvu veze leshonam: nichnesu kol haam vechulei nimtzeu beyad aharon arba. veim kavvanat harav beamro "kat achar kat" hu al kat shel aharon, venadav vaavihu, vechat shel hazzekenim vechulei, shebbishar hatztziuuyim hayu nichnasim ze achar ze, vechan nichnesu yachad aharon, nadav vaavihu vehazzekenim vehayyisreelim, hinne bema shennaamod al ikkaran shel devarim, lamma moshe nahag bechol hammitzvot beseder ze, velo haya shone lechullam yachad arba peamim, venimtzeu lechol echad miyyisrael arba peamim mippi moshe, shehu yoter tov millishmoa haarba peamim paam mimmoshe ushetayim veshalosh peamim mizzulato? ella hattaam hu leechad mishshene devarim: o laasot kavod lehaderagat yisrael – kavod leaharon, kavod levanav, kavod lazzekenim veachar kach leyisrael; o letzad shekkol echad lamad bifne atzmo mippi moshe, kesheyyachzor aharon levanav uchesheyyachzeru banav lazzekenim vehazzekenim leyisrael, meemtzaut ze yihye nikkar venirgash im yesh hishtannut bannishma ben hakkittot kesheyyachzeru haddevarim ze laze, ma shello haya hergesh ze im hayu kullam shomim mippi moshe haarba peamim, vedavar ze yuskal belev shomea. im ken lishte hadderachim yoter nachon laasot beseder ze gam bemitzva zo, ben letaam laasot kavod leaharon vechulei, lamma yiggara kevod aharon vechulei kan, ben letaam sheyyechavven haddevarim lashshomim, adrabba kan yitztarech lihyot haddavar yoter letzad shehem gufe hattora. veim letzad sheyyomar moshe hammitzva bederech kelali lechol yisrael, halo gam beseder harishonot yeshno livchina zo sheyyeshno ledibburo shel moshe kelali lechol yisrael keshennichnasin kol yisrael veshone lahem moshe bemaamad gam aharon uvanav vehazzekenim, veim ken ma kiur basseder haragil shetztzivva Adonai leshannot, sheen ze ella geraon?

Achen hannachon beenay hu, ki basseder harishon lo haya medabber moshe ella laanashim, vechan tzivva Adonai sheyyedabber lechol adat yisrael, anashim venashim vetaf, keseder shehayu mekubbatzim bemattan tora. uvesamuch yitbaer hakkatuv beofen acher:

Veamarta alehem. taam shekkafal lomar "veamarta" ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 24; torat kohanim) sheamru ki letzad sherov gufe hattora vechulei, laze asa bah gam ken keseder netinat hattora sheddibber bah rakkot vekashot (Shemot 19:3): "ko tomar vegomer vetagged", veamar dabber leshon koshi, veamarta amira rakka, uvesamuch yitbaer hakkatuv beofen acher.

Kedoshim tihyu. tzarich ladaat ma hu hammechuvvan shel mitzva zo. venire shebba hakkatuv latet ase al haarayot, shetztzivva alehem bapparasha hakkodemet belav, hosif ase alehem laavor alehem gam baase.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (kiddushin lat:): yashav adam velo avar avera notnim lo sachar keose mitzva, vehu maamar hakkatuv "kedoshim tihyu" bemitzvat ase beva avera leyado sheyyitrachek measotah, uvaze kiyyem mitzvat ase shennitztauu bemaamar kedoshim tihyu, vehotzi zichron mitzva zo belashon ze shel kedoshim, lomar shekkol hamekayyem mitzva zo nikra kadosh, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 104, yerushalmi yevamot 82 9) gam ken. uletaam ze dikdek lomar el kol adat bene yisrael, lomar ki mitzva zo shemmetzavve "kedoshim tihyu" hi mitzva sheyyeshnah bechol adam, shekkol ish yisrael bekayyemo mitzva zo kadosh yeamer lo, veen haderaga beyisrael shettihye nimnaat mehassaga zo. gam baze yityashshev taam kefel "dabber veamarta", ki yesh kan dibbur kashe beerech haover sheyyosif onesh ase, veyesh kan maala vechavod lammekayyemo sheyyikkare kadosh. veulay ki davka bene yisrael hu sheyyeshnam bivchina zo ma sheen ken ummot haolam, lu yihye sheyyifrosh adam atzmo mibbechinot haarayot haasurot lo o afillu sheenam asurot, af al pi chen meshullal hu mibbechinat hakkedushsha, velaze amar el vegomer bene yisrael. uvesamuch yitbaer beofen acher.

Ki kadosh ani vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma netinat taam hu ze, vechi yitchayyev haddavar litzir kappav lehiddamot lekono, vahalo harebe haderagot yeshnam belohe yisrael veenam mussagim beyisrael. veim kavvanato lomar taam hatztziuuy shehu chafetz baddavar letzad elohenu kadosh chafetz sheggam ovdav yihyu kemo chen velo taam hammitchayyev, vead atta en ani yodea lamma yitchayyev hakkatuv latet taam.

Verabbotenu zichronam livracha nire shemmikkusheya ze hirgishu, vedarshu betorat kohanim veze leshonam: im attem mekaddeshim atzmechem maale ani alechem keillu kiddashtem oti, ad kan. uchefi ze tihye kavvanat ki kadosh vegomer hodaat toelet hannimshach, vehodaat hefko kemo shessiyyem sham hattanna: veim en attem mekaddeshim atzmechem maale ani alechem keillu lo kiddashtem oti, ad kan. veulay ki gam laze kivven bechefel "dabber veamarta", lakkoshi hannimshach im lo yekaddeshu atzmam, velarommut hannisbav im yekaddeshu atzman:

Od nire lefaresh hakkatuv al ze hadderech, ki letzad shetztzivva Adonai al bechinat taava hakkevua beteva enoshi, vehu taava hashsholetet al haratzon, uchevar katavti bapparasha hakkodemet befasuk (Vayikra 18:2) "kemaase eretz mitzrayim" vegomer, ki bechina zo en yecholet baadam lishlot aleha ella begeder harichuk bivchinat hachoshev. umeatta, letzad shetztzivva Adonai bimkomo lekayyem hammin ulehiddavek betzela nachon leish, yesh motza ra mibbechina zo lehitgabber bo bechinat cheshek hammitgabber venotzeach haratzon behofcho, veen adam sholet beatzmo lehishshamer min haarayot shetztzivva Adonai alehem. veim ken mimma nafshach: yaase mitzva "derech gever bealma" (Mishlei 30:19) lekayyem mino – hinne hu meshullal mishshemirat haarayot; yimna atzmo mimmin ze kol ikkar – hinne hu mevattel mitzvat periyya verivya umitzvat yibbum.

Asher al ken ba maamar Adonai kan vetzivva binimut imre kadosh kedoshim tihyu, perush, sheyyekaddeshu atzman bammaasim asher baa alehem hammitzva laasotah, perush shello yaase haddavar letaavat haggeshem ulehashlim hachefetz hashshoalo asot davar, ella yaase haddavar bikdushsha uvetahara, kemo shemmitattef betzitzit umachnis tefillin bizroo, veyimas bedato chefetz habba meatzmo, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (nedarim 20:) yihye dome kemo shekkefao shed, uleish kaze kadosh yeamer lo.

Uletzad sheyyomar adam, ech nachchish hammuregash shehachefetz yakkirennu veyite taam haddavar, veen koach bivchinat hachoshev limnoa hahergesh baze, ki haregashato gedola umeoreret kol hachushim vehahergashot, vechoveshet hammachshava lavo immahem bitimat haddavar, veim ken chazarnu lachashasha harishona, laze amar ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem, perush, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Tikkunei Zohar 70) ki chol haose mitzva achat, shemo yitbarach havaya shore al evar shebbo asa hammitzva, ki tevat hammitzva bo ramuz shem, 130 beat bash 15, veotiyyot 11 hare havaya, uchevar katavti bimkomot acherim (Vayikra 18:4) taam shechatzi hashshem beat bash vachatzi nigle. veim ken baasot haadam haddavar leshem mitzva hinne shem havaya shore alav shehu kadosh, uvaze en davar ra mishtalshel mehammaase, vehu amro ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem, dikdek lomar elohechem lirmoz el devekut Adonai bammitkaddesh laasot hammaase leshem mitzva, al derech amro "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem". velaze amar el kol adat bene yisrael, lomar shekkol ish yisrael yeshno begeder mitzva zo, gam kafal "veamarta" lirmoz maala zo.

Od yirtze beamro ki kadosh ani vegomer, perush, letzad sheyyesh maamaro yitbarach battora sheam bene yisrael hem devukim behakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv (Devarim 4:4) "veattem haddevekim" vegomer, veal yede avadav hanneviim katuv lemor (yirmeya 13:11) "kaasher yidbak haezor el matne ish ken hidbakti elay et kol bet yisrael". meatta ba hakkadosh baruch hu betaana hannishmaat veamar kedoshim tihyu, vehattaam ki kadosh ani, veim tomar, uma latteven et habbar, laze amar Adonai elohechem, kan ramaz hasheraat shechina bidvekut laAdonai kaamur bappasuk "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem":

Od yirtze, shello yomar adam shello asar hakkatuv ella maase haarayot, aval lo bechinat hachoshev vehahistakkelut ushear dikduke hattiuv asher rabbu, uchevar ramzu mehem razal (berachot 61.) kegon hammartze maot miyyado leyad ishsha vechulei, kemo sheddarshu befasuk "yad leyad" vegomer (Mishlei 11:21), vechan tzivva Adonai al haddevarim hahemma vechayyotze bahem, shetztzarich leharechik atzmo mehakkiur umehaddome laddome lo kede shello yavo lehikkashel afilu baddikdukim hahem, uchemaamar hazzohar befasuk "al tifnu el haelilim", vehu ma shetztzivva bemaamar "kedoshim tihyu", leval yavo lide hachoshev vetihye nishlelet mehem bechinat hakkedushsha, kemaamar hakkatuv (Devarim 23:11) "lo yihye tahor mikkere layla". uletzad sheyyomar adam, halo davar ze eno birshuti, shehagam sheeshmor atzmi bayyom, af al pi chen ballayla en haddavar taluy beyadi, laze amar ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem, vechevan sheani kadosh vaani immachem, ani emna bechinat hattuma miggeshet laish hayyisreeli, zulat im adam yachshov bivchinat hara, az sholel mimmennu hasheraat shechina veshora alav bechinat hara vehu hahidrokan hammechasse pene ish ra, veaz yavo lide keri ballayla.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: kedoshim tihyu leshon atid, perush en hefsek lemitzva zo, ki chol shaar mehakkedushsha asher yikkanes adayin yeshno begeder hachenasat shaar acher lemala mimmennu, ki en shiur lehaderagot hakkedushsha hamezummenet lechol harotze littol et hashshem. vetze ulemad mimmadregot hanneviim zo lemala mizzo, umoshe ole al gabbehen, veulay sheyyachol lihyot haderaga gedola mimmoshe, vehu madregot malkenu meshichenu hammeuttar beitre atarot, kammuvan mippasuk (yeshaya 11:2) "venacha alav ruach Adonai" vegomer, uledivre razal (Bamidbar Rabba 99, Devarim Rabba 82) ki moshe shehaya hu haggoel heatid, uchemo sheheerachnu beferushan shel devarim bimkoman, im ken en shiur ugevul lehaderagot hakkedushsha. laze amar tihyu ki mitzva zo en lah hefsek vetamid yeshnah begeder mitzva zo lihyot kedoshim.

Venatan taam lidvarav ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem, sheen shiur el kedushshato yitbarach, vechafetz Adonai bevanav yedidav lehiddamot lekonam behafelagat hakkedushsha, umeatta dun bedatecha hahadragot asher tavo bahem.

Od yirtze bintinat hattaam ki kadosh vegomer, perush, ulefi erech gedullat kedushshato yitbarach tzerichin lehitkaddesh, ki letzad sheanu mechinim atzmenu lehasheraat shechina al rashenu, tzerichin leshaer godel kedushshato yitbarach kede laasot hammuchan laddavar, ki eno dome hammeachsen beveto hedyot, lammeachsen sar vegadol, vekal vachomer melech, vekal vachomer beno shel kal vachomer melech hammelachim, vekal vachomer vechulei melech haolam asher lo hammelucha, shekkol ma sheyyaase adayin yeshno bekum ase ki en shiur day lehatzerich asot, velaze amar ki kadosh ani Adonai elohechem, perush, uleerech kedushshati ani metzavve shettachinu atzmechem bechol yecholet hammussag.

Vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (shabbat 112:): im harishonim kemalachim vechulei veim harishonim anashim vechulei, hareta ladaat kamma tzarich adam asot behitkaddeshuto. vetze ulemad kamma hayu mishtaddelim baavodat Adonai harishonim, mimmaase rabbi elazar ben azarya (shabbat ned.) sheyyatzta parat shechento birtzua shebben karneha shello birtzon chachamim, hagam ki kefi dato haya muttar, veamru bayyerushalmi (shabbat 85) shehushcharu shinnav betaaniyyot al haddavar hahu. velaze kivven beamro dabber leshon koshi letzad hafelagat hatztziuuy. uletzad bechinat hammussag amar veamarta. veamar el kol adat bene yisrael leval yomar adam sheen mitzva zo haggedola lechol ish yisrael, velo dibber hakkatuv ella lichide segulla, laze amar el kol adat vegomer, shekkullam yeshnam begeder mitzva zo, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (451 deve eliyyahu, 282 hilchot teshuva 5): yachol adam laasot atzmo kemoshe rabbenu.

Od yirtze kedoshim tihyu kammalachim hannikraim kedoshim, kakkatuv (Daniel 8:13) "vayyomer echad kadosh", vehu al derech amro (tehillim 82:6) "ani amarti elohim attem uvene elyon kullechem", uletzad shehakkadosh baruch hu hishra shechinato betoch bene yisrael vaasaam bene pallatin shello bimkom hammalachim, vetze ulemad ma sheamru besefer hazzohar (zohar 10 140:) al zeman shehishra hakkadosh baruch hu shechinato battachtonim, kamma hayta haregashat bene elyon al shebbachar Adonai beucheluse yisrael yoter meucheluse hammalachim, velaze tzivva Adonai et uchelusav hammuvcharim shehen henna malachav, velahem yikkare kedoshim, ucheshennichnastem begeder ze lihyot ucheluse bimkom hammalachim tzerichin lihyot kedoshim. veramaz perat ze shennichnesu bimkom uchelusat hammalachim beamro Adonai elohechem:

rashi: Levilti hechel. shello yitchallel shemi; meachar shennodati lahem vehivtachtim lehotziam vehikkiru mitzrayim shehem ammi, illu hayiti mashchitam hayu omrim oyvehem: mibbilti yecholet beyado lehotziam (Bamidbar 14:16):
targum: Vaavadet bedil shemi bedil dela yitchal leene ammaya di inun benehon deitgeleti lemifrakhon leenehon leappakutehon meara demitzrayim:

rashi: Kemitlahamim. leshon mitlachamim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha pershu (sifre Devarim 24) kemitlahamim: kemet lahem. divre hameraggelim hayu lahem lemita:
Chadre vaten. hi mitat hadderokan:
targum: Miloy deshigusha marchenan leh vehinun nachatan legavah dichresa:

rashi: Aviv veimmo killel. lerabbot leachar mita (sham; sanhedrin 85):

Damav bo. zo sekila, vechen kol makom shenneemar damav bo, demehem bam; velamadnu meov veyiddeoni, shenneemar bahem baeven yirgemu otam demehem bam (sifra; keritut Adonai). ufeshuto shel mikra, kemo damo verosho (Yehoshua 2) — en neenash al mitato ella hu, shehu garam leatzmo sheyyehareg:
ohc: Ki ish ish asher yekallel. kashe amro ki shennoten taam lema shellefanav, velo amar davar kodem sheyyihye ze tamo. veim al shemirat hachukkim, vechi lo nichlal befasuk ze ella killat avot shehutzdak lomar ki? od, lamma kafal lomar "ish ish"? uvetorat kohanim amru: "ish" – en li ella ish, ishsha minnayin? talmud lomar "ish ish", ad kan. kashe, minnayin yaale al daat lemaet ishsha shehutzrach leribbuy, vahalo hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashim shebbattora bederech kelal, ucheamram zichronam livracha (bava kamma 15.). veim letzad shechash hakkatuv lefaresh ish shebba lemaet ishsha, lo haya lo lichtov ish litot lomar shebba lemaet ishsha, veyomar "adam ki yekallel" vegomer. od lamma kafal lomar "aviv veimmo killel"?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu, letzad shetztzivva kodem laze al haavarat beno uvitto lammolech, vehikpid hakkatuv al zaro levad, aval ben acherim vaafillu kerovav kegon achiv vaachoto patur, kidtanya besanhedrin (sanhedrin sad:) veze leshonam: eno chayyav ella al yotze yerecho vechulei, ad kan. vetzarich lomar taam chiyyuvo al beno uvitto velo al bene hazzulat, shehu letzad shebbanav hem niddonin kinchasav shel adam, laze moilim maasav keshemmakrivo laavoda zara bema shemmaaviran lammolech, aval chutz mehem en maasav osin roshem, al derech amram zichronam livracha (arachin koach, bava metzia 7:) afillu legabbe kadshe shamayim: en adam makdish davar sheeno shello. umeatta yomar adam, vahalo gam habben eno kullo shel haav, keamram zichronam livracha (nidda lo.) shehaav vehaem hem shuttafin baadam, halloven mehaav vehaodem mehaem, veim ken mizze hattaam atzmo lo yitchayyev haav al habben mitztzad chelek haem. laze amar hakkatuv achar azhara veonesh maavir banav lammolech: "ki ish ish asher yekallel vegomer mot yumat", vedikdek lomar "et aviv veet immo", perush, ze bifne atzmo o ze bifne atzmo, kemo sheddikdeku betorat kohanim befasuk ze atzmo chiyyuv al kol echad mishshenehem, hare shehabben met letzad shennaga beaviv o bichvod immo, veen anu omrim vahare en kol habben shel haav o shel haem lahamito bishvilam.

Veim tomar gam al ze dan anochi lamma yihye hammishpat hazze, laze gamar omer aviv veimmo killel, perush ki keshemmekallel aviv mekallel gam immo immo vechen lehefech, vehattaam letzad shehaav vehaem hem guf echad, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (berachot kad.): ishto kegufo, uchefi ze ben hannaase leechad mehem o hannaase meechad mehem livnehem yechashev lishnehem yachad. velaze timtza sheyyaanish Adonai laish lehamit ishto, dichtiv (Mishlei 22:27) "lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha".

Vechafal lomar ish ish mishshum shemmatzinu shettala hakkatuv zecharim binkevot unekevot bizcharim, veamru zichronam livracha (nidda lo.): ishsha mazraat techilla yoledet zachar, im ken yesh hefresh beledat hazzachar leledat hannekeva, umitztzad ze yishtanne hahefresh bivchinat hammolidim, veyesh makom lomar letzad shettala hakkatuv zecharim binkevot lo yumetu avot al haavarat habbanim o haimmahot al haavarat habbanot letzad shettelaam hakkatuv baavot, talmud lomar "ish ish" – echad legufo veechad leishsha, sheshshenehem yeshnam bechiyyuv haavarat ben uvat.

Od nire, ki letzad sheamar hakkatuv "aviv veimmo", vedarshu razal (yalkut shemauni 619) sheaviv" ba lemaet avi aviv, veimmo" ba lemaet em immo shello yehargu, laze chash hakkatuv litot velomar shehammiut ba "aviv" velo aviha, "immo" velo immah, veim ken hannashim peturot meonesh ze, talmud lomar "ish ish" lerabbot ishsha.

rashi: Velo tishshavu vishmi. lamma neemar? lefi shenneemar lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav (Shemot 20), yachol lo yehe chayyav ella al shem hameyuchad, minnayin lerabbot kol hakkinnuyin? tal velo tishshavu vishmi lashshaker — kol shem sheyyesh li (sifra):
Vaakutz. leshon mius, kemo katzti vechayyay (Bereshit 27), keadam shehu katz bimzono (sifra):
Machazik beazne chalev. haover lehitabber al riv lo lo hare hu keochez beazne kalev, haggorem sheyyishshechennu al chinnam:
targum: Delached beudnoy dechalba netze umitnetze al dina dela dileh:

rashi: Tikkasse sina. haose maasav bammachshach umechasse bemashshaon, shehu choshech (0 shoat choshech), et haddavar hassanouy lehakkadosh baruch hu, sof shehakkadosh baruch hu megalle raato vekahal, sheyyakkiru bo shehu rasha (sota 9.):
targum: Dimchase senuata bemuresta titgele bishteh bichnishta:

rashi: Etten et panay. penay shelli — pone ani mikkol asakay veosek bo (shem):
Baish. velo vatztzibbur (shem), sheen kol hatztzibbur nichratin:

Ki mizzaro natan lammolech. lefi shenneemar maavir beno uvitto baesh (Devarim 18), ben beno uven bitto minnayin? tal ki mizzaro natan lammolech, zera pasul minnayin? tal betitto mizzaro lammolech (sifra; sanhedrin 64):
Lemaan tamme et mikdashi. et keneset yisrael shehi mekuddeshet li, kilshon velo yechallel et mikdashay (Vayikra 21):
ohc: Vaani etten et panay vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma makom leonesh ze, achar sheyyesh din lematta veyirgemu oto aven?

Venire ki yodia hakkatuv shemmillevad onesh hahariga, od yihye lo onesh lannefesh, vehu amro vehichratti oto mikkerev ammo, perush meanaf netzer hakkedushsha. venatan hakkatuv taam lishne onashim ellu veamar ki mizzaro vechulei lemaan tamme vegomer ulechallel vegomer, hare shene pegamim uchenegdan shene onashin: keneged tamme mikdash yirgemuhu baeven, ucheneged chillul shem kadsho gam hu yitchallel venichrat nafsho meammah.

rashi: Lo tonu. onaat devarim; lo tomar lo emesh hayita oved aza veachshav atta va lilmod tora shennittena mippi haggevura (bava metzia 58):
ohc: Vechi yagur ittecha vegomer. amar lashon yachid ittecha vechazar lomar leshon rabbim beartzechem. letzad ki hameshachat haggerim tihye beemtzaut hatztzaddik avraham avinu alav hashshalom, gam letzad tohar eretz hakkedosha tiggarer nafshot hashshevuyot, laze amar ittecha leshon yachid lirmoz el hatztzaddik, ki lo kullan hem begeder hameshachat anfe hakkedushsha, veamar beartzechem lirmoz lemaase haaretz, sheggam hi yeshnah begeder peulla tova zo.

Od yirmoz al hasheraat hashshechina baolam hazze ittanu, vitzav Adonai "ki yagur ittecha ger" mimmakom gavoah. dikdek lomar "ittecha" al derech (tehillim 78:60) "ohel shikken baadam". veamar beartzechem hi eretz hakkedosha ki sham mekom hashshechina, veazva mekomah elyon uvaa lagur baaretz. "lo tonu oto", sheen lecha onaa keonaat hashshechina. veamro keezrach mikkem vegomer lehazehir al haggerim vechulei habbaim lehityahed.

rashi: Al tifnu. azhara levaal ov veyiddeoni; baal ov ze pitom hamedabber mishshechyo, veyiddeoni hammachnis etzem chayya sheshshema yaddua letoch piv vehaetzem medabber (sanhedrin 65):
Al tevakshu. lihyot asukim bam, sheim taasku vam, attem mittammein lefanay vaani metaev etchem:
Ani Adonai elohechem. deu et mi attem machalifin bemi (sifra):

ohc: Vaani ettenenna vegomer eretz zavat vegomer. kashe, achar sheamar "lareshet otah" ma tzarich lomar "vaani ettenenna"? od, lamma samach shevach haaretz lezichron hayyerushsha? venire li shehakkavvana hi shemmillevad ma sheyyirshu, od yitten lahem shettihye haaretz zavat chalav udevash yoter mehashshiur ma shellefaneha, gam shalal shello bizman yerushshatam achar kach shehu zeman hachurban shello tihye zavat chalav udevash, kemo shessipperu makkireha bazzeman hazze baavonenu.

rashi: Veet habbehema taharogu. im adam chata behema me chata? ella mippene shebbaa laadam takkala al yadah lefichach amar hakkatuv tissakel, kal vachomer laadam, sheyyodea lehavechin ben tov lera, vegorem raa lachavero laavor avera; kayyotze vaddavar atta omer abbed teabbedun et kol hammekomot (Devarim 12), hare devarim kal vachomer, uma ilanot sheenan roin veenan shomin, al shebbat takkala al yadam amra tora hashechet, serof vechalle, hammatte et chavero midderech chayyim ledarche mita, al achat kamma vechamma (sifra):

Lo tochlu al haddam. leharebe fanim nidrash besanhedrin (daf 63): azhara shello yochal mibbeshar kadashim lifne zerikat damim, veazhara laochel mibbehemat chullin terem shettetze nafshah, veod harebe:
Lo tenachashu. kegon ellu hamenachashin bechulda uveofot, pitto nafla mippiv, tzevi hifsiko vadderech (sifra):
Velo teonenu. leshon onot veshaot, sheomer yom peloni yafe lehatechil melacha, shaa felonit kasha latzet (sanhedrin 65):
ohc: Lo tochlu al haddam samach hakkatuv mitzva zo lemitzvat arla, lirmoz ma sheamru zichronam livracha (midrash talepayvat, Bereshit Rabba 21:7) ki adam harishon chata baachilat etz haddaat kodem zeman hettero, shehu bechinat arla, sheim haya mamtin ad lel shabbat kodesh haya mekaddesh al hayyayin, veze hu sod divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (sanhedrin lach:) adam moshech bearlato haya, zo hi arlato, vehu ma sheamar hakkatuv samuch leazharat "vaaraltem arlato" – lo tochlu, perush, mipperi arla, al haddam, perush, al sibbat haddam, ki zo sibba lechol shefichut damim, dam adam vedam zariyyotav. veyesh lecha ladaat ki sibbat haaralot veikkaram ze mekoram, shezzulat chet adam lo hayta arla baolam lo shel tzomeach velo shel baale chayyim.

rashi: Lo techalle peat sadcha. sheyyanniach pea vesof sadehu (80 sifra):
Veleket ketzircha. shibbolim hannoshrim bishat ketzira, achat o shetayim, aval shalosh enan leket (pea 86):
ohc: Uvekutzrechem vegomer. taam shehitchil ledabber bilshon rabbim vegamar omer bilshon yachid lo techalle, nitkavven lishlol daat toim asher omrim ki kesheen davar maspik laaniyyim en lo litten, al derech amro (Melachim 2 4:43) "ma etten ze lifne mea" vegomer, laze tzivva Adonai bilshon yachid lomar sheafillu echad levad alav chovat pea, hagam ki pea shel adam echad muetet hi lechol aniyye yisrael, uchemo chen bemitzvot leket uferet veolelot amar leshon yachid mittaam hannizkar.

Vetaam semichut mitzva zo leonesh karet, ulay sheramaz shello yomar adam im hezid venitchayyev karet, meatta en lishmor atzmo mikkol asher yizdammen lefanav bemaase hara ki kevar nitchayyev karet, laze amar uvekutzrechem et ketzir artzechem perush, kesheggaram ad shenniktzar ketzir artzo shehu karet haamur besamuch, lo techalle peat sadcha liktzor otah bemaasim raim acherim. vehodia baze shello tikkaret kol hannefesh ella heanaf shebbo ramuz mitzva zo, vaadayin yeshnah lirot acherim devukim besharsham, ki chol nefesh yisrael yesh lah sharashim lemala keneged kol mitzvot hattora. veamar veleket ketzircha vegomer, perush afillu beanaf hachet atzmo lo yosif lachato, ki yesh lecha ladaat maamar harav haari zichrono livracha ki beteva hakkedushsha lehasheir bammakom shettihye bo roshem. veim ken hagam shennichrat adayin yesh hishshaarut hakkatzir sham, vehu shetztzivva alav veleket ketzircha lo telakket berov peshaim, ki Adonai chafetz shebbeemtzaut halleket hahu yitorer veyashuv bitshuva lifne Adonai virachamehu, ki halo timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (yoma 86.) sheafillu avar adam al keretot umitot bet din teshuva vechulei mechapperin, uchemaamar hannavi (Hoshea 14:2) "shuva vegomer ad Adonai elohecha", vedarshu zichronam livracha (sham) gedola teshuva shemmaggaat ad kisse hakkavod, perush, shehagam shennichrat hachut hamechabber ad kisse hakkavod velo nishar ella chelek katan bekirbo, hatteshuva maggiato ad kisse hakkavod:

rashi: Ken ish rimma. mefatte umesit et chavero middarche chayyim ledarche mavet, ucheshechavero margish shehu mate oto, omer: metzachek ani (Bereshit Rabba 53,11):
targum: Hechna gavra dimrame vechavreh vaamar migchach gachachet:

rashi: Asher yishkav et dodato. hammikra hazze ba lelammed al karet haamur lemala shehu veonesh halichat ariri:

Aririm. ketargumo, bela velad, vedome lo veanochi holech ariri (Bereshit 15); yesh lo vanim, kovran, en lo vanim, met belo vanim, lechach shinna vishne mikraot ellu — aririm "yamutu", aririm "yihyu", aririm yamutu. im yihyu lo vishat avera lo yihyu lo kesheyyamut, lefi shekkovran bechayyav, aririm yihyu. im en lo bishat avera, yihye chol yamav kemo shehu achshav (sifra; yevamot 55):

Lo tekallel cheresh. en li ella cheresh, minnayin lerabbot kol adam? tal beammecha lo taor (Shemot 22), im ken lamma neemar cheresh? ma cheresh meyuchad shehu vachayyim, af kol shehu vachayyim, yatza hammet sheeno vachayyim (sifra):
Velifne ivver lo titten michshol. lifne hassuma vedavar lo titten etza sheenah hogenet lo, al tomar mechor sadcha vekach lecha chamor, veatta okef alav venotlah hemennu (sham):

Veyareta meelohecha. lefi shehaddavar hazze eno masur labberiyyot leda im dato shel ze letova o leraa, veyachol lehishshamet velomar letova nitkavvanti, lefichach neemar bo veyareta meelohecha hammakkir machshevotecha; vechen kol davar hammasur lelibbo shel adam haosehu veen shear habberiyyot makkirot bo, neemar bo veyareta meelohecha:
Lehafitz otam. meaz hivtachtim lahafitzam: "ki tolid banim uvene vanim vegomer" (Devarim 4:25-27):
targum: Af ana kaymet bememri lehon bemadbera leaglaa yathon levene ammaya ulevadara yathon bimdinata:

rashi: Tavus nofet. tirmos beregel, kemo "navus kamenu" (tehillim 44:6):

Kol-mar matok. kol davar mar, matok lah. veyesh lefotro betalmud tora: hammare et atzmo kesavea, sheeno mitavve ledivre tora letaavat nefesh, tavus nofet. af hatteamim hameyushshavim al hallev enam chashuvim alav; vehammitavve lah, afillu devarim habbaim lo bimrirut uvigia hem metukim lo:
targum: Nafsha desava daysha chavrita venafsha dechafna kol medam dimrir chali lah:

rashi: Nodedet min kinnah. sheholechet umittaltelet, ken haish hannoded mimmekomo. talmid chacham hannoded min hallimmud, millachazor al girsato:
targum: Hech tzippera dimshana min kinah hechna hu gavra dimshane ducheteh:

rashi: Beyom bochori veyisrael. hare shehayta sina zo kevusha lifne hammakom karov litsha meot shana, mishshehayu bemitzrayim ad yechezkel, vehayta ahavato mechappa alehem; veal yede shehayu atta marbim lifshoa – nitorra, veal ze neemar "sina teorer medanim vegomer" (Mishlei 10:12):
targum: Vetemar lehon kidnan amar Adonai elohim beyoma deitreeti veyisrael vekaymet lehon bememri lezara devet yaakov veitgeleti lemifrakhon beara demitzrayim vekaymet bememri lehon lememar ana Adonai elohachon:

rashi: Lo taasu avel bammishpat. im ledin, hare kevar neemar lo taasu avel bammishpat (pasuk 15), umahu mishpat hashshanuy kan? hu hammidda vehammishkal vehammesura, melammed shehammoded nikra dayyan, sheim shikker bammidda hare hu chimkalkel et haddin, vekaruy avval, sanouy umeshukkatz, cherem vetoeva, vegorem lachamishsha devarim haamurim baddayyan — metamme et haaretz, umechallel et hashshem, umesallek et hashshechina, umappil et yisrael bacherev, umagle otam meartzam (sifra):
Bammidda. zo middat haaretz (sham):
Bammishkal. kemashmao:
Uvammesura. hi middat hallach vehayyavesh (bava metzia sefer acher):
Shemen uketoret. reach shemen afarsemon vereach ketoret mesammechin lev:

Umetek reehu meatzat nafesh. mi shechavero mekarvo umemattek lo bidvarav, hu tov mimma shennafsho yoatzto. davar acher: umetek reehu hammachshir maasav, shehen metukin lehakkadosh baruch hu, tov lo mimma shehu memalle taavat libbo:
targum: Mishcha uvusema demachadyan libba hechna gavra dimvasim lechavre betarita denafsheh:

rashi: Kore shachat. kegon bilam, shehissi etza levalak al yisrael vehippil mehem esrim vearbaa elef (Bamidbar 25:9), uva lemidyan litboa secharo veneherag beyad yisrael (Bamidbar 31:8):
Vegolel. kelomar: sofo shel hammaamid michshol, sheyyikkashel bo:

Vegolel even. megallelo mimmakom lemakom, sheyyikkashlu bo bene adam. veaggada potro (tanchuma Buber, vayyar koach) baavimelech sheharag shivim echav al even achat, vesof met baeven, shenneemar "vattashlech ishsha achat pelach rechev vattaritz gulgalto vegomer" (Shoftim 9:53):
targum: Dechafer gumetza beh nippul vedimargel kefa aloy hafcha:

rashi: Hatishpot otam. leshon vikkuach:
targum: Hatochach yathon hatochach bar adam yat toavat avahathon hodainun:

rashi: Lo tignovu. azhara legonev mamon, aval lo tignov shebbaaseret haddibberot azhara legonev nefashot, davar hallamed meinyano — davar shechayyavin alav mitat bet din:
Velo techachashu. lefi shenneemar (Vayikra Adonai), vechichesh bah meshallem keren vechomesh, lamadnu onesh, azhara minnayin? talo velo techachashu:
Velo teshakkeru. lefi shenneemar (sham), venishba al shaker yeshallem keren vechomesh, lamadnu onesh, azhara minnayin? tal velo teshakkeru:
Lo tignovu velo techachashu velo teshakkeru velo tisbeu. im ganavta sofcha lechachesh, sofcha leshakker, sofcha lishshava lashsheker:
ohc: Lo tignovu vegomer. samach mitzvat geneva lemitzvat peat sade. ulay shennitkavven al derech ma sheamru betorat kohanim (kan) veze leshonam: ben bag bag omer, lo tignov et shellecha mehaggannav shello terae kegonev, ad kan. vechan nitkavven bema shessamach "lo tignovu" lefea, shebba aleha beazhara leval yignov otah bechashvo ki shello hu lokeach.

Uferush shelosha lavin ellu hu: lo tignovu – ze hallokeach mamon chavero shello midiato. lo techachashu – ze habba leyado mamon chavero behetter umechachesh keshettovo mimmennu. lo teshakkeru – ze habba leyado mamon chavero beedim vehu mechachesh, hagam shello toil lo hachechashato leinyan mamon, hare ze over mishshum "lo teshakkeru".

Od yirmoz sheim adam avar al harishona veganav, hakkadosh baruch hu yazmin lo makkirin, al derech amram zichronam livracha (chagiga 16.; Bamidbar Rabba 89) haover avera beseter hakkadosh baruch hu machriz alav umefarsem rishato, veim ken im ganav – Adonai yazmin mi sheyyeda bignevato, umetzavve oto Adonai shello yechachesh, vehu amro lo techachashu, umedabber hakkatuv beofen sheyyachol lehachechisho kegon sheen kan ella ed echad, im hoda ma tov, veim hichchish haroe, hakkadosh baruch hu yazmin lo ed sheni sheyyaid alav sheeno yachol lehachechish, veim yachchish, sheker bimino velo yoilu shekarav, vehu amro lo teshakkeru shemmillevad shello hoilu maasav hinne hu over gam al lav ze.

Vetaam amro leshon rabbim, ma shello amar beseder ze ad atta, gam bammitzvot hassemuchot milleacharav amar leshon yachid, dichtiv "lo taashok" vegomer. venire shennitkavven lehazehir gam bizman sheyyakkir echad bachavero shegganav o kichesh vechulei, shello yomar eese ken gam ani lehatztzil et shelli. laze amar leshon rabbim lo tignovu, perush, hagam shehu ganav lo tosif atta lehareshia kamohu veteasu shenechem gannavim. uchemo chen im yechachesh chavercha lo tosif gam atta asot kamohu utechachashu shenechem. uchemo chen im shikker becha chavercha vechulei, veamar velo tishshavu gam ken shello yomar im hu makkir shechavero nishba lo lashsheker hareni nishba lehatztzil mamoni mimmennu, venishbain laannasim, shehare atta mechallel shem vechulei, velaze gamar omer leshon yachid, lomar shemmedabber im mi shemmatztzil mamon atzmo bishvua, veen tzarich lomar hannishba rishon haramuz bichlal "lo tishshavu". od yechavven beamro lo tishshavu lehazehir gam lammashbia im yodea shechavero nishba lashsheker shello yashbiehu, veeno bechillul ella hannishba, laze amar vechillalta leshon yachid.

rashi: Lo telech rachil. ani omer al shem shekkol meshalleche medanim umesappere lashon hara holchim bevatte reehem leraggel ma yiru ra, o ma yishmeu ra, lesapper bashshuk, nikraim holche rachil — holche regila, ashepayymenat belaaz. ureaya lidvaray, shello matzinu rechilut sheen katuv bilshon halicha, lo telech rachil, holche rachil nechoshet uvarzel (Yirmeyahu 6), ushear lashon hara en katuv bo halicha, melashni vasseter reehu (Tehillim 101), lashon remiyya (sham 120), lashon medabberet gedolot (sham 12); lechach ani omer shehallashon holech umeraggel, shehakkaf nechelefet begimel, shekkol haotiyyot shemmotzaehem mimmakom echad mitchallefot zo vazo, bet befe vegimel bechaf vekof, venun belamed, vezayin betzadi, vechen vayraggel beavdecha (Shmuel 2 19) — riggel bemirma lemor alay raa, vechen lo ragal al leshono (Tehillim 15), vechen rochel — hassocher umeraggel achar kol sechora, vechen hammocher besamim lehitkashshet bahem hannashim, al shem shemmechazzer tamid baayarot, nikra rochel leshon rogel; la techul kuretzin kemo vaachalu kartzehon di yehudaye (Daniel 3:8), achal beh kuretza be malka (berachot 58:); nire veenay shehaya mishpatam leechol bevet hamekabbel divrehem shum haleata, vehu gemar chizzuk sheddevarav mekuyyamim veyaamidem al haemet, veotah haleata nikret achilat kuretzin, leshon koretz beenav (Mishlei 6), shekken derech kol holche rachil likrotz beenehem velirmoz divre rechilutan, shello yavinu shear hashshomim:
Lo taamod al dam reecha. lirot bemitato veatta yachol lehatztzilo, kegon tovea bannahar vechayya o listim baim alav (sanhedrin 73):
Ani Adonai. neeman leshallem sachar, veneeman lippara:
ohc: Lo telech rachil vegomer. kadmu razal besefer hazzohar hakkadosh vedikdeku kefel haddevarim, telech, rachil, ki achat henna, veamru derech sod yeuyyan sham divrehem baidra (Zohar nasha 128.). ulefi peshat hakkatuv nire sheyyechavven lomar shello yigrom hu harchilut hannaase mehazzulat al yado, ha ketzad? shello yegalle devarim afillu lemi sheen bahem rechilut bemakom sheyyesh lachush shehashshomim yolichu haddevarim, venimtza hu holich rechilut zo sherichlu haemtzaim. ulederech ze yeduyyak amro beammecha, perush, beemtzaut ammecha atta molich rachil, sheomrim haddevarim bifnehem umitgalgelim mizze laze venishmaim haddevarim. veamar ani Adonai perush, ani bochen haddevarim mimmi yatzu techilla uforea.
Od yirtze, shello yachazik bide medabbere lashon hara, shebbaze hu sovev sheyyolichu harachil, umaale alav hakkatuv keillu hu holich rechilut laze lihyoto sibba.

Lo taamod vegomer. letzad shetztzivva al harchilut, hitna bo shello yaamod al dam reecha, sheim raa kat achat sherotzin lirtzoach chayyav lehodio levaal davar kede sheyyatztzil nafsho, velo yomar hare ze rechilut. ha lamadta sheim lo gala ozen chavero vaharaguhu, bittel azharat "lo taamod" vegomer. vetze ulemad mimmaase gedalya ben achikam (yirmeya 40:14) sheggillu lo, ucheshello chash haya ma shehaya.

rashi: Batztzallachat. beyora chamma noten yado, mippene hakkor:
targum: Atla matshe aydeh beshachata lae denehfeche lefumeh:

rashi: Vaavdil etchem min haammim lihyot li. im attem muvdalim mehem hare attem shelli, veim lav hare attem shel nevuchadnetztzar vachaverav; rabbi elazar ben azarya omer minnayin shello yomar adam nafshi katza bivsar chazir, i efshi lilbosh kilayim, aval yomar efshi uma eese veavi shebbashshamayim gazar alay? tal vaavdil etchem min haammim lihyot li, shettehe havedalatchem mehem lishmi — poresh min haavera umekabbel alav ol malchut shamayim (sifra):
ohc: Vihyitem li kedoshim vegomer taam amro li, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (torat kohanim kan): al yomar adam i efshi bivsar chazir vechulei, ella efshi veefshi, ella avi shebbashshamayim vechulei, vehu amro vihyitem li kedoshim – shettihyu perushim li leshem mitzvotay velo letzad tiuv haddavar hanneesar. velaze samach maamar ze lehavedalat behema vechayya lirmoz lema shekkatavti.

Veamro ki kadosh ani Adonai vegomer, natan taam lemitzva zo shel havedalat behema temea, ki kadosh vegomer vaavdil etchem min haammim lihyot li. vehainyan atzmo shel perishut yisrael min haakkum hu haddavar atzmo shel perishatchem min habbehema temea. baruch Adonai asher hivdilanu min hattemeim meadam ad behema ad of hashshamayim:
Chassalat parashat kedoshim

rashi: Lihyot leot. ot gadol hu lahem, shennatatti et yom menuchati lahem limnucha; hare hekker gadol shekkiddashtim li:
targum: Veaf yat yome shabbaya dili yehavet lehon lemeheve leat ben memri uvenehon lemeda are ana Adonai mekadshehon:

ohc: Ushemartem et vegomer. taam shehutzrach lomar paam acheret pasuk ze, hagam shekkevar amar ken befarashat achare mot (Vayikra 18:26), nitkavven lomar shetztzerichin lishmor hammitzvot leval yitbattelu ben mehem ben mizzulatam, uvaze lo taki haaretz. ha lamadta sheim lo yihyu nishmarim hammitzvot taki haaretz gam hashshomrim, al shello michu beshello shamru.

rashi: Vayyamru vi. hem harshaim, rubbam shel yisrael, shemmetu bishloshet yeme afela, kemo shenneemar "vachamushim alu vene yisrael vegomer" (Shemot 13:18) – echad mechamishshim, veyesh omrim: echad mechamesh meot (mechilta ba 12):
targum: Vesarivu al memri vela avu lekabbala linviye gevar yat shikutze enehon la archiku veyat pulechan taavat mitzrae la shevaku vaamaret lemishpach chemti alehon deyachul rugezi behon bego ara demitzrayim:

rashi: Lo taashok. ze hakkovesh sechar sachir (bava metzia sefer acher):
La talin. leshon nekeva, musav al happeula:

Ad boker. bischir yom hakkatuv medabber, sheyyetziato mishsheshshaka chamma, lefichach zeman gibbuy secharo kol hallayla, uvemakom acher hu omer velo tavo alav hashshemesh (Devarim 24), medabber bishochir layla, shehashelamat peullato mishsheyyaale ammud hashshachar, lefichach zeman gibbuy secharo kol hayyom, lefi shennatna tora zeman levaal habbayit ona levakkesh maot (bava metzia 110):
ohc: Lo taashok vegomer. hakkavvana, leheyot shetztzivva Adonai al notel mamon chavero shello bidiato, al yomar adam shello hikpid ella bederech geneva, aval gezela veoshek asher yada haadam bahem en azhara, laze chazar letzauot gam al notel mamon chavero bidiato keones, velo gezelat mamon behechlet levad ella afillu akkavat mamon sachir asur.

Vetaam amro reacha, nitkavven lishlol taanat heyoto reo, uveemtzaut ze yitten yad bemamono veyomar kerea keach lo beno leven atzmo yimchol lo velo yachpotz lehaanisho, uletzad sheen beazhara zo ella mishshum devarim shebben adam lachavero, keshehu mochel en avon, laze amar lo taashok et reacha.

Uvederech remez yirmoz al derech ma sheddarshu chazal (berachot la:) befasuk "gozel aviv veimmo" vegomer, ze hannehene mehaolam hazze belo beracha, ad kan, vehu maamar Adonai kan lo taashok et reacha ze hakkadosh baruch hu, dichtiv (Mishlei 27:10) "reacha verea avicha", shello yigzol berachot shehu chayyav levarech al ma shennehene baolam hazze. veamro velo tigzol remez sheggam beoshek ze yesh gezela laacherim, shehu ma sheramaz befasuk "gozel aviv veimmo", vedarshu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sham) aviv ze hakkadosh baruch hu, immo zo keneset yisrael, ki keshehaadam memaet bammitzva hatztzarich asot gorem raa gam lichlalut yisrael. veamar lo talin shetztzarich latet chok yom beyomo, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 26:4) shehayu lovim bayyom uforim ballayla, vehu ma sheramaz kan "lo talin peullat sachir ittecha", perush tevat "ittecha" chozeret lesachir shehu ruach Adonai asher natan baadam kesachir ketoshav, usecharo hu asot mitzvot Adonai.

Od yirmoz al derech amram zichronam livracha ki bene tora en lahem parnasatam baolam hazze, ucheamram (yalkut Mishlei 247 934) sheamra tora mippene ma banay aniyyim, vehattaam hu shamati taam nachon mishshem haari zichrono livracha ki en haolam yachol lisbol rov hattova asher tinnaten bishvil hatztzaddikim, laze eno mashpia ella labbenonim vederech sham yihyu nizzonim bene tora. ha lamadta sheen haashirim ella marzev asher huchan lehistappekut hatztzorech latztzaddikim, vetzivva Adonai leval yaashok haadam et reehu shehu hatztzaddik, dichtiv (Tehillim 122:8) "lemaan achay vereay", velo yitten lo et chukko, veze oshek mefursam.

Od yirmoz shello yaashok tevat "et" sheetzel "reacha" shehu hakkadosh baruch hu, kemo sheddarash rabbi akiva (fesachim 22:) "et Adonai elohecha tira" lerabbot talmide chachamim. vehakkavvana baze liro mehachachamim haddanim baaretz, vechevan shekken hare yesh elohim shoftim baaretz asher yira mehem lekayyem devar mishpat, uvaze lo yigzol ki hashshofet yotzi gezela mimmennu.

rashi: Veseret lanefesh. ken darkan shel emoriyyim lihyot mesartin besharam keshemmet lahem met:
Uchetovet kaaka. ketav mechukke veshakua sheeno nimchak leolam shemmekakeo bemachat vehu mashchir leolam:
Kaaka. leshon vehoka otam (Bamidbar 25), vehokanum (Shmuel 2 21), tochavin etz baaretz vetolin otam alehem, venimtzeu mechukkin utechuvin bakkarka, paverapevaynat belaaz:
ohc: Veseret lanefesh vegomer. amro lanefesh, lomar hagam shehasseret chibbul hagguf hu al peredat hannefesh hayekara. vedikdek lomar lo tittenu bivsarchem, hodia hakkatuv ki lo yifgom pegam ze bannefesh ella babbasar shehu nartek hannefesh. vehattaam letzad sheadam bahul al meto (shabbat mag) en hammaase pogem kol kach keose bishat benefesh uveyishshuv haddaat. velaze timtza sheamar hakkatuv achare ze uchetovet kaaka lo tittenu bachem velo amar "bivsarchem", lomar shello babbasar levad yigrom happegam ella gam bifnimiyyut haadam, letzad sheeno ose mitztzad tzaar vechom hakkeev shennomar bo (bava batra 16:) en adam nitpas al tzaaro.

Veamro ani Adonai – yitbaer al pi maamar haelohi harashbi (Zohar 11 247), ki tevat "ani" taggid al kisse kevodo yitbarach asher anu korim shechinato yitbarach, veshem havaya baruch hu hu melech yoshev al kisse hammalchut, veramaz baze ki yakpid Adonai al kevod shemo yitbarach veal kevod shechinato, ulederech ze yetzav Adonai lehaadam leval yifgom gufo venishmato bishne maasim harshumim shehem seret lanefesh uchetovet kaaka.

rashi: Chesed hu. leshon arammi cherpa chissuda; umidrasho im tomar kayin nasa achoto chesed asa hammakom, livnot olamo mimmennu, shenneemar (Tehillim 89), olam chesed yibbane (sifra; sanhedrin 58):
Yinnacher sone. bedibburo mitnakker hassone, shello yakkiru shehu sone. dishkenoyisht belaaz:
targum: Man sifvateh mityeda sana uvegaveh saem ramyuta:

rashi: Ish immo veaviv tirau. kol echad mikkem tiru aviv veimmo, zehu feshuto; umidrasho: en li ella ish, ishsha minnayin? keshehu omer tirau hare chan shenayim, im ken lamma neemar ish? shehaish sefek beyado laasot aval ishsha reshut acherim aleha (sifra; kiddushin 30):

Immo veaviv tirau. kan hikdim em laav, lefi sheggaluy lefanav shehabben yare et aviv yoter meimmo, uvakkavod hikdim av laem, lefi sheggaluy lefanav shehabben mechabbed et immo yoter meaviv, mippene shemmeshaddalto vidvarim (sham):
Veet shabbetotay tishmoru. samach shabbat lemora av, lomar af al pi shehizharticha al mora av, im yomar lecha challel et hashshabbat, al tishma lo, vechen bishar kol hammitzvot (bava metzia 32):

Ani Adonai elohechem. atta veavicha chayyavim bichvodi, lefichach lo tishma lo levattel et devaray. ezehu mora? lo yeshev bimkomo velo yedabber bimkomo velo yistor et devarav, veezehu chavod? maachil umashke, malbish umanil, machnis umotzi (kiddushin 31):
ohc: Ish immo vegomer. taam semichut mitzva zo lemitzvat kedoshim, nitkavven lirmoz gam ken geder laarayot, vehu al derech maamaram zichronam livracha (sota lo:) sheddarshu bappasuk "vayyafozzu zeroe yadav mide avir yaakov" vegomer ki keshettakfato eshet potifar leyosef utekafo yitzro, nizdammena lo deyokan aviv veamar lo vechulei, miyyad "vayyafozzu zeroe" vegomer. veshamati mishshem anshe emet (102 hayyashar 82) ki deyokan haav tagbir koach hakkedushsha babben vetimnaehu mibbo el hattiuv, vehu amro samuch lemitzvat haarayot aviv veimmo tirau. velaze mi shettekafo yitzro yetzayyer ben enav yoldav veyihye lo lemeshiv nefesh.

Gam yirmoz ki baasoto hammezimmata yevazze kevod aviv, velaze yetzav hael samuch lemitzvat haarayot mitzvat morao shel av vaem, ha lamadta sheim gilla arayot bittel mitzvat mora av vaem, sheggaram lahem zilzul sheyyomru arur shezzo yalad vechulei. ulederech ze hikdim haem laav letzad shehi notelet hacherpa beyoter, al derech amro (Mishlei 10:1) "uven kesil tugat immo".

Ulederech ze hirvachnu taam nachon gam bismichut veet shabbetotay tishmoru, vehu al derech amro zichronam livracha bazzohar (10 277, 11 301) ki shiva tzaddikim yittachnu lahem shivat yeme hashshavua, veamru bezohar chadash (resh parashat toldot) ki yom shabbat hu keneged yosef hatztzaddik, vehu sod hashshalom, velaze anu omrim shabbat shalom veanu mevarchin "happores sukkat shalom", vehi bechinat yesod hakkol, veyosef letzad tzidkato asher shamar ot berit kodesh miggeshet el hattuma yarash bechina zo. vehu ma sheamar kan veet shabbetotay shete shabbatot: achat shemirat atzmo milletamme ot berit kodesh, veachat shemirat shabbat, ushenehem bechina achat, velaze nikraim shenehem otot, beshabbat amar (Shemot 31:13) "ot hi beni" vegomer, uvemila amar (Bereshit 17:11) "vehaya leot". veteda ki shete habbechinot beerech hammaasi hem shetayim, aval baerech hammesubbav mehem hu bechina achat, vehashshomer echad mehem yesovev hattikkun vehitkashsherut nafsho bishte hammitzvot, velaze amar veet shabbetotay.

Veaviv tirau. betorat kohanim amru, shebbemakom echad hikdim hakkatuv av laem, dichtiv (Shemot 20:12): "kabbed et avicha veet immecha" vegomer, uvemakom acher hikdim immo vechulei, lomar sheshshenehem shekulim. aval amru chachamim haav kodem laem. gam habbarayta, huvea bekiddushin daf 31, darash rabbi veze leshono: galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya vegomer shebben mechabbed leimmo vechulei, lefichach hikdim kevod av vechulei, vegaluy veyadua vechulei shehabben mityare meaviv vechulei, lefichach hikdim Adonai mora haem vechulei, ad kan. vekashe li lishte hadderashot, ki keshennaskil bainyan bishne hakketuvim hechshiv hakkatuv haav yoter mehaem: befasuk "kabbed" vegomer hismich haav lakkavod beamro "kabbed et avicha", gam befasuk ze hismich haav lammora beamro "veaviv tirau", uvederech hazze matzinu lerazal sheddarshu bechamma mekomot. vehen emet im lo haya din yotze midderech ze hayiti yachol lefaresh hakkatuv kidvarenu, shekkevar harshut netuna lanu lefaresh hakkatuv hagam sheyyihye beseder acher meshunne middivre harishonim, kol sheen haddin mishtanne, aval bema shellefanenu yishtanne haddin, im nitgarsha haem, ki lefi ma shepperashnu shehattora hikdima bishne hammikraot haav laem, im yomar aviv "hashekeni mayim" veimmo omeret "hashekeni mayim" im lehakedim aviv laem. uledivre rabbotenu sheamru shehem shavim, ella letzad shehu veimmo chayyavin bichvod aviv, im nitgarsha sheen taam ze, ratza yakdim leaviv ratza yakdim leimmo. vechen amru sham bekiddushin bishelat ben almana achat et rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, veze leshonam: nitgarsha mahu? amar lo: hattel lahem mayim besefel vechulei, ad kan. hare lisvarat rabbi eliezer shekulim hem mammash.

Veulay ki lefi ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha sham betorat kohanim, veze leshonam: "ish"- en li ella ish, ishsha minnayin? talmud lomar "tirau". im ken lamma neemar "ish"? mippene shehaish sippek beyado, ishsha en sippek beyadah laasot, ad kan. hinne ledivre barayta zo neemar "ish" lemaet ishsha beinyan hakkavod. emor meatta shelleinyan hakkavod neemar "ish immo" vegomer, uveim eno inyan, uchefi ze yeshnah lehakedamat em bivchinat hakkavod. vechol ze leyashshev barayta detorat kohanim, aval lidrashat rabbi sheddarash shehikdim hakkatuv em laav bivchinat hammora vechulei (kiddushin lo.) adayin kashe. veulay kevan sheen ze ella derech aggada veen yotze mizze din, hadderasha tiddaresh, shehare sof sof hikdim hakkatuv em laav, shehaya lo lomar "ish yira immo veaviv", vahagam shehuchrach hakkatuv ledabber beseder ze lomar "ish" lemaet ishsha mechiyyuv hakkavod velomar "tirau" lerabbot bivchinat hammora, af al pi chen sof sof hare seder haem kodem laav vehaaggada nitlet beremez kol shehu.

Od nire lomar, ki hattannaim lo nira lahem lomar shelletzad shehismich hakkatuv zichron hammora laav yihye gadol mehaem, mittaam shehakkatuv huchrach bemaasav ledabber beseder ze "ish vegomer tirau" kede shennidrosh miut veribbuy benashim. vechevan shekken nomar befe male shehakkodem bappasuk hu harishon, veamar "tirau" levassof lo lehasemich lah haav kede sheyyihye bemaala yoter mehaem, ella lidrosh mimmenna ribbuy chiyyuv haishsha bemora horim.

Od nire lomar taam sheamar leshon yachid vegamar omer leshon rabbim, nitkavven lomar ki keshehabben yihye yare meaviv gorem gam ken shebbeno yihye yare mimmennu. ibbaet ema lema shekkadam bidvarenu bimkomot acherim (Bereshit 49:3), ki sharshe hakkedushsha venegdehem hannimtzaim bammolid yaasu kayyotze bahem bannoladim; veibbaet ema midderech hammusar, ki kesheyyire habben sheaviv mezalzel bichvod aviv yifka kelilat morao gam ken mimmennu, uchesheadam yare meaviv vechulei habben lokeach musar. gam yashrishu benefesh habben bechinat mifal hattov, venimtza mekayyem shene moraim, vehu amro ish leshon yachid, tirau leshon rabbim, ki bemora echad yereim shenayim, veze amram (avot 4:2) mitzva goreret mitzva.

O yomar al derech ma sheppasak hattur siman 240, veze leshono: venire li kevan shehu rasha eno chayyav bichvodo, kidamrinan (bava kamma tzad:) gabbe hinniach lahem para gezula chayyavin lehachezir mishshum kevod avihem, ufarich bashas vahalo lav ose maase ammecha veen chayyavin bichvodo, umeshanne kesheasa teshuva, alma kol shello asa teshuva en chayyavin bichvodo, ad kan leshono. sover harav sheen lehacheziko beasa teshuva ella kesherinuhu sheasa davka. vehu maamar hakkatuv ish immo veaviv, perush, ish shemmitnaheg im immo veaviv keminhag av vaem – laze tirau, aval mi shemmezalzel bichvod aviv veimmo patur mimmora. vetevat "immo veaviv" chozeret laish hammolid venimshechet gam ken letirau", lehaggid al mi baa mitzvat tirau, vehaven.

Vegam lefi ma shekkatavti bechibburi peri toar, veheemadnu divre rambam shekkatav shemmin hassetam muchzak bechazar bitshuva, vehochachato mehahi sheamru beshas (kiddushin mat.) beomer leishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li al menat sheani tzaddik gamur" vechulei, sheanu omrim asa teshuva hagam shello reinuhu sheasa vechulei, vedachinu reayat hattur shehevi mehinniach lahem avihem para gezula, ki shani hahu shemmaasav mochichim shello chazar bitshuva, shehare odenna lefarat chattato omedet chayya af ki achare moto, aval kol sheen hochacha kazo min hassetam yaamod bechezkat shechazar, gam lefi ze yaamdu devarenu bizman sheanu roim vadday sheeno mechabbed veen makom lachush litshuva vechaddome lehanniach para gezula, ish kaze paka kevodo umorao mibbanav kaasher asa.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha behahi uveda dehahu gavra vechulei, veshama veshamteh mishshum "lifne ivver lo titten michshol", vehu maamar hakkatuv kan "tirau" leshon rabbim, hagam shello tzivva ella leechad dichtiv "ish", af al pi chen hammitzva muttelet al hayyare veal hammityare, leval yigrom lamtzuvve shello yira, shello yesovvehu likkashel.

Veet shabbetotay tishmoru vegomer. razal amru (bava metzia lev:) minnayin sheim amar lo aviv challel shabbat vechulei shello yishma lo, dichtiv "ish immo vegomer veet shabbetotay vegomer ani Adonai" – sheatta veavicha chayyavin bichvodi, ad kan. hinne letaam "atta veavicha" vechulei sheddarshu meamro "ani Adonai" muvan ki kammishpat hazze yihye bechol mitzvot hattora, hagam sheenam chamurim keshabbat, kegon hashavat aveda velittamme lemetim. im ken lamma lo hismich ella mitzvat shabbat shehi chamura, shehaya lo lehasemich mitzva acheret kalla? gam baze lo haya tzarich lintinat taam "ani Adonai" lehavi mimmenna shear mitzvot kallot.

Veyitbaer al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek Adonai mehilchot mamrim veze leshono: hayu aviv veimmo reshaim gemurim vechulei asur lo lehakkotam vechulei, ad kan. vediyyeku kol haacharonim ki davka lehakkotam asur, aval kevodam umoraam eno chayyav bo. veheeleti bechibburi al yore dea beyishshuv divre rambam im ma shekkatav beferek 7 mehilchot mamrim shechayyav lechabbedam, ki lo katav ken ella bemi sheavar ketzat averot leteavon beakray, vechan medabber bemi shehuchzak beresha gamur, velaze dikdek bilshono "reshaim gemurim" velo hispik lomar "reshaim". vesover ani shershaim gemurim hem ovrim al kol haaverot habbaot leyadam, ellu eno chiyyuv al habben liro mehem ulechabbedam. vehu maamar hakkatuv kan ish immo veaviv tirau, utenay hu haddavar veet shabbetotay tishmoru kullechem avot uvanim, veduk minnah sheim haavot lo yishmeru shabbetot Adonai hare paka mitzvat moraam, ki shakul shabbat keneged kol hattora kullah (Shemot Rabba 25:12) venikra rasha gamur.

Od yitparesh kol hakkatuv bederech remez, behair od lamma amar shabbetotay leshon rabbim velo leshon yachid kadderech haragil bechol hattora. verazal amru (shabbat 69:) shebba litten shemira achat leshabbatot harebe, vehakkavvana baze sheim asa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe behelem shabbat eno chayyav ella chattat achat. venire al derech ma sheamru besefer hazzohar (10 5:) ki "shabbetotay" yirmoz lallayla velayyom, veze leshono: da shabbeta umaale shabbeta, ki layla kayyom yitkaddesh, uletzad shebbechinat layla eno shave likdushshat yom ki hallayla hu bechinat or hammityaches elav kalla vehu bechinat "shamor", vehayyom hu bechinat or elyon hammityaches elav bechinat chatan hammashpia beor hallayla kayyadua leyode chen, velaze yityaches elav "zachor". velaze amar bazzohar (10 88.) ki seudat layla hi seudat chakal tappuchin kaddishin useudat yom hi seuda attika kaddisha av harachamim, velaze yikkare kiddush hayyom bilshon chazal (fesachim kav.) kiddusha rabba. veshamati gam raiti katuv (besof 376 253) maase shebbime rabbi avraham ibben ezra amad toe echad vechatav birayot ki yom shabbat yakdim bo hayyom veachar kach hallayla, venitgalla haddavar leharav al yede nes vesatar moatzotav vechulei dirshu meal sifro (iggeret shabbat). ucheneged daat toa zo dibber hakkatuv veamar ish immo veaviv tirau, hikdim em laav vehishva lemitzva zo mitzvat hashshabbat veamar veet shabbetotay shehem layla veyom vechulei, lomar sheggam bahem yakdim bechinat haem shehi layla livchinat haav shehu hayyom, shekkeseder horim ken seder shabbatot maale shabbeta veshabbeta, velo kedaat hattoim hannizkeret.

rashi: Od zot. hosifu laasot keshehaviotim el haaretz:
targum: Bechen itnabbe levet yisrael bar adam vetemar lehon kidnan amar Adonai elohim od da argizu kadmay avahatchon bidshakaru bememri shekar:

rashi: Natatti lahem chukkim lo tovim. mesartim beyad yitzram lehikkashel baavonam; vechen tirgem yonatan: "umesartinun beyad yitzrehon tafsha, vaazalu vaavadu gezeran dela taknan venimusin dela yitkayyemu behon":
targum: Veaf ana midmardu vememre vela avu lekabbala linviay archektinun umesartinun beyad sanehon uvatar yitzrehon tippesha azalu vaavadu gezeran dela taknan venimusin dela itkayemtun behon:

rashi: Lo taasu avel bammishpat. melammed shehaddayyan hamekalkkel et haddin karuy avval, sanuy umeshukkatz, cherem vetoeva, shehaavel karuy toeva, shenneemar ki toavat Adonai vegomer kol ose avel (Devarim 25), vehattoeva keruya cherem vesheketz shenneemar velo tavi toeva el betecha vehayita cherem kamohu shakketz teshakketzennu vegomer (sham 7):
Lo tissa pene dal. shello tomar ani hu ze, veheashir chayyav lefarneso, azakkennu vaddin venimtza mitparnes binkiyyut (sifra):
Velo tehdar pene gadol. shello tomar ashir hu ze, ben gedolim hu ze, heach avayyeshennu veere bevashto? onesh yesh baddavar lechach neemar velo tehdar pene gadol:
Betzedek tishpot amitecha. kemashmao; davar acher: heve dan et chavercha lechaf zechut (shavuot 30):
ohc: Lo taasu avel bammishpat. azhara zo baa levaale dinim shello yaarimu lizkot kefi haddin, vehu avel, velaze amar bilshon rabbim "lo taasu" vegomer, veshiur amro avel bammishpat hu al ze hadderech, bammishpat asher yishpetu haddayyanim shello yesovvu sheyyihye bo avel, ki haddayyan shofet al pi hatteanot asher yesadderu lefanav, velaze samach mitzva zo leazharat "lifne ivver" vegomer, ki ze machshil haddayyan lishpot mishpat meuvval.

Od yirtze lomar, shehagam shehammishpat zikkahu, lo yismoch laasot avel kesheyyakkir beatzmo ki avel bimino, velaze amar bilshon rabbim ki yedabber levaale dinim, uvesamuch shekkavvanato letzauot lashshofet amar leshon yachid "lo tissa" "lo tehdar" vegomer.

Od yechavven beamro lo taasu avel azhara ledayyan, shehagam shehammishpat yaggid lechayyev et ze ulezakkot et ze, im beenav nire ki hu avel – lo yaasu avel ze bishvil ma shennitchayyev bammishpat, ella en ledayyan ella ma sheenav root.

Od yirtze beamro bammishpat beHei hayedia, al derech amram zichronam livracha (betza 16.) ki berosh hashshana kotzev hakkadosh baruch hu lechol ish veish hatztzarich lo al mishpat tzedek, velaze im yechayyevu hazzakkay vizakku hachayyav hinne hu yotze avel bemishpat elyon besach katzuv, ucheshemmechassero im ken naasa haavel bammishpat shello natal ze ma shechayyav bevet din shel mala, vechen lehefech:

rashi: Veim heachol yeachel vegomer. im eno inyan lechutz lizmanno, shehare chevar neemar veim heachol yeachel mibbesar zevach shelamav vegomer (Vayikra 7), tenehu inyan lechutz limkomo; yachol yihyu chayyavin karet al achilato, talo vehannefesh haochelet mimmennu avonah tissa, "mimmennu" velo mechavero, yatza hannishchat bemachashevet chutz limkomo (zevachim 28):
Piggul. metoav, kemo umerak piggulim kelehem (Yeshayahu 65):
Uvemishpachto. amar rabbi shimon vchi mishpacha me chata? ella lelammedcha sheen lecha mishpacha sheyyesh bah moches sheen kullam mochsin — shekkullan mechappin alav (sifra; shavuot 39):
Vehichratti oto. lamma neemar? lefi shenneemar uvemishpachto yachol yihyu chol hammishpacha behikkaret, tal oto — oto behikkaret velo chol hammishpacha behikkaret ella beyissurin (sham):
Liznot achare hammolech. lerabbot shear aza sheavadah bechach vaafillu en zo avodatah (sifra):
ohc: Vesamti ani et panay vegomer. mashmaut hakkatuv yaggid sheim lo yaase mishpat haam, yaase Adonai mishpat bo uvemishpachto gam ken, ma shello haya im hayu osim din am haaretz, veellu hem devarim rechokim, mimma nafshach, im hem chayyavin, ben asu din kemo chen barasha atzmo ben lo asu.

Venire lefaresh al ze hadderech: veim haelem vegomer, perush bemakom sheen din lematta yihye din lemala, "vesamti ani" vegomer. uchesheyyaasu din lemala yiftechu gam ken pinkese bene mishpachto veyitorru haddinim al kol hammishpacha, vehu amro uvemishpachto. vechazar uferesh simat panim zo ma osa, veamar keneged haish atzmo "vehichratti oto", ucheneged mishpachto yiftechu sifre dinehem, im yesh mehem zonim kemoto hare hu bichlal hakkaret, vehu amro "veet kol hazzonim acharav" mimmishpachto, aval otam shenniftechu sefarav venimtza shello zanu lo yikkartu. veamar od liznot velo hispik lomar "hazzonim vegomer achare hammolech", nitkavven lomar shehagam shello zana ad atta, perush shello heevir beno lammolech, ella shechashav liznot, machshevet avoda zara nitpasim aleha kemaase, veyachrit Adonai et hachoshev kaose, kemo sheamar hakkatuv (Yechezkel 14:5) "lemaan tefos et bet yisrael belibbam".

Nimtzeta omer, sheim am haaretz yaasu din baose ra – en din lemala, velo yamut miyyisrael zulat haoved lammolech. aval im lo yaasu din, niftachim sifre kol hammishpacha umitorer haddin gam alehem, venitpasim gam al hammachshava. vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 5:4): bemakom sheyyesh din vechulei en vechulei, ad kan. kashe, peshita shekkesheyyaasu din lematta ma makom laddin leasot lemala? uledarkenu yeduyyak al nachon, shekkesheosin din lematta nimna din lemala, perush din hashshear sheen sifrehem niftachim. vetimtza sheamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (rosh hashshana 16:) shekkeshenniftachim sifre haddinim, adam nichnas besakkana vetzarich zechut gadol lippater.

rashi: Vaatamme otam bemattenotam. otam mattanot shechakakti lahem, lekaddesh li kol bechor (Shemot 13:2), mesartim beyad yitzram lehaaviram, leotam bechorot, lammolech (Vayikra 18:21); hare: chukkim lo tovim:
Lemaan ashimmem. asimem veachariv otam, ashimmem leshon "shemama" (Yechezkel 6:14); vehamefarsho leshon "ashma" (Vayikra 22:16) toe hu, shehaalef enah mishsharshe hatteva:
Asher yedu. kesheavi alehem haraa:
targum: Vesaivet yathon bemattenathon beaabbera kol petach valda vedil deatzdinun bedil deyedun di ana Adonai:

rashi: Al techallel et bittecha lehazenotah. bemoser bitto fenuya levia shello leshem kiddushin (sanhedrin 76):
Velo tizne haaretz. im atta ose ken, haaretz mezanna et peroteha laasotan bemakom acher velo veartzechem, vechen hu omer (Yirmeyahu 3), vayyimmanu revivim vegomer (tosefta, kiddushin 1):
ohc: Al techallel et bittecha vegomer. perush, yetzav hael lemi sheyyesh lo bat shello yinhag bah minhag chullin lehareotah lifne chol ulehitnaot lifnehem, ella kevudda bat melech penima. vahagam sheyyitkavven bah lahanaat ziuugah kede sheyyivvada ki bat yafa uneima hi vetinnase larauy lah, al kol ze yetzav hael ki chillul hu lah, vehayyotze mizze hu lehazenotah lo lehassiah, ki yivar bah esh hattivi utechallel kevodah. velo zo bilvad ella shettihye sibba lehaveir esh belev roe vechomed vetizne haaretz, ulevassof "umala haaretz zimma", venimtza avon kol haresha taluy betzavvaro. vetze ulemad ma shepperashti befarashat achare mot befasuk (Vayikra 18:2) "kemaase eretz mitzrayim", shechush harut yagdil hachefetz baddavar vivattel koach haratzon bammenia veyattehu el chefetz hammaase rachamana litzlan:

rashi: Veshetef af umi yaamod. lifne kinato shel kanna venakkam:
targum: Nichzeriuta hi chemta vechefa hi rugeza umanu kaem kodam kinata:

rashi: Lo tikkom. amar lo hasheileni maggalcha, amar lo lav, lemachar amar lo hasheileni kardummecha, amar lo eni mashilcha kederech shello hishaltani, zo hi nekima; veezo hi netira? amar lo hasheileni et kardummecha, amar lo lav, lemachar amar lo hasheileni maggalcha, amar lo he lecha, eni chemotcha shello hishaltani, zo hi netira, shennoter haeva belibbo, aappi sheeno nokem (sifra; yoma 23):
Veahavta lereacha kamocha. amar rabbi akiva ze kelal gadol battora (sifra):
ohc: Lo tikkom vegomer. razal (torat kohanim kan; yoma 23.) amru: nekima hu sheose lo kemaasehu hara, netira shello yomar lo "lo eese lecha kemaasecha". uchefi ze natan taam hakkatuv lemitzva zo bismichut "veahavta lereacha kamocha", perush ki Adonai chafetz shettihye ohev reacha kamocha, veim atta omer lo ken, hare gillita datecha ki tamun haya velibbecha maasehu bilti hagun lecha. venatan taam laddavar "ani Adonai", perush al derech amram (Zohar 11 16.) shebbeemtzaut yichud hallevavot mityached shemo yitbarach, leheyot shekkeneset yisrael hem anfe shem havaya baruch hu, dichtiv (Devarim 32:9) "ki chelek Adonai ammo".

Venitchakkem Adonai letzauot beinyan hanehagat yisrael ze im ze behaderaga. mitzva 1: lo tisna. 2: lo tikkom vegomer. 3: veahavta, vedikdek lomar, achicha, ammecha, lomar sheen mitzva ella al anashim sheosim maase ammecha, aval sone Adonai kegon hammumarim vehaeppikorsim asur leehov otam veadrabba tzarich lisnootam, keamro (tehillim 139:21) "halo mesanecha Adonai esna":

rashi: Yisna dakkav. mi shemmekabbel lashon hara sone et hannidkaim tachtav, shekken al lashon hara radaf shaul ledavid veharag nov (Shmuel 1 22:18-19):
Ufe chalak. pe shel chalaklakkut:
Yaase midche. ose dichuy, sheddoche et mekabbelo meal hakkadosh baruch hu:
targum: Lishana deshikra sane archata dekusheta ufuma diflig aved tarchuneta:

rashi: Mishkeve ishsha. machnis kemichchol bishfoferet:
