Et chukkotay tishmoru. veellu hen: behemtecha lo tarbia kilayim vegomer; chukkim — ellu gezerat melech sheen taam laddavar:

Uveged kilayim. lamma neemar? lefi shenneemar "lo tilbash shaatnez tzemer ufishtim yachdav" (Devarim 22), yachol lo yilbash gizze tzemer vaanitze fishtan, tal "beged", minnayin lerabbot hallevadim? talo "shaatnez" — davar shehu shua tavuy venuz. veomer ani nuz leshon davar hannimlal veshazur ze im ze lechabbero, tayshateyr belaaz, kemo "chazyayn linzae deit behon" (moed katan 12), sheanu mefarshin leshon kimmush, paleyshetarea, uleshon shaatnez peresh menachem machberet tzemer ufishtim:
ohc: Et chukkotay vegomer behemtecha vegomer. betorat kohanim amru veze leshonam: en li ella behemto, behemat chavero minnayin? talmud lomar "et chukkotay", ad kan. vekashe, im ken lamma hutzrach hakkatuv lomar behemtecha? haya lo lomar "behema lo tarbia kilayim", veaz lo haya tzarich lerabbot behemat acherim. veraiti leharav baal karban aharon shekkatav baze sheddibber hakkatuv bahove. veen devarav nirim li, ki lo yedabber bahove bemakom sheyyesh litot veyitztarech lehosif devarim lehasir hattaut.

Venire behair beseder hakketuvim, lamma samach hakkatuv mitzvat harebaa lemitzvat ahavat reim, umi yodea lesadder seder matim chaAdonai elohenu. achen letzad shetztzivva Adonai al ahavat hachaverim vehitkashsherut libbam yachad ki chafetz Adonai hitkashsherut anfe hakkedushsha, umizze yomar adam ki lo yakpid Adonai al harebaat tehora im tehora, laze ba hakkatuv veamar ki en haratzon baze lekashsher behema im behema vaafillu bishne anfe hattahara hagam sheshshenehem min tahara, velaze dikdek lomar "behemtecha" perush behema hattehora lecha laachila. vetimtza shebbetorat kohanim darshu veze leshonam: en li ella behema im behema, tehora im temea, temea im tehora minnayin? talmud lomar "et chukkotay tishmoru", ad kan. hinne shessover hattanna ki "behemtecha" hi behema tehora, veim lo amar hakkatuv "behemtecha" lo hayiti yodea shehattehora bichlal, veadrabba yuchshar hammaase letzad shehu hitkashsherut min tahara, vahagam shehaya Adonai merabbe eze ribbuy hayiti dorsho beechad mishshear taarovet tame vetahor.

rashi: Bechukkotay lo halachu. nissu oti baegel (Shemot 32) uvirfidim (Shemot 17:1-7) millekabbel et hattora (mechilta beshallach massechta daamalek 1), vehotiru min hamman (Shemot 16:20):
Veet shabbetotay chillelu. yatzu min haam lilkot man (Shemot 16:27):
targum: Vesarivu al memri bet yisrael bemadbera bikyamay la halichu veyat dinay katzu deim yabed yathon enasha veyeche vehon chaye alma veyat yome shabbaya dili achilu lachada vaamaret lemishpach chamati alehon bemadbera leshetzayutehon:

rashi: Veervat achot immecha vegomer. shana hakkatuv beazharatan, lomar shehuzhar alehen ben al achot aviv veimmo min haav, ben al achyotehen min haem, aval ervat eshet achi aviv lo huzhar ella al eshet achi aviv min haav (80 yevamot 54):

Kemitlahleah. kemityaggea lirot zikim shel esh, kemo "uvezikot beartem" (yeshaya 50:11), milleshon 'zikukim dinur (berachot noach:). davar acher: zikim. 'feronzolash, milleshon "avne kala" (Zecharya 9:15), vechen baggemara (bava metzia tzad.): zikta pesik lan; veyore chitztzim vamavet:
targum: Ech hu demittachat defashet gere shenine demota:

rashi: Nidda hiv. hashshechiva hazzot menudda hi umeusa; verabbotenu darshu leesor haaraa vah kenidda shehaaraa meforeshet bah — et mekorah heera (yevamot 54):

Yihye kol piryo kodesh. kemaaser sheni shekkatuv bo vechol masar haaretz vegomer kodesh laAdonai (Vayikra 27), ma maaser sheni eno neechol chutz lechomot yerushalayim ella befidyon, af ze ken, vedavar ze hillulim laAdonai hu, shennoso sham leshabbeach ulehallel lashshamayim (80 berachot 35):

Vechi tizbechu vegomer. lo neemra farasha zo ella lelammed, shello tehe zevichatan ella al menat leachel betoch hazzeman hazze, sheim likboa lahem zeman achila, hare chevar neemar (Vayikra 7) veim neder o nedava zevach karbano vegomer (sifra):
Lirtzonchem tizbachuhu. techillat zevichato tehe al menat nachat ruach — sheyyehe lachem leratzon, sheim techashshevu alav machashevet pesul lo yeratze alechem lefanay:
Lirtzonchem. apeyytzaymanetav, zehu lefi feshuto; verabbotenu lamdu mikkan lammitassek bakkodashim sheppasul, shetztzarich sheyyitkavven lishchot (zevachim 47; chullin 13):

Metzuppe al chares. kesige chesef hammedubbakim al hacheres shetztzorfin oto bo, vehu mavhik keillu hu kesef, veen bo toelet, ken sefatayim dolkim velev ra. harodfim achar habberiyyot lahasitam bachalakot umedabberim echad bappe veechad ballev:
Velev ra. nirin keohavin vehem oyvim:
Dolkim. kemo "dalakta acharay" (Bereshit 31:36):
targum: Hech kaspa mesalya dikrim al chispa hechna sifvata dedalkan velibba bisha:

rashi: Vehivdaltem ben habbehema hattehora lattemea. en tzarich lomar ben para lachamor, shehare muvdalin venikkarin hem, ella ben tehora lecha litmea lecha — ben shennishchat rubbo shel siman lenishchat chetzyo, vechamma ben rubbo lechetzyo? melo seara (sifra):
Asher hivdalti lachem letamme. leesor:
Ki yihye vahem ov vegomer. kan neemar bahem mita ulemala charet, edim vehateraa biskila, mezid belo hateraa behikkaret, veshiggatam chattat, vechen bechol chayyave mitot shenneemar bahem karet:

Necherefet leish. meyuedet umeyuchedet leish, veeni yodea lo dimyon bammikra; uveshifcha chenaanit chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin hameoreset leeved ivri shemmuttar beshifcha hakkatuv medabber:
Vehofde lo nifdata. peduya veenah peduya, usetam pidyon bechesef:
O chufsha. bishtar (sifra):

Bikkoret tihye. hi loka velo hu, yesh al bet din levakker et haddavar shello lechayyevah mita ki lo chufsha veen kiddusheha kiddushin gemurin: verabbotenu lamdu mikkan (makkot 22), shemmi shehu vemalkut tehe vikria — shehaddayyanim hammalkin korin al halloke "im lo tishmor laasot vegomer vehifla Adonai et makkotcha vegomer" (Devarim 28):
Ki lo chufsha. lefichach en chayyav aleha mita, sheen kiddusheha kiddushin, ha im chuppesha kiddusheha kiddushin vechayyav mita (sifra):
Reacha. verea avicha hakkadosh baruch hu shennikra rea leyisrael, verea avicha shechibbev et avotecha:
Al taazov. im azavta, yavo alecha puranut:

Uvet achicha. al tivtach bivne esav veyishmael sheyyekarvucha. matzinu (tanchuma, yitro 5): kesheggalu yisrael levavel hayu omrim lemolichehem bekolar: bevakkasha mikkem, holichunu bederech achenu bene esav veyishmael, vehayu bene yishmael yotzim likratam umekaddemin otam bemine meluchim venodot nefuchim:
Meach rachok. tov sheyyishkon benechem hakkarov lekorav (tehillim 145:18), mishshettavou etzel ach shennitrachek, lemor "yikrevu yeme evel avi vegomer" (Bereshit 27:41):
targum: Chavrach vechavreh daavuch la tishbok uveveta daachuch la teol beyoma detavrach tav shachna kariv meach rachik:

rashi: Lo teolel. lo tittol olelot shebbah, vehen nikkarot; ezehu olelot? kol sheen lo lo chatef velo natef (sifra):
Uferet karmecha. gargere anavim hannoshrim bishat betzira:
Ani Adonai elohechem. dayyan lippara; veeni gove mikkem ella nefashot, shenneemar al tigzal dal vegomer ki Adonai yariv rivam vegomer (Mishlei 22):
Venatarot. leshon godel, kemo "haetartem alay" (Yechezkel 35:13):
targum: Shappiran inun pudeateh derachama uvishan nushekata desana:

rashi: Veim haelem yalimu. im helimu bedavar echad, sof sheyyalimu vidvarim harebe; im helimu sanhedre ketanna, sof sheyyalimu sanhedre gedola (sifra):
ohc: Veim haelem yalimu – taam hakkefel, lomar sheim helimu min haechad shuv enam yecholin shello lehaelim mehabbaim acharehem, veyalimu vadday mikkullam, ki im yirtzu laasot din bahem yomru lahem "lamma lo asitem din baechad". o yomar haelem leval yimnauhu millitten lammolech, yalimu millaasot bo mishpat achar asher natan, keamro "betitto mizzaro" vegomer.

rashi: Vehitkaddishtem. zo perishut aza (sham):
ohc: Vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim. yetzav Adonai sheyyihyu notim el bechinat hakkedushsha, uvaze hu mavticham sheyyihyu bemadregat malachim hannikraim kedoshim, dichtiv (Daniel 8:13) "vayyomer echad kadosh", vehu amro vihyitem kedoshim. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 100) befasuk "kaet yeamer leyaakov" vegomer ki hammalachim yihyu omdim bashshura hachitzona veyisrael bifnim, veshoalim malache elohim leam kedosho "ma paal el". nimtzeta omer ki kedoshav bimkom hammalachim hem yisrael. vechazar hakkatuv uferesh haddavar shebbo yitkaddeshu veamar ushemartem et chukkotay, perush, tishmeru mitzvot lo taase, utekayyemu mitzvot ase, baze ani mekaddishchem, ki al yede ze shem havaya mitgalle alav uvaze mitkaddesh, uchemo ma shekkatuv bazzohar (Tikkunim 70) ki haevar shebbo ose mitzva shore alav shem havaya haramuz betevat mitzva.

rashi: Ki gerim heyitem. mum shebbecha al tomar lachavercha (sham 59):
Ani Adonai elohechem. elohecha velohav ani:
ohc: Keezrach mikkem vegomer. kan gilla Adonai sodo shekkol nafshot am kedosho hayu tevuim bemitzrayim betoch haummot, vehu ma sheamar "keezrach mikkem" vegomer. veim tomar ech yishve zera mereim sheavotav goyim leezrach sheavotav yedide Adonai? laze amar ki gerim heyitem beeretz mitzrayim, perush nafshotam hayu meoravim toch kelippot mitzrayim, veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat yitro (Shemot 20:2) befasuk "anochi Adonai vegomer asher hotzeticha meeretz mitzrayim" vegomer, uchemo chen ger ze hayta nafsho toch hakkelippot veachshav zarcha baolam vechazra lesharshah, uchefi ze yeshno lintinat taam lishvach "ki gerim" vegomer, sheim al gerut haggufot en hattaam nachon ki yishtanne ger habba min haummot shello yihye neehav letzad hahevdel sheyyeshno beshinnuy hammishpachot, ki lo kechol mishpechot haggoyim bet yisrael.

rashi: Tevel asu. genay; lashon acher mevalbelin zera haav bezera habben:

Heera. gilla, vechen kol leshon erva gilluy hu, vehavvav yoredet batteva leshem davar kemo zaava miggizrat velo kam velo za (Ester Adonai), vechen achava miggizrat ach. vehaaraa zo nechleku vah rabbotenu, yesh omrim zo neshikat shammash, veyesh omrim zo hachenasat atara (yevamot 55):
Meshive taam. chachamim:
targum: Atla chakkim beaynoy tav min shuvea yahave taama:

rashi: Vayyamru vi habbanim. shivto shel dan (Shoftim 18:30-lo); vechen hannitzmadim levaal peor (Bamidbar 25:1-5), leachar shemmetu dor hammidbar (Devarim 2:14-18):
targum: Vesarivu al memri benaya bikyamay la halichu veyat dinay la netaru lemebad yathon deim yabed yathon enasha viche vehon vechaye alma yat yome shabbaya dili achilu vaamaret lemishpach chemti alehon deyachul rugezi vehon bemadbera:

rashi: Veochlav avono yissa. benotar gamur hakkatuv medabber, veeno anush karet al hannishchat chutz limkomo, shekkevar miato hakkatuv, veze benotar gamur medabber, uvemassechet karetot (daf Adonai), lemaduhu miggezera shava:
ohc: Venichreta vegomer. yesh latet taam lamma yihye chamur onesh kohen ochel kadashim chutz lizmannam chiyyuv karet yoter meochel nevela uterefa ushekatzim. da ki min hattaam atzmo sheamru (bava metzia 114:) yisrael metamme beohel veen akkum metammein beohel, letzad sheyyisrael hem bechinat hakkedushsha, velaze keshemmistalleket mimmennu hakkedushsha kol hakkelippot mitkabbetzim yachad uvaim alav. vehu hattaam atzmo bema shellefanenu, ki letzad shehakkadashim yeshnam bemaala sheen lemala mimmenna, kesheavar zeman asher tzivva Adonai bo mistalleket hakkedushsha veshora alav tuma gedola asher koretet nefesh ochaltah, ma sheen ken betumat achilat shear issurim kinvelot uterefot shekatzim vechulei sheen koach battuma hahi lehacherit hannefesh, umittaheret bemalkut.

Veamro ki et kodesh Adonai chillel, shennire sheyyakpid al besar hakkodesh, velidvarenu yakpid al nefesh ochelet devar tuma. ulay ki letzad sheal yede achilat habbasar hu mashlim maase hashshelamim, laze kesheochlim habbasar yesh baze chillul hakkodesh, sheggomer ma shekkevar naasa al yede maase ze, vehu basar tame umechallel et asher kevar ba bakkodesh mehaddam vehachalavim, vezo gam ken sibba lehasheraat tuma gedola al habbasar hahu, ki bechinat hara tekavve vetishaf lemakom hassavuch vesaruch lakkedushsha.

rashi: Avne tzedek. hem hammishkolot sheshshoklin kenegdan:
Efat. hi middat hayyavesh:
Vehin. zo hi middat hallach:

Asher hotzeti etchem. al menat ken; davar acher ani hivchanti bemitzrayim ben tippa shel bechor letippa sheenah shel bechor, vaani hanneeman lippara mimmi shettomen mishkelotav bammelach lehonot et habberiyyot sheen makkirin bahem (bava metzia sefer acher):
Al tifnu al haelilim. leavdam; elilim leshon al — kelo hu chashuv:
Velohe massecha. techillatan elilim hem, veim atta fone acharehem sofcha ose otam elohot (sifra):
Lo taasu lachem. lo taasu laacherim velo acherim lachem; veim tomar lo taasu leatzmechem aval acherim osin lachem, hare chevar neemar lo yihye lecha (Shemot 20) — lo shellecha velo shel acherim:
ohc: Al tifnu. amro leshon peniyya, leesor machshevet avoda zara, shello yihye pone bedato lachshov bah. ulehaskilcha al devar emet da ki bechinat elohim acherim tityaches lah bechinat achorayim, ucheshehaadam choshev bah hem ponim otam letzad panim, vehammaskil yavin.
Haelilim. amar lashon rabbim, letzad shebbechinat hara hi bechinat happerud veen chelek bah sheyyihye leechad, velaze kesheyyazkir hakkatuv elohim acherim yazkirem bechinnuy rabbim.

Velohe massecha vegomer. kashe, vahalo tzivva bederech kelal al kol haelilim shello lifnot lahem, uma tzorech lachzor uletzauot al ze? od lamma amar lachem? veulay sheyyechavven lema sheamru zichronam livracha (Tikkunim 18) ki baasot haadam maase hagun tishre alav shechina, uveavro pi Adonai haevar shebbo chata shora alav ruach hattuma, vehu masach hammavdil beno uven elohav, kederech amro (Yeshayahu 59:2) "avonotechem mavdilim" vegomer, vehu maamaro kan velohe massecha, perush, elohim shehem masakkim mavdilim etchem mimmekor hachayyim lo taasu otam lachem. ha lamadta shehappone laavoda zara gorem masach hammavdil beno uven kono, velaze gamar omer ani Adonai elohechem, lomar mimmi hu nivdal mitztzad hammasach hallaz.

Od yechavven beamro "ani Adonai elohechem", ki bema sheyyishmor atzmo meissur ze shel avoda zara, baze Adonai elohav, al derech amram (chullin 5.) kol hakkofer baavoda zara kemode bechol hattora kullah.

Uvederech remez yechavven al derech amram zichronam livracha (Megila 28.) befasuk "lule pene yehoshafat" vegomer (Melachim 2 3:14), mikkelal sheasur lehistakkel bifne adam rasha, vehu amro kan velohe massecha lo taasu lachem, perush, lo taasu atzmechem elohe massecha sheasur lehistakkel bachem.

rashi: Al tithallel. al titpaer achshav bedavar sheatid lihyot lyom machar:
Ki lo teda ma yeled yom. shemma hayyom yivvaled shum raa, sheyyevattel machshevot machar:
targum: La tishtavhar beyoma delimchar dela yadaat mena yelid yoma:

rashi: Lehosif lachem tevuato. hammitzva hazzot shettishmeru, tihye lehosif lachem tevuato, shebbischarah ani mevarech lachem perot hannetia; haya rabbi akiva omer dibbera tora keneged yetzer hara, shello yomar adam hare arba shanim ani mitztaer bo chinnam lefichach neemar lehosif lachem tevuato (sifra):
Ani Adonai. ani Adonai hammavtiach al kach veneeman lishmor havetachati:

targum: Vaavadet bedil shemi bedil dela yitchal leene ammaya deafektinun leenehon:
Vihavet lehon yat keyamay veyat dinay hodet yathon deim yabed yathon enasha viche vehon bechaye alma:
Veaf ana kaymet bememri lehon bemadbera bedil dela leaala yathon leara di yehavet avda chalav udevash tushebcha hi lechol medinata:
Vaamaret livnehon bemadbera bigzerat avahatchon la tehachun veyat nimusehon la titrun uvefulechan taavathon la tistaavun:
Vein mechanen vekaleh la tehemin beh metul dishva bishata it belibbeh:
Chalaf dedine la avadu uvikyamay katzu veyat yome shabbaya dili achilu uvatar taavat avahathon havaa enehon:
Neshabbechinach chilonay vela fumach nucheraa vela sifvatach:
Veappektinun meara demitzrayim veaeltinun lemadbera:
Beyoma hahu kaymit lehon bememri leappakutehon meara demitzrayim leara dihavet lehon avda chalav udevash tushebcha hi lechol medinata:
Hech tara dimcharach al tzirtah hechna atla al arseh:
Chalaf di vedinay katzu veyat keyamay la halichu behon veyat yome shabbaya dili achilu are vatar fulechan taavathon libbehon tae:
Tavta machsenuta dimgalya min rachamuta demitashya:
Vechas memri alehon milchabbelutehon vela avadit imhon gemira bemadbera:
Vahava fitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Veyat yome shabbaya dili kadishu vihon leat ben memri uvenechon lemeda are ana Adonai elahachon:
Ana Adonai elahachon bikyame halichu veyat dine taru vaavidu yathon:
Vaatev yat mechat gevureti vaavadet bedil shemi bedil dela yitchal leene ammaya deafket yathon leenehon:

bart: Mi sheyyesh lo ginna. venitratztza chitzon latet lappenimi derech beemtza sadehu:
Lo yikkanes mittochah. dechevan demazziko hezzek gadol sheover beemtza sadehu, anan sahade delo nitratztza lo ella letzorech ginna bilvad, velo sheyyikkanes letzorech tashmish acher:
Vehachitzon zorea. dechevan divemtza sadehu hu, anan sahade delo machal lo hadderech legamre veshello yuchal hu lezarah:
Veze vaze en rashshain lezarah. dechevan demin hatztzad hu, lehilluch gereda yichaduhu lo:

Gorfin. beshabbat evus shellifne hashshor shemmefattemim oto, shello yitarev haafrurit shebbaevus batteven uvasseorim shennotnim lefanav veyakutz bemaachalo, umesallekin teven shellefanav litzdadim keshehu rav kede shello yidresennu beraglav veyitlachlech biri:

Vachachamim osrim. attarvayhu kae, echad gerifat haevus veechad teven shellefanav lo yesallekennu litzdadim. velo nechleku rabbi dosa vachachamim ella beevus shel keli, aval beevus shel karka hakkol modim sheen gorfim, dilma ate leashvoye gummot. verabbanan gazru evus shel keli attu evus shel karka. vahalacha kachachamim:

Notlim millifne vehema zo venotnim lifne zo. velo amrinan tiltul delo chaze have, ella vadday chaze, deen behema katza bemaachal hannittal millifne chavertah. vedavka millifne hachamor venotnin lifne hashshor vechayyotze baze, aval lo millifne hashshor venotnim lifne hachamor, shemmaachal hashshor maus baririn hayyotzim mippiv veen hachamor ochel mimmennu:

Nolad ben hashshemashot nimmol letisha. shehare yom shemini shel machar hu nimmol, veshemma ben hashshemashot yom hu venimmol latteshii. haya hayyom erev shabbat i efshar lemulo beshabbat habba, deshemma teshii hu vehaveya la mila shello bizmannah veenah docha shabbat, vetzarich lehametin ad leachar hashshabbat shehu asiri:
Chal yom tov lihyot achar hashshabbat. en mila shello bizmannah docha oto, venimmol leachad asar:
Shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana. dikdushsha achat hen, veen mila shello bizmannah docha et yom tov hashsheni shel rosh hashshana, nimmol lishnem asar:
Ad sheyyavri. veyaavru alav shiva yamim shelemim meet leet miyyom shehivri, veachar kach malin oto:
Haishsha meta techilla. veen leyorshe haishsha kelum, shehare habbaal met acharon veyarash et ishto:

Nechasim bechezkatan. nichse tzon barzel bechezkatan. velo pershu bet hillel i bechezkat yorshe haishsha shehayu shellah, i bechezkat yorshe habbaal sheacharayutan alav, hilkach nichse tzon barzel yachaloku:
Uchetubbat ishsha. shehem mane matayim vetosefet, nisharim bechezkat yorshe habbaal:

Unechasim hannichnasim veyotzim immah. hem nichse melog. shebbeshaa shehi nichneset nichnasim immah ucheshehi yotzet yotzim immah, im pachatu pachatu lah veim hotiru hotiru lah. ellu hem bechezkat yorshe haishsha. nimtzeu yorshe haishsha notlim kol nichse melog vachatzi nichse tzon barzel:
En meyalledin. en moshchin havvalad min harechem beyom tov, deikka tircha yetera:
Aval mesaadin. ochez et havvalad shello yippol laaretz:
Chachama. meyalledet bekia:
Mimmakom lemakom. veen choshshin leissur techumim:

Umechallelin aleha et hashshabbat. mishshaa shehi yoshevet al hammashber umatchil haddam lihyot shotet ad kol shelosha yamim achar sheyyalda, ben amra tzericha ani ben lo amra tzericha ani mechallelin. mishshelosha vead shiva, amra tzericha ani mechallelin, lo amra tzericha ani en mechallelin. mishshiva vead sheloshim, afillu amra tzericha ani en mechallelin, aval osim tzeracheha al yede nachri mippene shehi kechole sheen bo sakkana, vedavar sheen bo sakkana osin tzerachav al yede nachri:
Vekoshrim hattabbur. shel valad shehu aroch, veim lo yiksheruhu veyichrechuhu yetzu meav. aval en kortin oto beshabbat ledivre tana kamma:
Rabbi yose omer af chotchin. vahalacha kerabbi yose shechotchin oto umenakkim oto venotnin alav avak hadas vechayyotze bo:
Vechol tzarche mila osin beshabbat. ulekamman beidach pirka mefaresh letzarche mila may nihu:

Echad habben veechad habbat bannachala. hachi kaamar, echad habben veechad habbat shavin birushshat nichse haem kevirushshat nichse haav, veen hefresh ben yerushshat nichse haem lirushshat nichse haav, ella shehabbechor notel pi shenayim benichse haav veeno notel pi shenayim benichse haem:
Kane shel zetim. kane sheasuy livdok hazzetim shebbammaatan im nitassef shamnan betocho vehiggia lihyot reuyin levet habbad:

Im yesh kesher berosho. keen pekak shebbakkane, mekabbel tuma, lefi sheal yede shehu pakuk bekesher mishtayyer bo min hashshemen hazzav min hazzetim, uvodek bo im higgia leitztzur, vahava leh bet kibbul:
Veim lav. sheen bo kesher, af al pi shehu chalul en chalalo asuy lekabbel kelum, hilkach hava leh peshute kele etz veeno mekabbel tuma:
Ben kach uven kach nittal beshabbat. deha keli hu veasuy lahafoch bo et hazzetim:
Veen benehem poteach tefach. sheen hattachton gavoah min haaretz tefach veen haelyon gavoah min hattachton tefach:

Benehen vetachtehen tame. deen hattachton chotzetz, kevan deen tachtav poteach tefach velo al gabbav poteach tefach, vehaelyon mevi et hattuma lechol ma shettachtav vetachat hattachton, vechotzetz lema sheal gabbav, kevan deelyon gavoah min haaretz tefach:
Kenegdo ad harakia tame. uma shettachtav tahor. deaf al gav deen gavoah mechavero tefach, hare gavoah min haaretz tefach vechotzetz:
Hinniach banot. velo banim:

Shehabbanot nizzonot min habbanim. bitnae ketubba. veen banot ketannot nizzonot min haggedolot. devimkom sheen banim yorshim en habbanot ochlot bitnay ketubba, ella cholkot beshave vechol achat nizzonet mishshellah:
Ketzad botzrin bet happeras. veyihyu haanavim sheggadlu vo tehorim:
Mazzin al haadam veal hakkelim. bashshelishi:
Veshonin. bashshevii:

Umotziin chutz levet happeras. veaf al gav dehabbotzer laggat huchshar lekabbel tuma vehu mishshemona asar davar sheggazru vo vayyom, hane mille letuma deorayta, aval letumat bet happeras derabbanan hi lo chashvinan la hechsher. umishshum hachi nakat vetane mazzin al haadam veal hakkelim, kede sheyyihyu tehorim mittuma deorayta, veaf al pi shechozrin umittammein bevet happeras bishat betzira, tu lo mittammu anavim bingiatam mishshum tumat bet happeras kol kamma delo huchshar hechsher gamur:
Vaacherim. shello nichnesu bevet happeras:
Mekabbelin. min habbotzrim:
Umolichin laggat. bechelim acherim. aval habbotzrim en molichin otam laggat, lefi shehaggat male mashkin umitkashshere vehu hechsher gamur:
Veim nagu ellu vaellu. habbotzrim nagu baacherim hamekabbelin: temeim. hamekabbelim umetammein kol haanavim. shehaadam shennitma bevet happeras naasa av hattuma umetamme adam vechelim:
Bet shammay omrim ochez et hammaggal. desavre habbotzer laggat huchshar afillu letumat bet happeras, umishshum hachi tzarich sheyyochaz hammaggal shehu votzer bo besiv shel dekel delo mekabbel tuma:
O votzer betzor. vehu even chadda, delav keli hi:
Venoten letoch kefisha. keli gadol shekkovshim bo zetim, delav bat kabbole tuma hu:
Umolich laggat. afillu hu atzmo. dechevan dezahir veit leh hekkera shemmanniach bichfisha lo naga:

Bamme devarim amurim becherem hannaasa vet happeras. shehayu gefanim veilanot netuim bo kodem shennaasa bet happeras: aval hannotea. lechattechilla bevet happeras: yimmacher lashshuk. dekansinan leh, mippene shello haya lo litta bevet happeras. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Rabbi eliezer omer echad bari veechad mesukkan. rabbi eliezer let leh divre shechiv mera kichtuvin vechimsurin damu, vaafillu metzavve mechamat mita sevira leh deen mattenato mattana ella bekinyan, kemattenat bari. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Kevinati. targum redidim kevinta:
Tekabberem immam. kelomar en meviin reaya mehem, shershaim hayu, ukenasa kansu rabbanan labbanim lekayyem labbat mattenat imman, af al pi shello haya min haddin:
Aval lo vechol. im chillek hashshechiv mera nechasav bechol:

Kal vachomer bechol. vechen halacha deven bechol ben beshabbat divre shechiv mera kichtive vechimsire damu, veen tzarich kinyan. veim shaal sheyyiknu miyyado, konim mimmennu ben bechol ben beshabbat, kede shello tittaref dato alav:

Veshiyyer karka kol shehu. vehu haddin im shiyyer leatzmo mittaltelin, mattenato mattana, veim amad eno chozer. vehu shekkanu miyyado al oto mattana, demattenat shechiv mera bemiktzat bae kinyan ben amad ben lo amad. veim lo kanu miyyado lo kana mekabbel hammattana afillu met hashshechiv mera. vedavka keshebba lehakenot hammattana mechayyim. aval im amar yittenu lifloni kach vechach achar moto eno tzarich kinyan, vaafillu shiyyer leatzmo. ushechiv mera shebba litten mattana mechayyim, im lo shiyyer leatzmo kelum veamad, chozer vaafillu kanu miyyado. umetzavve mechamat mita dishmana leh dekaamar vay leh demayet, leolam chozer, ben shiyyer ben lo shiyyer, vaafillu kanu miyyado. veim met, kana mekabbel hammattana vaafillu belo kinyan:
Lo chatav bah shechiv mera. kad katzir verame bearseh. veaf lo leshon mattenat bari, kad halach al raglohi beshuka. velo shiyyer kelum:
Hu omer shechiv mera hayiti. vechozrani bi. vehalla omer bari hayita velo tachazor:
Tzarich lehavi reaya shehaya shechiv mera. devatar hasheta azlinan, dehaidna bari hu, vealav lehavi reaya shehaya shechiv mera bishat hammattana:

Vachachamim omrim. lo azlinan batar hasheta ella amrinan hammotzi mechavero alav haraya, umekabbel hammattana shebba lehotzi miyyad hannoten shehu muchzak, alav lehavi reaya veedim shebbari haya beotah shaa. vahalacha kachachamim:
Get pashut. shetar pashut, keen shellanu sheenan tefurim umekushsharin. vechol shetar karuy get:
Edav mittocho. mibbifnim keen sheanu osim:

Mekushshar meachorav. kotev shita achat o shetayim vechorchan al hechalak vetofer, veed echad chotem al hakkerech mibbachutz, vechozer vechotev shene shitin o yoter mibbifnim vechorchan al hechalak, vechotem ed sheni al hakkerech mibbachutz, vechen ed shelishi. vetikkenu rabbanan get mekushshar, mishshum kohanim kappedanim shehayu kotvim get pitom linshotehem umitchartim velo hayu yecholin lehacheziran, vehitkinu lahem get mekushshar sheeno noach likkatev mehera, shemma betoch kach yitpayyes. ucheshem shettikkenu mekushshar beget, kach tikkenu bishar shetarot, shello chilleku chachamim:
Shenehem pesulin. shello naasu ketikkun chachamim:
Sheyyachol laasoto fashut. sheim yikra hattefirot veyiftach hashshetar yihye pashut:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer hakkol keminhag hammedina. pelugta detanna kamma verabban shimon ben gamliel beatra dinhige befashut uvimkushshar, veamar leh aved li mekushshar, veazil veavad leh pashut, o pashut veavad leh mekushshar, tanna kamma savar mikpad kafed ufasul. verabban shimon ben gamliel savar hoil uminhag hammedina betarvayhu, lo kafed vechasher. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Ze beni neeman. leyorsho veliftor et ishto min hayyibbum:
Ze achi eno neeman. lehorisho im echav, shehare enan makkirim oto:

Venotel immo bechelko. kegon im hem shene achim levad hassafek, veyesh lahem lechallek shalosh sadot, ze notel sade umechetza veze notel sade umechetza, veze shemmeid al hassafek shehu achiv, noten lo chatzi hassade, vehaacher eno noten lo kelum, deamar leh have reaya ushekol:
Met. hassafek:
Yachzeru. otan hannechasim shennatan lo achiv:
Limkoman. kelomar lemi shennetanam lo. aval shear achim en yorshim immo:
Naflu lo. lassafek:
Nechasim mimmakom acher. bechayyav. o kana nechasim veachshav met:
Yirshu echav. shel ze shehaya meid shehu achiv:

Immo. deha ka modi lehu sheachihem hu. vehane mille bidla kafru shear haachin lomar vadday sheeno achihen, ella toanim sheenan makkirim oto. aval im kafru bo sheeno achihem, lo yirashennu ella ze sheheid lo bilvad:
Deyateke. tzavvaat shechiv mera. uleshon deyateke da tehe lemekam ulemeheve:
Keshura al yerecho. delekka lememar acher ketavah unetanah sham, afillu hachi hare zo enah kelum, shehare lo gamar lehakenot ella bekabbalat hashshetar, veen shetar leachar mita:
Chatzar hakkever. chatzer hammukkefet mearba ruchoteha arba mearot shel kevarot:

Tahor ad sheyhe vah arba ammot. kol zeman sheyyesh bah arba ammot tahor haomed bah. aval pechuta mearba ammot, tame haomed bah. veim en sham ella shalosh mearot mishshalosh ruchot veruach reviit shel chatzer petucha laavir haolam, afillu eno meruchak mippetach hammeara ella kol shehu, tahor, uvilvad shello yigga lammashkof shel petach hammeara. vehane mille chatzar hakkever dimsayyema mechitztzatah, aval met bealma tofes arba ammot letuma:
Golel lekever. kissuy al petach hakkever:
Ella cheneged happetach. shel hakkever. vehannogea bakkatze hammunnach chutz lakkever, tahor:
Asa roshah golel lekever. vahare hi omedet al hakkever kemo ilan. hannogea mimmenna bearbaa tefachim samuch lakkever, tame mishshum golel, umearbaa ulemala tahor:
Bizman shehu atid lagod. lakotz. veaf al pi shello kitztzetz adayin. lagod, kemo goddu ilana (Daniel 4):
Kullah chibbur. kol zeman shello kitztzetz, veaf al pi sheatid lakotz. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Midda vachevel vechulei. haomer lachavero shete leshonot hallalu hassotrim ze et ze, midda bachevel demashma betzimtzum, hen chaser hen yater demashma delo kafed al meat pachot o yoter. bittel lashon acharon shehu hen chaser hen yater, et lashon rishon shehu midda bachevel. vaafillu pichet rova lisa o hotir rova lisa, higgio:

Divre ven nannas. disvira leh tefos lashon acharon. ufelige rabbanan aleh, veamre hallech achar pachut shebballeshonot, ben rishon ben acharon. dimsafka lehu i tefos lashon rishon o lashon acharon, venotel hallokeach kappachut shebbashshiurin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Besimanav uvimtzarav. amar lo bet kor afar ani mocher lecha betoch hassimanim vehammetzarim haelle:

Hachi garsinan pachot mishshetut higgio ad shetut yenakke. vehachi perusha, im pichet min habbet kor shetut vechol shekken pachot mishshetut, higgio. aval yoter al shetut ulematta ad shetut velo shetut bichlal, yenakke:
Kush. pelech shehannashim tovot bo. veaf al gav difshute keli etz hu mekabbel tuma, mishshum tzinnoret shel mattechet hakkevua bo:
Af al pi sheenan mechuvvanin. sheen shene chatzae zetim mechuvvanim ze keneged ze:
Tame. hakkush. demevi hattuma al atzmo bechol shehu:
Hakkaddar. mocher hakkederot:
Vehassal. hammot shennose bo et hakkederot. uvemassechet kelim korehu esel, ditnan hatam [97 56] haesel sheyyesh bo bet kibbul maot:
Veim yesh bassal poteach tefach. mevi tuma al hakkederot shettachtav latztzad hashsheni shetteluyot bo:
Hatteluliyyot. leshon tel:
Hakkerovot ben lair. hassemucha levet hakkevarot:
Ben ladderech. hassamuch levet hakkevarot:

Echad chadashot veechad yeshanot temeot. mippene shehannashim kovrot sham niflehen, dead chamishshim amma azla ishsha lechoda vekoveret sham hannefel shellah. aval rechokot lo azla lechoda likbor battel, vehoil utzericha leish sheyyelech immah, holechet levet hakkevarot veenah koveret battel. veha dimtammeinan bishanot vaafillu rechokot, dechayshinan shemma kerovot hayu mittechillatan vecharva hair venishtakkach haddavar:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Vetumtum. safek zachar safek nekeva:
Hazzecharim dochin oto etzel hannekevot. deamre leh ayte reaya dezachar at ushekol:
Hannekevot dochot oto etzel hazzecharim. deamre leh ayte reaya dinkeva at vetizzon immanu:
Yalda zachar notel mane. veaf al gav dekayma lan hamezakke laubbar lo kana, hacha bishchiv mera shezzacha livno kana, sheddato shel adam kerova etzel beno:
Yalda zachar unekeva. teomim yachad:
Yalda tumtum eno notel. hay matnitin iddachya la, vehilchata shettumtum notel kappachut shebbishnehem:
Yoresh et hakkol. dela tema birya bifne atzmah hu velav bar yerushsha hu, kamashma lan:
Shennafal echad mehen laummanut. laavodat hammelech. shekken minhag hammelech lehaamid mikkol batte hair adam echad lemoches chodesh echad o shene chodashim:
Nafal laemtza. kol harevach. mippene shemmechamat avihem baat lo. aval im mechamat atzmo, mippene charifuto vachashivuto vechachmato nilkach laavodat hammelech, ma shehirviach hirviach leatzmo:

Chala venitrappa. im chala beones, kelomar shello pasha hu beatzmo, mitrappe min haemtza. aval im chala mitztzinnim pachim vechayyotze vahem, dichtiv behu (Mishlei 22) shomer nafsho yirchak mehem, beha amrinan bematnitin deeno mitrappe ella mishshel atzmo:

Shushevinut. derech shushevinut notel seuda vedoron lachuppa veochel immo, veze chozer veose chen laze gam ken kesheyyissa ishsha. veim shalach haav shushevinut bistam al yad echad mibbanav vechazra hashshushevinut achar kach leachar shemmet haav, chazra laemtza, mippene shehi kemilva, shehare nigbet bevet din, sheyyachol hammolich shushevinut lachavero lachazor velitboa mimmennu bevet din sheyyitten lo shushevinut kederech shennatan lo. vehu sheyyihyu nissue hashsheni kenissue harishon, im betula betula, veim almana almana, veim farhesya farhesya, veim betzina betzina. sheyyachol hashsheni lomar larishon, eni ose immecha ella kederech sheasita immi:
Aval hashsholeach lachavero kadde yayin vechadde shemen. belo chuppa. o i nammi bechuppa veeno holech leechol immo, en zo shushevinut ella mattana, veenah nigbet bevet din:
Massar haggadol. megera gedola shennosrim bah korot:
Veyated shel macharesha. keli gadol heasuy kesakkin shebbo osin charitz shel telem hammaana, vehanach kafed alayhu umeyached lehu makom, delo chazu limlacha achariti:

Kol hakkelim nittalim letzorech veshello letzorech. hachi kaamar, kol hakkelim shemmelachtan lehetter, kegon kearot vechosot, nittalim letzorech gufo uletzorech mekomo shel keli, veshello letzorech, afillu sheeno tzarich legufo velimkomo shel keli ella letaltelo mechamma latztzel o shello yignevuhu haggannavim, share bichli shemmelachto lehetter. ucheli shemmelachto leissur, kegon meduchot verechayim vechayyotze bahen, letzorech gufo uletzorech mekomo muttar, mechamma latztzel o mippene haggannavim asur:

Rabbi nechemya omer en nittalim ella letzorech. mefaresh baggemara letzorech tashmish hameyuchad lo bilvad, velo letzorech davar acher, vaafillu letzorech gufo, kegon sakkin lachtoch bo bilvad share, velo lismoch bo et hakkeara. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya:
Mi shehayta derech harabbim overet betoch sadehu. shehecheziku rabbim laavor sham leolam:
Veshello lo higgio. veyesh larabbim shene hadderachim. dekayma lan metzar shehecheziku bo rabbim asur lekalkelo:
Derech hayyachid. hammocher lachavero derech toch sadehu tzarich litten lo arba ammot:
Derech hammelech en lo shiur. shehammelech poretz gader lefanav laasot lo derech:

Derech hakkever. shennosin hammet lekavro, en lo shiur. takkanat chachamim hi, mishshum yekara demet. velo sheyyecholim lifrotz gader kederech hammelech, ella sheyyecholim hamelavvin et hammet laavor al gabbe zeraim veen tzerichim lintot lechan ulechan:

Bet arbaat kabbin. hu [sheloshim veshalosh ammot ushene tefachim] rochav beorech chamishshim amma. umekom hammaamad hu shehayu osim shiva maamadot shiva moshavot keshehayu chozrin millikbor hammet, keneged shiva havalim shebbitchillat sefer kohelet:
Shelosha vet happeras hen. kidka chashiv lehu veazel. sade shennechrash bah kever, vesade sheavad bah kever, usede vochim:

Nittaat kol neta. notea bah kol ilanot sheyyirtze. umatnitin delo cherabbi yose deasar leel. veikka lememar deaf rabbi yose lo asar ella litta bah kerem bilvad, mishshum dehabbotzer laggat huchshar, aval lo shear ilanot:
Chutz mizzera hanniktzar. aval zera hanneekar im sharashav chayshinan shemma yavi etzem kasseora im heafar haole im hashsharashim hanneekarim:
Veim akaro. oto zera hanniktzar:
Tzover et garno letocho. letoch hassade atzmah. vedash oto sham. velo yeviennu labbayit ad achar disha, shello leharebot et hattuma:
Vechovro vishte chevarot. zo achar zo. shemma nitarev immo etzem kasseora:
Vehakkitniyyot beshalosh. lefi shehakkitniyyot yesh bahen afar yoter mibbattevua, mishshum hachi chayshe vehu tefe. aval tehorin hen, shehare lo huchsheru. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vesoref et hakkash veet heatza. betoch hassade. shemma yesh bahen etzem kasseora:
Kash. teven shel tevua:
Atza. teven shel kitniyyot:
Umetammea vemagga uvemassa. sede bet happeras sheamarnu:
Veenah metammea veohel. dechol tumatah mishshum etzem kasseora veetzem kasseora eno metamme veohel:
Vehittiach besela. hikka hammacharesha besela umittoch kach ninara hammacharesha:
O shennier et hammacharesha. min heafar shealeha. veha ka mashma lan delo chayshinan shemma lo nier yafe:
Ad sham hu ose vet happeras. velo yoter, vaafillu toch shesh ammot o chamesh:
Bet peras ose vet peras. hammatchil lacharosh besof bet happeras o veemtza. mone mea amma mimmakom shehitchil lacharosh, vehu naasa bet happeras keillu charash mimmekom hakkever:
Charash chatzi maana. chamishshim amma mimmekom hakkever, vechazar achar kach vecharash mishsham od chamishshim amma acherot, kol hammea naasu bet peras. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Yorshe haav omrim habben met rishon. veen baal chov yachol lehippara minnechasim ellu, shehare lo zacha bahen habben meolam:
Uvaale hachov omrim haav met rishon. venaflu hannechasim shaa achat lifne habben, vehem meshubadim lichtubbat ishsha uvaale chov:
Bet shammay omrim yachaloku. dekasavre bet shammay shetar haomed liggavot kegavuy dame, veyorshe haav uvaale chov tarvayhu muchzakim havu, lefichach yachaloku:
Uvet hillel omrim. hannechasim bechezkat yorshim uchemuchzakim damu uvaal chov ba lehotzi miyyadam vealav lehavi reaya shehaav met techilla:

Kofin keara. shel cheres al gabbe hanner, uvilvad shello yechabbe. veaf al pi shennotel keli lehatztzalat kora sheenah nittelet beshabbat, ha otivna minna lerabbi yitzchak deamar en keli nittal ella letzorech davar hannittal, veshane la betzarich limkomo shel keli, deshare letaltelo letzorech mekomo:

Veal tzoa shel katan. lav tzoa shel naar katan kaamar, deha geraf shel rei hu umuttar letaltelo ulehotzio laashpa, ella hachi kaamar veal tzoa shel tarnegolim, mippene hakkatan shello yetappeach veyitlachlech bah. uchegon shetztzoa zo munnachat baashpa shebbechatzer delo ramya kammeh velav geraf shel rei hu, hilkach en muttar letaltelah ulehotziah, aval kofin aleha keara bishvil hakkatan shello yitlachlech:
Maase va. kefiyyat keli al akrav:
Baarav. shem makom:

Choshesh ani lo mechattat. dechevan shello haya akrav ratz acharav choshesh ani shemma chayyav chattat mishshum tzida. uleinyan pesak hahalacha otan baale haeres shennoshchin umemitin vadday, kegon hannechashim hasserafim vechelev shote, muttar lehargan miyyad kesheyyire otan vaafillu sheen ratzim acharav. veotan sheenan noshchim umemitin vadday, ella peamim memitin ufeamim en memitin, im ratzim acharav muttar lehargan, veim en ratzim acharav kofe alehem keli, veim derasan vaharagan lefi tummo muttar. velatzud nachash mippene sherotze letzachek bo, asur:
Hishbichu gedolim et hannechasim. beodan bitfusat habbayit:

Hishbichu laemtza. vehane mille kesheshshavchu hannechasim mechamat nechasim atzman, shello hotziu mishshellahen kelum ella minnichse avihen sachru poalim vehishbichu hannechasim mechamat atzman. aval im chafru venatu vehotziu mishshellahen, ma shehishbichu hishbichu leatzman:

Vechen haishsha shehishbicha. baggemara mokminan la beishsha yoreshet. kegon shennasa reuven et bat shimon achiv, umet belo vanim, uvenot shimon achiv yorshot oto, nimtzet ishto shehi bat shimon achiv yoreshet oto im shear achyoteha, vesalka datach amena divhahi hanaa denafek ala kala sheshsholetet umashbachat afillu ki amra reu ma hinniach li bali vechulei‏ afillu hachi machala verotza sheyyihye hashshevach laemtza, kamashma lan dehishbicha leatzmah:
Nizraat kol zera. hachi garsinan berov hassefarim. aval battosefta katane enah nizraat kol zera. vechen hi veenay:
Veenah nittaat kol neta. velo mibbaya deen notin lechattechilla, ella af hannatua lo yekayyem, shello leharegil bene adam lesham, mishshum dimtammea veohel achmur bah tefe:
Chutz meilan serak. demuttar litta bah. umahu ilan serak, sheeno ose perot:

Hachoresh. bet happeras. makom shehattuma perusa umitpashshetet sham. verabbotay fershu, peras leshon davar parus veshavur, sheatzamot shel met [shelemot] nifresu sham. umippi acherim shamati, al shem shepparsot bene adam nimnaim lalechet sham mippene hattuma:

Melo maana. shel hammacharesha. mimmekom hakkever shehitchil lacharosh bo ad mea amma beorech hassade al mea berochav, chayshinan shemma holicha hammacharesha mimmennu etzem kasseora. veim haya choresh veholech chutz lemea amma, mimmea amma velachutz tahor, sheen hammacharesha molechet atzmot hakkever ella ad mea amma:

Bet arbaat sein. mea amma orech al mea amma rochav hu mekom zeriat arba sein, shehare chatzar hammishkan shehaya mea al chamishshim hu vet satayim, kidamrinan beeruvin [23:], nimtza mea al mea bet arba sein:
Rabbi yose omer bet chamesh sein. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Uvemorad. kelomar, shiur ze sheamarnu letanna kamma ulerabbi yose lemar kidit leh ulemar kidit leh, hane mille cheshemmolich hammacharesha bemorad, dimgalgalto lemerachok, vehu haddin keshehakkarka shava bemishor. aval bemaale, keshechoresh veole, ledivre tanna kamma noten rova kav karshinin al borech hammacharesha, hu etz chalul kafuf asuy cheen berech shehammacharesha tekua vo, veose beshulav nekev katan keshiur sheyyetze mimmennu garin echad miggarine hakkarshinim, umolich hammacharesha vehaggarinim noflim meat meat, uvemakom shekkalu hakkarshinim sheen nofel mehem harebe beyachad ella shelosha garinim ze betzad ze, sham kale bet happeras:

Rabbi yose omer bemorad velo vemaale. lo amru din bet happeras ella vemorad, aval kashehammacharesha ola baggova en sham bet happeras kelal, shemmiyyad hammacharesha nineret veim yesh sham etzem nofel. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Tzarich sheyyichtov mehayyom uleachar mita. demashma guf hakkarka yehe kanuy lecha mehayyom, velo tochal happerot ad leachar mita. veim lo katav mehayyom, lo natan lo kelum, deen mattana leachar mita:

Eno tzarich. lichtov mehayyom. dechevan shekkatav bashshetar bechach vechach beshabbat amar lanu peloni havu alay edim, zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav shemmeoto hayyom hitchila hammattana, dei la tema hachi, zeman shennichtav bashshetar lamma nichtav. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Leachar moto. mehayyom uleachar mita:
Haav eno yachol limkor. belo habben. shehagguf kanuy labben:
Vehabben eno yachol limkor. belo haav. shehapperot kenuyin laav:
Machar haav. setama, mechurim happerot lallokeach ad sheyyamut haav:
Machar habben. bechayye haav, en lallokeach perot ad sheyyamut haav:
Haav. shekkatav nechasav livno mehayyom uleachar mita:

Tolesh umaachil. happerot lemi sheyyirtze bechayyav. aval ma shehinniach bimchubbar bishat mita af al pi sheomed littalesh hare hen shel beno mekabbel hammattana. aval hakkotev nechasav leacher, afillu ma shehinniach bimchubbar lakkarka bishat mitato hare hu shel yorshim, sheddato shel adam kerova etzel beno yoter meacher:
Mitparnesin. levush uchesut. lefi shepparnasat haggedolim merubba mipparnasat hakketannim:

Nizzonim. achila ushetiyya. lefi shemmezonot hakketannim merubbim mishshel gedolim, sheochlim peamim rabbot umefazzerim, lefichach hakketannim meakkevim al haggedolim millehitparnes mittefusat habbayit, vehaggedolim meakkevin al hakketannim millizzon, ella yitparnes veyizzon kol echad mechelko:
Nasu gedolim. veasu tzarche chuppa mittefusat habbayit leachar mitat avihem:
Yisseu gam hakketannim. mittefusat habbayit:
Veim amru hakketannim. leachar mitat avihem, hare anu nosim kederech shennesatem attem bechayye avinu:
En shomin lahem. ella ma shennatan lahem avihem bechayyav, natan:

Habbodek. ha ditnan uvodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma, en tzarich lachpor et kullan, ella chofer amma al amma umanniach amma sheeno chofer, veose chen ad shemmaggia lesof esrim. veotah amma shehu chofer tzarich lachpor ad shemmaggia lesela, o livtula, shehi karka shello nechpera meolam:
Hammotzi et heafar mimmekom hattuma. meotam haammot shehu chofer:

Ochel bedimo. im kohen hu ochel bitrumato. leshon meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher (Shemot 22). veaf al gav deen kohanim rashshain livdok shehare hen muzharin al hattuma, mikkol makom i itreme kohen uvadak eno asur leechol bitruma hecha delo itchazzak sham tuma:
Hamefakkeach et haggal. shel avanim shennafal al haadam vamet, im kohen hu eno ochel bedimo, dechevan dehuchzeka sham tuma chayshinan dilma heehil, vaafillu safek chay safek met chayshinan:
Marchitzin et hakkatan. hay marchitzin lav kedarko hu, detana sefa lefaroshe resha ketzad marchitzin kegon lezallef bayyad, aval bichli afillu lezallef asur, vechol shekken lirchotz kedarko:

Rabbi elazar ben azarya kulei. paleg attanna kamma vesavar marchitzin et hakkatan kedarko ben lifne hammila ben leachar hammila, uvayyom hashshelishi lammila nammi ben bechammin shehuchemu beerev shabbat ben bechammin shehuchemu beshabbat atzmo, desakkanat nefashot hi, vahalacha kerabbi elazar ben azarya:
Safek. ben shemona chodashim safek ben tisha. dei ben shemona keeven bealma hu veen milato docha shabbat:

Verabbi yehuda mattir beanderoginos. middichtiv (Bereshit 16) himmol lachem kol zachar lerabbot anderoginos. vetanna kamma, arlato ketiv, mi shehu kullo arel, yatza ze shechetzyo nekeva. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Natlu shelosha chalakim bannachala. benachalat eretz yisrael. vesavar hay tanna leyotze mitzrayim nitchalleka haaretz, dichtiv (Bamidbar 26) lishmot mattot avotam yinchalu. utzelafchad vechefer aviv shenehem natlu chelek baaretz, shemmiyyotze mitzrayim hayu shenehem. venatlu benot tzelafchad chelek avihem shehaya maggia lo baaretz, vechelek hammaggia lo mirushshat chefer aviv, vechelek bechorato shehaya bechor venotel pi shenayim. veaf al pi sheadayin lo yarshu et haaretz veen habbechor notel pi shenayim barauy lavo leachar mita, eretz yisrael muchzeket hayta:
Hashsholeach sivlonot. minhag chatanim lemochorat hakkiddushin sholchin levet haarusa tachshitim umine migdanot vechadde yayin vechadde shemen, ufeamim holech hechatan veochel sham:
Enan nigbin. im met hu o meta hi o shebba legarshah. demechamat chibbat simchat achila machal. vedavka sheachal bedinar, aval achal pachot middinar lo machal vegove hassivlonot:

Shalach sivlonot merubbim. vaafillu muatim, im peresh al menat sheyyavou immah levet balah hare ellu nigbin. veorcha demilleta nakat, shedderech hassivlonot sheshsholchin kede sheyyavou levet balah lihyot merubbin, veotan sheshsholchin kede shettitkashshet bahen bevet aviha darkan lihyot muatin:
Hamekabbel mechavero. bekibbolet sheyyachpor lo kever:
Arba ammot. rochav, veshesh baorech:
Shemona chuchin. shemona kevarim:

Shelosha mikkan shelosha mikkan. lishne tzedadin shel orech hammeara. ushenayim keneged hannichnas lammeara. vechol kever vakever arba ammot orech verochav shishsha tefachim verum shiva. nimtza ben kol kever vakever shemmin hatztzedadim amma umechetza. uven hashshenayim shemmikkeneged shete ammot:

Hakkol lefi hassala. im hammakom kashe en hamekabbel chayyav lachpor ella shesh ammot baorech vearba barochav kedivre tanna kamma. veim hammakom rach vetichoach chayyav hamekabbel lachpor shesh al shemone kedivre rabbi shimon. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Kol hammittaltelin meviin et hattuma. mishshum ohel. sheim heehil rosho echad al hammet verosho echad al hakkelim, mevi lahem hattuma:
Koovi hammardea. afillu en bo rochav tefach ella sheyyesh behekkefo tefach, dechut shel tefach makkifo, degazru al hekkefo mishshum avyo:
Akappach et banay. ekberem. kippuach leshon kerita vechittuch. ushevua hi, akappach et banay im en davar ze emet shehalacha zo mekuppachat ketua umechuttechet, deha poteach tefach bainan:

Sheshshama hashshomea. keshennishala sheela al yede maase bevet hammidrash veshama shettimmeuhu velo yada mishshum ma timmeuhu. hem timmeu et hammardea mishshum kelim hammaahilim al hammet, shehakkeli atzmo hammaahil al hammet tame bechol shehu, delo vainan poteach tefach ella lehavi et hattuma tachat rosho hashsheni, vetimmeu et haikkar o mittaam chibburim o mishshum dahave leh kelim shennagu vammet veadam bakkelim vetame tumat shiva. vehashshomea taa lomar detimmeuhu mittaam shehammardea mevi alav tuma middin ohel:
Sheyyehu divre chachamim mekuyyamim. sheomrim demardea mevi tuma.

Al haadam hannosan. zimnin deadam hannosan en alav ki im tumat erev, shebbigdo mafsik ben ketefo lammardea vahave leh deyikrav bidyikrav lidyikrav, veharoe shemmetammeim oto tumat erev yite lomar mishshum ohel timmeuhu lefi sheyyesh behekkefo tefach, veate lememar detumat ohel en bah ki im tumat erev. hilkach gazru alav boovi hammardea littamme tumat shiva middivrehem mishshum ohel:
Veal atzman bechol shehen. dichli hammaahil al hammet tame afillu kol shehu:
Veal shear adam vechelim. shettachat hammardea.
Befoteach tefach. kevan deen lahem tuma kelal en shayyach ligzor al hekkefo mishshum avyo:

Nafal habbayit alav veal immo. veen lah ben acher ella ze. yorshe habben omrim haishsha meta techilla veyarash habben nechaseha veanu yorshim habben. veyorshe haishsha mimmishpachat bet aviha omrim habben met techilla veanu yorshim et haishsha:

Ellu vaellu modim. bet shammay uvet hillel: sheyyachaloku. dechevan sheshshenehem baim mikkoach yerushsha have safek vesafek, veyachloku. velo dame lenafal habbayit alav veal ishto, dehatam yesh shene mine nechasim, yesh shehabbaal muchzak veyesh shehaishsha muchezeket, aval hacha hakkol bechezkat haishsha kevan shehayta almana, ushenehem baim mikkoach yerushsha lirash hakkol, hilkach yachaloku:

Mode ani vaze. dildivre bet hillel hacha nammi amrinan nechasim bechezkatan, bechezkat yorsheha min haav, shehare bechayyeha mishshemmet balah achar shevet aviha hi mityacheset, umamonah nammi bechayyeha haya bechezkat shevet aviha. hilkach yorsheha min haav yorshim otah. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Al hachalukin anu mitztaarin. kelomar, al machaloket dilel devet shammay uvet hillel anu mitztaarim shello hishvu datan, veatta omer sheggam baze chalukin uvata lachlok al tanna kamma sheomer shehem shavin:

Aliyya tehora. mimma nafshach, im hakkever betoch habbayit, habbayit tame vehaaliyya tehora. veim hakkever tachat askuppat petach habbayit, tuma nichneset labbayit vaaliyya tehora. aval kesheen petach haaliyya mechuvvan keneged petach habbayit, chayshinan dilma kae kever tachat hakkotel mechuvvan keneged pitchah shel aliyya, uvokaat hattuma ad shemmaggaat lefitchah shel aliyya, venichneset laaliyya derech happetach:
Vaafar chutza laaretz. kelomar o afar chutz laaretz. deeretz haammim uvet happeras tarvayhu metammu vemagga uvemassa:
Shebba veyarak. kegon agudda shel yarak sheyyesh bah kelachim harebe shenneekru vegushehen, uvechol kelach bifne atzmo lekka afar kechotam hammartzufin shehu shiur haggush letamme:
Chotam hammartzufin. amtachot shel or keen sakkin sheholche derachim notnim kelehem betocham vechotmim alehem bechotam shel tit:

Kisa uchesatayim chotamot. shel tit. vehay uvda mayte rabbi yehuda lesayyoe lerabbanan delisa vesatayim meafar shebba michutza laaretz lo chashshu, hoil velo haya vechotam echad bifne atzmo kechotam hammartzufin. vahalacha kachachamim:

Rabbi eliezer omer tolin et hammeshammeret. shemmesannenim bah shimre yayin, umoteach et piha lechol tzad beiggul venaase keohel al chalal hakkeli. veaf al gav deaved ohel, share beyom tov, disvira leh lerabbi eliezer machshire ochel nefesh sheefshar laasotan meerev yom tov muttar laasotan beyom tov. aval beshabbat [tole] lechattechilla lo, aval im teluya hi notnin letochah shemarim umesannenin, deen derech borer bechach:
En tolin et hammeshammeret. deaved ohel aray umechaze kemaase chol:
Veen notnim latteluya veshabbat. dahava toladat borer o merakked. vahalacha kachachamim:
Tzitzin. kemin nimin shel basar shennisharu min haarla:
Atara. hi safa gevoha hammakkefet et haggid saviv, umimmenna meshappea veyored lerosho. uvasar hachofe et rov haatara dekatane matnitin, lo tema rov hekkefah ella afillu rov gavha bemakom echad:

Veeno ochel batteruma. im kohen hu, dechohen arel asur leechol bitruma. neemar befesach (Shemot 10) toshav vesachir lo yochal bo, veneemar batteruma (Vayikra 22) toshav kohen vesachir lo yochal bo, ma pesach asur learel, af teruma asura learel:
Veim haya vaal basar. shehaya shamen venire basar shellemala mearlato leachar shennittela haarla kullah keillu oto basar chozer vechofe et haggid:
Metakkeno. umeshappea beizmel meoto ovi:
Mippene marit haayin. shello yehe nire kearel:
Velo fara. lo gilla:

Keillu lo mal. veyashuv veyifra, vaafillu sillek yado mimmenna. vechol zeman shehu mitassek bammila beshabbat chotech ben tzitzin hameakkevin ben tzitzin sheen meakkevin. leachar shessillek yado, al tzitzin hameakkevin chozer, al tzitzin sheenan meakkevin eno chozer:
Chavile. aguddot:
Zeradim. anfe hailan lachim shemmezardin otam lemaachal behemot:
Kofin et hassal lifne haefrochim. umevattel keli mehechano lo have, sheen haefrochim omdim alav. vehaomer en keli nittal ella letzorech davar hannittal, moke lematnitin betzarich limkomo shel keli:
Shebbarcha. min habbayit:
Dochin otah. bayyadayim:
Ad shettikkanes. vedavka dochin, aval lo medaddin, lefi shehattarnegolet magbahat atzmah min haaretz venimtza shehu metaltelah. aval avvazin ushear ofot medaddin:
Medaddin agalim. ochez betzavvaro uvitzdadav vegorro umassio umenaanea lo raglav:
Vehaishsha medadda et benah. ochazto bizroav meachorav vehu menia raglav veholech:
Shennotel achat umeniach achat. keshehattinok menia et raglav meniach achat umagbiah achat:
Aval gorer asur. shennosato. vechol makom sheamar rabbi yehuda ematay bammishna lo ba lachalok ella lefaresh divre chachamim, hilkach hilcheta kevateh:
Pekak hachallon. kegon luach umasach o shear kol davar shessotmim bo hachallon:
Vetaluy. sheeno nigrar baaretz:
Veim lav en pokkin bo. sheim nigrar al gabbe karka keshehu shomto meal haaretz listom bo, mechaze kemosif al habbinyan, vesavar rabbi eliezer en mosifin al ohel aray beshabbat:
Ben kach uven kach. ben kashur ben eno kashur pokkin bo, hoil vehaya muchan meetmol lechach, desavre rabbanan mosifin al ohel aray beshabbat. vahalacha kachachamim:
Lo amar kelum. veen yachol lesalleko min hayerushsha ella al yede sheyyitten bemattana nechasav lishar banav:
Al piv. mishshum dimtzavve mechamat mita, ushechiv mera devarav kichtuvim vechimsurim veeno tzarich kinyan. mishshum hachi tane al piv:
Vehishva lahen et habbechor. bilshon mattana:
Devarav kayyamin. veen kan matne al ma shekkatuv battora, sheyyesh koach baadam litten mamono bemattana lechol mi sheyyirtze:

Veim amar mishshum yerushsha. veim ribba leechad umiet leechad betorat yerushsha, sheamar peloni beni yirash sade bet kor, ufeloni [beni] yirash sade bet letech, veal beno bechor amar sheyyirash keshel chavero, lo amar kelum, mippene shemmatne al ma shekkatuv battora:

Katav ben battechilla vechulei. tinnaten sade pelonit lifloni veyirashenna, zehu battechilla. yirashenna vetinnaten lo, zo hi bassof. yirash sade pelonit vetinnaten lo veyirashenna, zo hi mattana baemtza:
Im amar al mi sherauy leyarsho. kegon al ben ben habbanim, veal bat ben habbanot, peloni yirasheni:

Devarav kayyamin. dichtiv (Devarim 21) vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav, hattora natna reshut laav lehanechil labbanim lemi sheyyirtze. umode rabbi yochanan deal ach bimkom bat veal bat bimkom ben, lo amar kelum, sheen habbat reuya lirash bimkom ben, velo haach bimkom bat. vechen mode rabbi yochanan, sheim hishva et habbechor labbanim lo amar kelum, dichtiv (sham) lo yuchal levakker vechulei. vahalacha kerabbi yochanan ben beroka:
En ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. en lachachamim nachat ruach bemaasav, vaafillu en banav nohagim kashshura, dilma nafek minnayhu zara maalya. veen halacha kerabbi shimon ben gamliel:

Tavlayot shel etz. shehen semuchot zo etzel zo vechol achat mehen gevoha min haaretz tefach venogot bekarnotehen kol achat bachavertah sheetzlah, vederech karne hattavlaot sheen berachban tefach, hilkach kelim shettachat harishona shehattuma tachteha, temeim, veshettachat hashsheniyya tehorim:

Hannogea bashsheniyya tame tumat shiva. veaf al gav ditnan beferek kamma kelim hannogim bemet vechelim bechelim temeim tumat shiva, hashshelishi ben adam ben kelim temeim tumat erev, ha tenan hatam en haohel mitchashshev, hilkach tavla shehattuma tachteha enah min hamminyan:

Ad sheyyehe vo ribbua befoteach tefach. kemin teva perutza sheyyesh lah arba defanot hayu osim lashshulchan shehashshulchan yoshev aleha, veotah teva perutza karuy ribbua. ufeamim shehashshulchan bolet veyotze chutz meoto ribbua tefach o pachot o yoter, vehasheta kaamar detzarich sheyyehe hashshulchan bolet chutz meoto ribbua befoteach tefach, dema shebbetoch haribbua eno mitztaref. veim tuma nammi vetoch haribbua mibbifnim, haribbua chotzetz umonea hattuma millaavor lachutz:
Chatzatzo meartzo. shekkissa karkait habbayit binsarim o yeriot:
Tuma vachatzatz. afillu yesh bo tefach al tefach berum tefach:

Kelim shebbabbayit temeim. keviv shehu kamur tachat habbayit, ditnan leel beferek 3, yesh bo poteach tefach veen bitziato poteach tefach, tuma vetocho habbayit tame, tuma babbayit ma shebbetocho tahor:
Sheartzo shel bayit kamohu. kesheen bo poteach tefach:
Kurnas. pattish:
Haddevela. leachar sheasaah iggul hi ava vekasha utzericha kurdom lechatchah:
Megera. keen sakkin aroch veyesh bo pegimot harebe:
Ligror bo et haggevina. lechatchah ulechallekah lachalakim, sheal yede pegimotav memaher vechotech haddavar heav:
Magrefa. ligrof bah haggerogarot min hechavit:
Rachat. luach sheyyesh lah bet yad ushete defanot vezorin bah et hachitta:
Umazleg. keli sheyyesh lo shalosh shinnayim umehappechim bo et hakkash baggoren:
Kush. pelech shettovot bo hannashim:
Karkar. etz shel orgim vedome lemachat shel sakkain:
Litchov bo. leechol bo tutim vechol mine peri rach:
Machat shel yad. machat ketanna shettofrim bah begadim:
Littol bo et hakkotz. shennichnas bivsaro, shemmuttar littelo beshabbat, kemo shemmuttar lehafis muresa lehotzi mimmenna lecha, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot lah pe:
Veshel sakkaim. machat gadol shettofrin bah sakkin:
Liftoach bo et haddelet. mi sheavda lo mafteach:
Mefannin. im tzarich limkoman lehoshiv sham orchin lehasev basseuda o talmidim lishmoa hadderasha, vedavka lidvar mitzva share velo chayshinan letircha deshabbat:
Arba vechamesh. lav davka, dei bae afillu tuva nammi:
Aval lo et haotzar. kelomar uvilvad shello yigmor et haotzar kullo ad sheyyaggia lekarkaito, dilma ate leashvoye gummot:
Mefannin teruma tehora. vaafillu yisrael delo chazya leh yuchal letaltelah ulefannotah, kevan dechazya lechohen:
Udemay. dechaze laaniyyim, keditnan maachilin et haaniyyim demay, vei bae hava mafkir lenichseh vahave ani vechaze leh, hasheta nammi chaze leh:

Umaaser rishon shennittela terumato. shennittela mimmennu terumat maaser velo nittela mimmennu teruma gedola, kegon shehikdim ben levi velakach hammaaser beshibbolin daadayin lo chala aleha chovat teruma, sheen haddagan chayyav bitruma gedola ad sheyyitmareach bakkeri, veze shehikdim velakach hammaaser beshibbolin eno mafrish ella terumat maaser bilvad, umuttar baachila af al pi shello hifrishu mimmenna teruma gedola:
Umaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu. sheppadu otan habbealim venatnu et hakkeren velo natnu et hachomesh, veshaminan mehacha shehem peduyin vehachomesh have milve gabbe bealim:
Aval lo et hattevel. vaafillu tevel derabbanan, kegon hazzarua beatzitz sheeno nakuv:

Velo et maaser rishon shello nittela terumato. im hikdim ben levi velakach hammaaser achar shennitmarcha hattevua bakkeri kodem shehifrishu mimmennu teruma gedola, vehifrish mimmennu terumat maaser velo hifrish teruma gedola, zehu maaser rishon shello nittela terumato haamur kan, shekkevan shennitmarcha bakkeri venitchayyeva bitruma, keshellokeach hammaaser rishon af al pi shemmafrish mimmennu terumat maaser, kol zeman shello hifrish mimmennu teruma gedola tevel have veasur letaltelo beshabbat:

Velo maaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu. kegon shennifdu aval lo nifdu kahalacha, kegon sheppada hammaaser sheni al gerutaot shel kesef, veen maaser sheni nifde ella bemaot sheyyesh alehem tzura dichtiv (Devarim 14) vetzarta hakkesef beyadcha. vehekdesh eno nifde bekarka dichtiv (Vayikra 27) venatan et haerkecha bayyom hahu, davar hannittan miyyad leyad:
Luf. min kitnit sheeno rauy chay afillu livhema. verambam peresh min mimmine habbetzalim:
Leorvin. kegon ashirim shemmegaddelim orvim ligdulla. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Shechatzatzo. sheasa vo mechitztza:
Min hatztzedadin. shehayeriot vehannesarim netunot keneged hakketalim shel habbayit:
O min hakkorot. shennetunot tachat tikrat habbayit:
Kelim shebbachatzatz tehorim. diriot unesarim chotztzim, venechshavim kechelim sheal haggag uchechelim shechutz lakkotel:
Kelim shebbabbayit temeim. deen chatzitza lattuma, midi dahava akkeli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil, deim tuma babbayit matztzil al ma shebbetocho, veim tuma vetocho en tzamid patil lattuma:
Kelim shebbachatzatz. hakkeli sheim hattuma betoch hammechitztza:
Im yesh sham poteach tefach. sheyyesh sham chalal rachav tefach:
Veim lav tehorim. hakkelim shebbachatzatz. aval bayit miha tame:
Chiltit. kach shemah baaravi, vehi chamma venohagin leachlah bammekomot hakkarim, veen shorin otah beshabbat, demechaze kemaase chol:
Et hakkarshinin. metzif alehem mayim bichli livror pesaltan, shehappesolet tzaf lemala:
Velo shafin otan. bayyad lehashshir pesaltan, dahava leh borer:
Aval noten betoch hakkevara. veaf al pi sheppesaltan nofel lifamim derech nikve hakkevara venimtza mitbarer meelav:
Hatteven. shehayu osim min hakkash shemmechattechin otan bammorigim venaasa kol zenav hashshibbalin teven:
Motz. hu mizzekan hashshibbolet haelyon, veeno rauy lemaachal behema, vechovrim oto bichvara sheyyippol hammotz:
Aval notel bichvara venoten letoch haevus. veaf al pi shehammotz nofel meelav, dedavar sheeno mitkavven muttar kerabbi shimon:
Mi shemmet. shehannechasim merubbim. kede sheyyizzonu habbanim vehabbanot ad sheyyivgeru habbanot:
Shehannechasim muatin. sheen bahem keshiur ze:

Bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti. bitmiha. ella lo afsid, venizzon kullanu yachad. veen halacha keadmon. veasu almana etzel habbat binchasim muatim, kevat etzel haachin, ma bat etzel haachin habbat nizzonet vehabbanim yishalu al happetachim, af almana etzel habbat haalmana nizzonet vehabbat tishal al happetachim:

Notnim mayim. beshabbat al gabbe shemarim hannetunim bamshammeret mibbeod yom. kede sheyyitztzallu sheyyihyu hashshemarim tzelulim veyazov kol yenam. perush acher al gabbe shemarim shennisharu bechavit, vekoltin hammayim taam hayyayin, umotziin otan beshabbat veshotim otan, veen baze mishshum borer:
Et hayyayin. mippene hakkemachim levanim shemmithavvim bo:

Besudarin. hameyuchadin lechach. velekka lemigzar dilma sachit lehu, hoil vaasuyin limlacha zo. vehu shello yaase beyado bassudar kemin gumma befi hakkeli kede sheyyered hayyayin bammidron, shello yaase kederech shehu ose bechol:
Uvichfifa mitzrit. sal heasuy mitztzure haddekel. vehu shello tihye hakkefifa gevoha mikkarkait hakkeli hattachton tefach, shello yease ohel aray:
Venotnim betza vimsannenet. shennatnu bah chardal lehistannen, shergilin litten betza terufa baddevarim haachurin vehem mitlabbenim umizdakkechim al yadah:
Enumelin. yayin udevash ufilpelin:
Lagin. gadol mikkos vekatan mechavit:
Hakkol lefi haorchim. im yesh lo orchin merubbin ose harebe, ben beshabbat ben beyom tov ben bammoed. vahalacha ketanna kamma sheosin yenumulin beshabbat kefi ma shehen rotzim:

Kol hakkodem lannachala yotze yerecho kodmin. veim en yotze yerecho kayyamin, chazra nachalatan etzel haav. ketzad, reuven shemmet, chanoch ufallu chetzron vecharmi [banav] yorshin oto. veim met echad min habbanim kodem reuven, vehahu ben hinniach ben o bat [o ben ben o bat ben] o ben bat o bat bat] ad mea dorot, yirash bimkom aviv benichse aviv reuven, veyittol keechad mibbene reuven. veim en liruven banim velo bene vanim veaf lo benot banim, az yorshot benot reuven et reuven. veim en liruven banot velo bene banot velo benot banot ad sof kol haddorot, az yirash yaakov et reuven beno. veim en yaakov kayyam, yirshu et reuven echav bene aviv, shimon levi vihuda [yosef uvinyamin] vechulei. veim enan kayyamin, yirshu et reuven bene shimon velevi vechulei. veim en lahem banim velo bene vanim, yirshu benotehen o bene venotehen o benot benotehen. divchol makom hazzachar veyorshav kodmin lannekeva. veim metu echav shel reuven belo zera o shello haya lo ach meolam, tirshennu achoto dina bat yaakov o baneha o bene vaneha [o benoteha uvenot benoteha] ad sof haolam. veim en liruven achot velo zera achot, tachazor yerushshato laavi aviv dehaynu leyitzchak. veim en yitzchak kayyam, tachazor yerushshat reuven leesav ben yitzchak, shehu achi aviv shel reuven. veim en esav kayyam, tachazor yerushshat reuven leelifaz ben esav o levanav velivne vanav o livnotav velivnot benotav ad sof kol haddorot. veim en achim leaviv shel reuven velo mibbene venehen, tachazor yerushshat reuven laachot aviv o levaneha velivne vaneha o livnoteha al hasseder sheamarnu. veim en leaviv shel reuven lo achim velo bene achim velo achot velo bene achot, tachzor yerushshat reuven leavraham avi avi aviv. vechen leolam ad adam harishon:

Haav kodem. leolam laache haav velivnehem, [vaache haav kodmim laachot haav], vaache haav vaachot haav kodmim [laavi haav. vaavi haav kodem laache avi haav. vaache avi haav veaf achoto kodmin] laavi avi haav. vechen leolam:
Haeven shebbekeruya. delaat yevesha umemalleim bah mayim, umittoch shehi kalla enah shoevet ella tzafa, venotnin bah even lehachebidah:
Im memallein. bakkeruya:
Veen haeven nofelet. shehiddekuha yafe befi hakkeruya, hava keli:
Veim lav. hare hi kishar avanim veen metaltelim et hakkeruya, shennaaset basis laeven shennosatah:
Zemora shehi keshura letafiach. lefach katan sheshshoavin bo mayim min habbor o min hammayan, memalleim bo, deshavya lehach zemora keli:
Sagos ave. hach matnitin perashnuha leel beferek habbayit shennisdak [mishna 3]. veayde devae lemitne tavlayot, hadar tanye hacha:

Veim hayu shel shayish. afillu elyona gevoha min haaretz tefach la chashive ohel lehavi et hattuma, kevan dehattachtona memaetet et haavir lefi shehen nechshavot kaaretz. aval tavlaot shel etz enan chashuvot kekarka bizman shehaelyona gevoha min haaretz tefach, af al pi shehattachtona memaetet et haavir, haelyona mevia et hattuma:

Mi shehayu lo shete tinokot vechulei. pelige amorae baggemara begirsat mishna zo, vehaggirsa shettafsu rabbotay ikkar kach hi, mi shehayu lo shete tinokot, echad lamul achar shabbat veechad lamul beshabbat, veshachach umal et shel achar shabbat beshabbat, chayyav. echad lamul beerev shabbat veechad lamul beshabbat, veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat beshabbat, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat verabbi yehoshua poter. vehachi perushah, shachach umal et shel achar hashshabbat beshabbat chayyav ledivre hakkol, shehare taa bidvar mitzva velo asa mitzva keshehikdim umal et shel achar hashshabbat beshabbat, uveha afillu rabbi yehoshua mode:

Echad lamul beshabbat veechad lamul beerev shabbat veshachach umal et shel erev shabbat beshabbat, rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat. demila shello bizmannah enah docha shabbat. veaf al gav detaa bidvar mitzva shehaya tarud beoto shel shabbat umittoch kach taa baze, veaf baze asa mitzva shehare rauy hu lamul ella sheeno doche shabbat, sevira leh lerabbi eliezer taa bidvar mitzva veasa mitzva sheenah docha et hashshabbat chayyav:
Verabbi yehoshua poter. disvira leh taa bidvar mitzva veasa mitzva sheenah docha et hashshabbat patur, kevan desavur haya shebbirshut bet din hu ose. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Haya vodek. lehashelim esrim amma:
Lenachal. nahar:
Lishlulit. ammat hammayim shemmechalleket shalal laagappeha sheammot acherot shel mayim shotot mimmenna:
O lederech harabbim. sheen kovrim bah et hammet:
Mafsik. veeno vodek od lehashelim esrim amma:
Vehakkol tahor. veen lahem tefusa. ella melakket haatzamot bilvad veen tzarich littol yoter:
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Rabbi eliezer omer im lo hevi cheli. izmel lamul et hattinok:
Mevio veshabbat megulle. lehodia shechaviva mitzva zo, shemmechallelim aleha et hashshabbat:
Uvassakkana. sheggazru gezera al hammila:
Mechassehu al pi edim. sheyyaidu sheizmel shel mitzva hu mevi, velo yachsheduhu shehu nose shear chafatzav:
Velaasot barzel. kede laasot izmel lemila:
Kol melacha sheefshar laasotah. kegon machshire mila, hoil veefshar laasotan meerev shabbat en dochin et hashshabbat, ufaleg adderabbi eliezer:
Shei efshar laasotah meerev shabbat. kegon mila atzmah shei efshar lah leasot, dizmannah bashshemini, docha shabbat. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Melatamya. kemo male tamya. chafira melea metim ze al gabbe ze. tamya velashon arammi atzamot shel metim:

Umitztzevirat haatzamot. mimmakom shehaatzamot tzevurim sham. deze davar sheeno matzuy sheyyihye adam choresh al chafira shehi melea metim veal tzevirat atzamot geluyim, velo gazru ella vekever shennecherash shehu davar hammatzuy:
Umissade sheavad bah kever. dahave leh sefek sefeka, shemma lo charash bimkom hakkever, veim timtze lomar charash shemma lo holich mimmenna etzem:
O shennimtza vah kever. shecharash veachar kach nimtza. devet happeras derabbanan, velo kansu leh kevan delo yada:
Hachoresh et sheeno shello. lo kansu rabbanan lemihve ara dechavreh bet happeras. vechen nachri lo shayyach beh kenas:
Sheen bet happeras lakkutiyyim. kelomar, shehare af al hakkutiyyim lo kansu, kol shekken shello kansu al hannachri:
Hannogea bah. kol zeman shehi golel:
Tame tumat shiva. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vechol asher yigga al pene hassade, lerabbot golel vedofek:

Vehechavit vehammashkin tehorim. dichli cheres hammukkaf tzamid patil tahor millittamme veohel hammet, shenneemar (sham) vechol keli fatuach asher en tzamid patil alav tame hu, ha yesh tzamid patil alav tahor, uvichli cheres hakkatuv medabber, sheeno mekabbel tuma miggabbo:

Rabbi meir omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi meir, ella af al pi sheen lecha davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim umetamme, chutz meadam, mikkol makom metammeim hen mishshum golel kol zeman shehen golel lakkever:
Mohalin. chotech et haarla:
Uforin. haor hamechasse rosh haggid:
Umotztzim. et haddam, veaf al pi shehu ose chabbura, sheen haddam nittak mechibburo ella al yede metzitza:
Ispelanit. tachboshet:
Loes beshinnav. dechol ma deefshar leshannot meshanne:
Im lo taraf yayin veshemen. regilim hayu shehayu torfim bikara yayin veshemen umearvin otan yachad lirfua al hammila, kederech shettorfim betzim bakkeara:
Chaluk. chaticha shel beged nekuva, umachnisin hammila beoto hannekev kede shello yachzor haor vichasse et haggid:
Lo hitkin. lo hizmin:
Korech al etzbao. derech malbush leshannoto midderech hotzaa bachol:
Afillu mechatzer acheret. lo mibbaya mibbayit levayit beoto chatzer af al pi shello ervu, ella afillu lechatzer acheret sheenah meorevet immahem:
En omrim lo kabbe. daamira lenachri shevut:
Veal techabbe. en tzarich limchot beyado, ella yannichennu vichabbe, mippene sheen shevitat hannachri alehem, deyisrael eno muzhar al shevitat hannachri kesheeno avdo:

Hammotze met battechilla. shello haya yadua shehaya sham kever. vehachi amrinan baggemara benazir [daf sad] hammotze, velo shehaya matzuy. met, perat leharug, deharug en lo tevusa veen lo shechunat kevarot, vehachi gemire la.
Mushkav. velo shehaya yoshev:
Kedarko. velo shehaya rosho munnach ben yarchotav. dechol hane chayshinan lehu shemma nachrim hen, sheen darkan shel yisrael likbor metim kach:

Notlo veet tefusato. muttar lefannoto mishsham ulekavro bemakom acher. vetzarich sheyyittol min heafar shel hakkever immo, kede tefisa, shehu kol heafar tichoach shettachtav, vechofer bekarka betula shalosh etzbaot. dichtiv (Bereshit 47) unesatani mimmitzrayim ukevartani bikvuratam, shello haya tzarich lomar mimmitzrayim, ella hachi kaamar, meafar shel mitzrayim tol immi. verambam gares tevusato, heafar hameorav middam velecha shel hammet. leshon mitboseset bedamayich (Yechezkel 16):
Matza shelosha. im yesh ben ze laze mearba ammot vead shemone. kelomar mikkever rishon ad shelishi en pachot mearba ammot velo yoter al shemone:

Hare ze shechunat kevarot. venikkar shelleshem kevura netanum sham, veasur lefannotam, dekanu mekomam. vaafillu met echad im nikkar shelleshem kevura netanuhu sham asur lefannoto. ella shebbeechad o vishnayim anu tolim shello nikberu sham ella lefi shaa vehaya datam lefannotam, aval bishlosha muchach shezze makom meyuchad likvarot. veorech hammeara darkah lihyot shesh verachbah arba vaalachsonah odef shete ammot dehaynu shemone, umishshum hachi tenan mearbaa vead shemone:
Kimlo mitta vekovreha. lo garsinan la hacha:

Bodek mimmennu ulehallan esrim amma. shehammeara arba ammot rochav al shesh orech, vehechatzer shehammearot petuchot lo mikkan umikkan, shesh al shesh, dehachi sevira lehu lerabbanan bevava vatra perek hammocher perot [daf ka], nimtza orech shete mearot vechatzer shebbenehen shemone esre ammot, ulefi sheppeamim chofrim meara achat baalachsonah, vaalachson shel meara odef al ribbuah shete ammot, nimtzeu esrim amma, shemone dimara rishona vaalachsonah veshesh dechatzer shebben shete hammearot veshesh dimara sheniyya, dechad alachson amrinan tere alachsone lo amrinan, vehayenu dekatane esrim. veod tzarich livdok millemala umillematta esrim amma, dehaynu arbaim amma, deshemma zo hi meara shebbemizrach hechatzer veyesh adayin acheret kenegdah bemaarav hechatzer, i nammi zo hi shebbemaarav hechatzer veyesh adayin acheret bemizrach hechatzer:

Matza met echad besof esrim bodek hemennu ulehallan esrim amma. demi yemar demibbet hakkevarot ze haveya hahi meara, shemma kever acher hu vechatzer acheret shel adam acher, vetzarich laasot gam lesham kol bedikot dilel, dichmo sheyyesh sham kever kemo chen yesh acherim:
Sheraglayim laddavar. achare shennimtza kevar besade zo shechunat kevarot:
Sheillu mittechilla metzao. lekever ze kodem shemmatza hashshelosha harishonim, haya notlo veet tefusato, keditnan baresha hammotze met bitchilla kulei‏ notlo veet tefusato:
Al gabbe tehora. shessede bet happeras lemala utehora lematta:
Afillu adumma. shehayta afarah shel tehora adumma:
Vehilbinuha. mechamat afar bet happeras shehaya lavan:
En osin otah bet happeras. shello gazru tuma ella al gush kivriyyato, velo gazru al heafar hannishtaf im hammayim:
Kol hakkelim. sheyyesh lahen delatot:
Nittalim beshabbat vedaltotehen immahen. veaf al pi shennitparku haddelatot min hakkelim kodem hashshabbat, nittalim beshabbat aggav hakkelim:
Veenan domin ledaltot habbayit. sheafillu nitparku beshabbat en nittalin, lefi sheddaltot habbayit enan min hammuchan, kelomar lo naasu letiltul:
Hammaahil al hammet venogea bechelim. hakkelim temein tumat shiva mittaam chibburim, kegon divshaa shennaga bammet o maahil alav, nogea kemo chen bakkelim:
Veim yesh beyadav poteach tefach temeim. kevan deyadav maahilot al hammet veal hakkelim, meviot et hattuma:
Shene vattim. ufitchehen mechuvvanim ze cheneged ze:
Mevi et hattuma. venisharu shene habbattim temeim. deohel shel yadav metzaref et hattuma keillu shene hachatzaim munnachim baze uvaze:
Veim lav. deen beyadav poteach tefach, gavra miha tame have, keditnan lekamman veal atzman bechol shehen, aval shene habbattim tehorim:
Meen melacha. ezo melacha shettihye, vaafillu enah meen melachtan harishona:

Litztzok letochan mikpa. ava, dumeya deissa meorevet bemayim. velo felige ella benishberu beshabbat, aval nishberu meerev shabbat kulle alma modim denittalim afillu en osin meen melachtan harishona. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Notel adam et beno. bechatzer vehaeven beyado velo amrinan dimtaltel laeven:
Kalkalla. sal:

Vehaeven betochah. vehu sheyyihyu perot bassal, sheim en bo perot naase basis ledavar haasur veasur letaltelo. vetzarich nammi sheyyihyu betocho perot sheim yashlichem baaretz yimmaasu, kegon tutim vaanavim vechayyotze bahem, aval im hayu bo perot kegon egozim ushekedim, menaer et happerot vehem noflim. uferot hannimasim nammi kegon tutim vaanavim, im efshar lesallekam letzidde hakkalkalla ulenaer haeven levaddah ulehashlichah, asur letaltelah im haeven. umatnitin ayre kegon shennifchat mitztzidde hakkalkalla o shuleha vehaeven dofen lah, shei efshar lehishtammesh bakkalkalla belo haeven:
Teruma temea im hattehora veim hachullin. aggav hattehora veaggav hachullin. aval temea beanpe nafsha lav bat tiltul hi:

Af maalin et hamedumma beechad umea. sea shel teruma shennafla bemea seim shel chullin, muttar lehaalotah lisa shel teruma mehen beshabbat veyihyu kullan chullin umuttarin lezarim, velo amrinan metakken hu, ditruma shennafla bachullin chashvinan la keillu munnachat levaddah veenah meorevet, uchesheola beechad umea hatteruma atzmah shennafla ola, hilkach lav metakken hu. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Tuma vifnim. bimkom hatteven:

Shekkeneged hayetzia. makom panuy yesh kerochav amma min happetach ad kotel shekkenegdo shennichnasim veyotzim derech sham lehotzi hatteven ulehachnis. vechelim shebbeoto makom happanuy temeim, midi dahava attuma bachatzatz dechelim shebbabbayit temeim:
Tuma vachutz. hayenu bammakom happanuy min happetach ad kotel shekkenegdo:
Kelim shebbifnim. bimkom hatteven:
Im yesh bimkoman tefach al tefach berum tefach tehorim veim lav temeim. devachatzatz nammi im tuma babbayit kelim shebbachatzatz sheen bimkoman tefach temeim:

Veim yesh ben hatteven velakkorot poteach tefach. lo nitbattel hatteven hahu lechashev kachatzatz vahare hu chishar chafatzim shebbabbayit, veen matztzil al ma shebbetocho ben yesh bimkomo tefach ben en bimkomo tefach:
Haomer lachavero bet kor afar. middat bet kor hu chamishsha veshivim elef amma. shechatzar hammishkan haya bet satayim, vehaya mea al chamishshim, vechor sheloshim sein:
Afar. harauy lizria mashma. aval im amar bet kor setam, o bet kor karka, afillu haya kullo selaim higgio, deshemma livnot bayit o lemishtach beh perot bae leh:
Nekaim. bekaim amukkim o selaim gevohim asara. uchegon sherchavim arbaa al arbaa, dahave makom chashuv:
En nimdadin immah. vetzarich sheyyitten lo bet kor shalem mikkarka chalak. sheen adam rotze litten meotav bemakom echad veyerau lo kishnayim ushelosha mekomot:
Kevet kor. mashma kemo shehi, ben selaim ben afar:
Chaviyyot. shurot harebe shel chaviyyot, zo achar zo vezo al zo:
Shehen yoshvot al shulehen. ufihen lemala:
O muttot al tziddehen. ufihen min hatztzad:
Baavir. bagginna o vechatzer:
Befoteach tefach. berochav tefach nogot zo vazo:

Tuma vokaat veola. latztzedadin katane la. demuttot al tziddehen afillu cheneged hattuma en tame ella ma shettachtehen veal gabbehen, aval ma shebbetochan tahor, kevan deen keli cheres mittamme miggabbo, al ma shebbetocho matztzil. uma sheeno cheneged hattuma afillu shettachtehen veal gabbehen tahor. uveyoshvot al shulehen afillu al ma shebbetocho en matztzilot, kevan sheen hefsek meavir tocho laavir shechutza lo, vechavit atzmah nitmea venitmeu chol kelim shebbetochah vaafillu shello cheneged hattuma, kidamrinan taama besof perek kavveret:
Bamme devarim amurim bithorot. dechevan dithorot hen damu letavlaot shel shayish shehattachtonot sotmot et chalal tefach vetuma bokaat veola:

Aval im hayu temeot. afillu en gevohot min haaretz, haelyonot sheggevohot min haaretz tefach meviot et hattuma, sheen hattachtonot sotmot kevan ditmeot midi dahave akkefulin zo al zo vetavlaot zo al zo:
O gevohot min haaretz poteach tefach. meviot et hattuma, vaafillu tehorot, kevan denogot zo vazo berochav tefach nechshavot kullan keohel echad:

Meshammenin benehen. roin hammakom hashshamen shebbesade zo, venotel oto hammocher, deyad lokeach al hattachtona. uchenegdo noten lallokeach min hammakom haggarua kemo sheshshave hammakom hashshamen shennatal hammocher. dechi kaamar leh chatzi sade ani mocher lecha, kede deme chatzi sade kaamar leh. veim hayta bat mea amma bemea dinarin, veyesh bah sheloshim amma makom shamen sheshshave chamishshim dinarin, notlo hammocher, venoten lallokeach shivim amma min haggarua bachamishshim dinarin. venafka minna, derotze adam bekav iddit mishshene kabbin zibburit, veaf al pi sheddeme shenehen shavin:
