Chetzyah shebbaddarom ani mocher lecha. en shamin kol hassade kehahi deresha, ella shamin kamma shave chatzi hassade shebbaddarom ben tov uven ra, ucheneged ma sheshshave chetzyah shebbaddarom noten lo mocher lallokeach bechol ruach sheyyirtze min haggarua sheyyesh lo. deyad lokeach al hattachtona, veshemma hachi kaamar leh, ma sheshshave chatzi shebbaddarom ani mocher lecha bakkarka shelli bechol makom sheertze:

Umekabbel alav. hallokeach, latet makom bachatzi sade ze shekkana laasot gader, vecharitz uven charitz, tarvayhu achore haggader mibbachutz, kede shello tehe chayya kofetzet venichneset bassade. dei avid charitz velo avid ben charitz, ayde dacharitz ravach, nichneset betocho vekofetzet lemala al sefato hashsheni. vei avid ben charitz velo avid charitz, ayde dekatin kayma assefata vekaftza. vechamma ben charitz leven ben charitz, tefach:
Vechen keri shel tevua. shebbittelo:
Afillu tuma vetzad hakkelim. shehayta hattuma betoch haggal, vechelim sham semuchim lattuma betoch haggal aval enan nogim battuma:
Tuma vokaat veola. uma shebbetziddah tahor. veim yesh bimkom hattuma tefach al tefach berum tefach, hare hu chekever satum umetamme kol sevivav:
En bahen poteach tefach. shehazzizin en berachban tefach, hilkach ben shehattuma lematta ben shehattuma lemala lo chaytze kelal:
Vechen shete yeriot shehen gevohot min haaretz befoteach tefach. ugevohot zo mizzo tefach, dinan kishne zizin:
Hakkash sheal hammitta. setama lehassaka umuktze hu, uva lishkav alav umenaneo kede sheyyehe rach vetzaf lishkav alav:
Lo yenaneo veyado. demuktze hu, aval menaneo begufo bichtefav, detiltul min hatztzad hu velav shemeh tiltul:
O shehaya alav kar o sadin. degalle dateh deaktzeye lishchiva, meatta torat keli alav:
Machbesh. shene luchot shemmesimin benehen habbegadim leachar kevisatan umehaddekin halluach haelyon al habbegadim hammunnachin balluach hattachton kede sheyyehe kippulan nae:
Mattirin. dehaynu letzorech shabbat littol et habbegadim, aval lo kovshim dehaynu tzorech chol:
Veshel kovsim lo yigga bo. mippene shehu asuy letakken begadim umihaddak tefe, vehattarato doma listira. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Midda vachevel. kelomar betzimtzum ani mocher lecha sade zo sheyyesh bah bet kor afar, kemo shemmoddim bemiddat hachevel, lo pachot velo yoter:
Pichet kol shehu. shello haya beoto sade bet kor shalem, hammikkach kayyam, vinakke hammocher kefi happechat:
Hotir. karka kalshehu al bet kor, yachazir lammocher hakkarka shehotir o deme hakkarka, kedimfaresh veazil:
Im amar lo. mocher lallokeach, bet kor afar ani mocher lecha hen chaser hen yater, bechach vechach damim, velo amar lo midda bachevel:

Afillu fichet o hotir rova kav. lechol sea, dehaynu sheloshim reviiyyot levet kor, higgio. umiddetane tanna afillu pichet rova lassea, velo tane afillu pichet shiva kabbin umechetza lechor, shaminan minna daafillu bimchira muetet, kegon bet sea ani mocher lecha hen chaser hen yater, im pichet rova o hosif rova, higgio. veim amar bet kor setam, setama nammi kehen chaser hen yater dami:
Yoter mikkan. yoter merova lechol sea im hotir, yaase cheshbon, yachshov kamma hotir al bet kor vechamma shavin lefi cheshbon shemmachar et bet kor:

Velamma amru yachazir lo maot. shemmin haddin en lehachazir lo ella karka shehare lo kana hallokeach ella bet kor bilvad. velo tikkenu chachamim sheyyitten lo maot keneged ze hayyeter, ella leyappot kocho shel mocher, shello yafsid oto karka muat delo chazi leh lemidi:

Sheim shiyyer. bevet kor sade bet tisha kabbin, dehashta chazi leh hay karka, kidamrinan daf 11, devet tisha kabbin chashuv lihyot nikra sade, az en machazir lo maot, ella hammocher notel et hakkarka shello. veshaminan mimmatnitin deshivat kabbin umechetza lechor, shehu rova hakkav lechol sea, have mechila. mishshiva kabbin umechetza ad tisha kabbin velo ad bichlal, yaase cheshbon. tisha kabbin o yoter, yachazir karka:

Velo et harova. hachi kaamar, hecha daamaran yaase cheshbon o yachazir karka, lo et hammotar bilvad hu machazir, ella gam kol hashsheloshim reviiyyot shel bet kor hayeterim hu machazir, dechevan deikka karka chashuv ben hakkol, lo machil mide:

Bamme devarim amurim bechissuy karka. baggemara kaamar divchissuy kelim kulle alma lo felige deshare af al gav delet lehu bet achiza, uvechissuye karkaot kegon kissuy shel bor vedut kulle alma lo felige deasur i let lehu bet achiza. ki felige bechissuye kelim hamechubbarim lakkarkaot, mar savar kekarkeot damyan, umar savar lav kekarkeot damyan. vahalacha kachachamim, shehamechubbar lakkarka hare hu kekarka:
Mille mayim. mibbor birshut harabbim:

Kevesh. osin bisfina gedola lered bo min hassefina layyabbasha. veitzterich tanna leashmeinan ner umayim, dei tana ner hava amena ner hu deshare delekka lemigzar shemma yarbe bishvil yisrael, dener leechad ner lemea, aval mayim deikka lemigzar asur. vei ashmeinan mayim hava amena mayim hu devishvil yisrael asur, aval ner af al gav devishvil yisrael kevan deihu nammi tzarich leh share, dener leechad ner lemea, tzericha. vechevesh af al gav dedami lener, dechevesh leechad kevesh lemea, mishshum maase derabban gamliel uzekenim tana leh, demaase rav:
Yesh nochalin. yesh kerovim shennochalin et kerovehem keshehem metim. veaf keshemmetim hem, manchilin lahem et mamonam:
Haav et habbanim. dichtiv (Bamidbar 27) ish ki yamut uven en lo vehaavartem et nachalato levitto, bimkom bat atta maavir nachala meav, vei atta maavir nachala min haav bimkom achin:
Vehabbanim et haav. dichtiv ish ki yamut uven en lo, ha yesh lo ben, ben kodem:
Vehaachin min haav. dichtiv (sham) mimmishpachto veyarash otah, umishpachat av keruya mishpacha, dichtiv (sham 1) lemishpechotam levet avotam:

Haish et immo. dichtiv (Bamidbar 37) vechol bat yoreshet nachala mimmattot bene yisrael, heach bat yoreshet shene mattot. ella zo sheaviha mishshevet echad veimmah mishshevet acher, virashtan. umiddichtiv mattot, hikkish matte haem lematte haav, ma matte haav ben kodem labbat, af matte haem ben kodem labbat:

Vehaish et ishto. dichtiv sheero, zo ishto. vekarinan hachi, unetattem et nachalat sheero lo, vegorin umosifin vedorshin. yachol af hi tirshennu talmud lomar veyarash otah, hu yoresh otah veen hi yoreshet oto:
